3 算术主题变奏3 

Variations on an Arithmetic Theme

本章介绍一种极其强大、但也可能很危险的灵活性技术：通过谓词分派的泛型过程。我们从相对平静的算术水域出发，逐步调整运算符符号的含义。In this chapter we introduce the extremely powerful but potentially dangerous flexibility technique of predicate-dispatched generic procedures. We start out in the relatively calm waters of arithmetic, modulating the meanings of the operator symbols.

我们先把算术推广到能够处理符号代数表达式，再推广到函数。我们使用一个组合子系统，其中被组合的元素是算术运算包。We first generalize arithmetic to deal with symbolic algebraic expressions, and then to functions. We use a combinator system where the elements being combined are packages of arithmetic operations.

但很快我们就想要更多灵活性。因此，我们发明了可以动态扩展的泛型过程，其中处理过程是否适用，由作用于所提供实参的谓词决定。这非常强大，也很有趣。利用泛型过程，把算术扩展为能够操作“微分对象”，我们只需很少的工作就实现了自动微分！But soon we want even more flexibility. So we invent dynamically extensible generic procedures, where the applicability of a handler is determined by predicates on the supplied arguments. This is very powerful and great fun. Using generic procedures to extend the arithmetic to operate on “differential objects,” we get automatic differentiation with very little work!

谓词分派的开销相当大，因此我们将研究降低这种开销的方法。在此过程中，我们发明了一种带标签的数据，其中标签不过是缓存某个谓词值的一种方式。在本章结尾，我们通过设计一个简单但易于扩充的冒险游戏，展示泛型过程的威力。Predicate dispatch is pretty expensive, so we investigate ways to ameliorate that expense. In the process we invent a kind of tagged data, where a tag is just a way of memoizing the value of a predicate. To finish the chapter we demonstrate the power of generic procedures with the design of a simple, but easy to elaborate, adventure game.

3.1 组合算术系统3.1 Combining arithmetics

假设我们有一个程序，能够计算出一些有用的数值结果。它依赖于程序文本所引用的算术运算符的含义。我们可以扩展这些运算符，使其不仅能操作程序原本预期的数，还能操作其他事物。经过这些扩展，程序可能完成一些在编写时未曾预料到的有用工作。一种常见模式是，程序接收数值权重和其他参数，将加权后的参数相加，构成线性组合。如果把加法和乘法运算符扩展为既能操作原来的数，也能操作数的元组，那么该程序就能构造向量的线性组合。这种扩展之所以能够奏效，是因为这组算术运算符是一个规范明确、内部协调一致的整体。用更强大的算术系统扩展数值程序是可行的，除非新的量不遵守程序作者所假定的约束。例如，矩阵乘法不满足交换律，因此，如果某个数值程序依赖数的乘法满足交换律这一事实，那么这样的扩展就行不通。我们暂且忽略这个问题。Suppose we have a program that computes some useful numerical results. It depends on the meanings of the arithmetic operators that are referenced by the program text. These operators can be extended to work on things other than the numbers that were expected by the program. With these extensions the program may do useful things that were not anticipated when the program was written. A common pattern is a program that takes numerical weights and other arguments and makes a linear combination by adding up the weighted arguments. If the addition and multiplication operators are extended to operate on tuples of numbers as well as on the original numbers, the program can make linear combinations of vectors. This kind of extension can work because the set of arithmetic operators is a well-specified and coherent entity. Extensions of numerical programs with more powerful arithmetic can work, unless the new quantities do not obey the constraints that were assumed by the author of the program. For example, multiplication of matrices does not commute, so extension of a numerical program that depends on the fact that multiplication of numbers is commutative will not work. We will ignore this problem for now.

3.1.1 一个简单的常微分方程积分器3.1.1 A simple ODE integrator

微分方程描述系统状态如何随着自变量的变化而变化；这称为系统状态的演化。1 我们可以在自变量的不同位置取样，并近似计算每个取样点处的状态变化，从而近似描述系统状态的演化。这种近似过程称为数值积分。A differential equation is a description of how the state of a system changes as an independent variable is varied; this is called the evolution of the system's state.1 We can approximate the evolution of a system's state by sampling the independent variable at various points and approximating the state change at each sample point. This process of approximation is called numerical integration.

让我们借助一个二阶常微分方程的数值积分器，考察数值运算的通用性。我们将使用一个以均匀间隔对自变量取样的积分器，每个间隔称为一步。考虑下面这个方程：Let's investigate the generality of numerical operations in a numerical integrator for second-order ordinary differential equations. We will use an integrator that samples its independent variable at uniform intervals, each of which is called a step. Consider this equation:

其核心思想是：未知函数二阶导数的离散近似，是前面若干步二阶导数的线性组合。具体系数通过数值分析来选取，这里不作讨论。The essential idea is that a discrete approximation to the second derivative of the unknown function is a linear combination of second derivatives of some previous steps. The particular coefficients are chosen by numerical analysis and are not of interest here.

其中，h 是步长，A 是存放那些神奇系数的数组。where h is the step size and A is the array of magic coefficients.

例如，二阶 Stormer 积分器为For example, Stormer's integrator of order 2 is

为了用它计算 x 未来的值，我们编写一个程序。stormer-2 返回的过程是针对给定函数和步长的积分器；给定 x 的历史值，它会估计下一时刻 x 的值，即 x(t + h)。过程 t 和 x 从历史记录中提取先前的时刻及 x 的值：(x 0 history) 返回 x(t)，(x 1 history) 返回 x(t − h)，而 (x 2 history) 返回 x(t − 2h)。我们也用类似方式从历史记录中获取某一步的时刻：(t 1 history) 返回 t − h。To use this to compute the future of x we write a program. The procedure returned by stormer-2 is an integrator for a given function and step size, that given a history of values of x, produces an estimate of the value of x at the next time, x(t + h). The procedures t and x extract previous times and values of x from the history: (x 0 history) returns x(t), (x 1 history) returns x(t − h), and (x 2 history) returns x(t − 2h). We access the time of a step from a history similarly: (t 1 history) returns t − h.

(define (stormer-2 F h)

  (lambda (history)

    (+ (* 2 (x 0 history))

       (* -1 (x 1 history))

       (* (/ (expt h 2) 12)

          (+ (* 13 (F (t 0 history) (x 0 history)))

             (* -2 (F (t 1 history) (x 1 history)))

             (F (t 2 history) (x 2 history)))))))

stepper 返回的过程接收一份历史记录，并使用给定的积分器，将其向前推进 h，返回新的历史记录。The procedure returned by stepper takes a history and returns a new history advanced by h for the given integrator.

(define (stepper h integrator)

  (lambda (history)

    (extend-history (+ (t 0 history) h)

                    (integrator history)

                    history)))

过程 evolver 使用过程 stepper，生成一个能够把历史记录向前推进一步的过程 step。过程 evolve 使用 step 过程，将历史记录向前推进指定步数，每步的大小为 h。这里，我们显式使用专用的整数算术运算（名为 n:> 和 n:- 的过程）来计数步数。这样，其他所有计算就可以使用不同类型的算术，而不会影响简单的计数。2The procedure stepper is used in the procedure evolver to produce a procedure step that will advance a history by one step. The step procedure is used in the procedure evolve that advances the history by a given number of steps of size h. We explicitly use specialized integer arithmetic here (the procedures named n:> and n:-) for counting steps. This will allow us to use different types of arithmetic for everything else without affecting simple counting.2

(define (evolver F h make-integrator)

  (let ((integrator (make-integrator F h)))

    (let ((step (stepper h integrator)))

      (define (evolve history n-steps)

        (if (n:> n-steps 0)

            (evolve (step history) (n:- n-steps 1))

            history))

      evolve)))

像方程 3.1 这样的二阶微分方程，通常需要两个初始条件才能确定唯一的轨迹：有了 x(t0) 和 x(t0)，就足以求出所有 t 对应的 x(t)。但我们使用的 Stormer 多步积分器需要三个历史值——x(t0)、x(t0 − h) 和 x(t0 − 2h)——才能计算下一个值 x(t0 + h)。因此，要用这个积分器推进轨迹，我们必须从一份包含 x 的三个过去值的初始历史记录开始。A second-order differential equation like equation 3.1 generally needs two initial conditions to determine a unique trajectory: x(t0) and x(t0) are sufficient to get x(t) for all t. But the Stormer multistep integrator we are using requires three history values, x(t0), x(t0 − h), and x(t0 − 2h), to compute the next value x(t0 + h). So to evolve the trajectory with this integrator we must start with an initial history that has three past values of x.

考虑这个非常简单的微分方程：Consider the very simple differential equation:

按照方程 3.1 的形式，其右端为：In the form shown in equation 3.1 the right-hand side is:

(define (F t x) (- x))

由于这个方程的所有解都是正弦型函数的线性组合，我们可以用正弦函数的三个值初始化历史记录，从而得到简单的正弦函数：Because all the solutions of this equation are linear combinations of sinusoids, we can get the simple sine function by initializing the history with three values of the sine function:

(define numeric-s0

  (make-initial-history 0 .01 (sin 0) (sin -.01) (sin -.02)))

其中，过程 make-initial-history 接收以下参数：where the procedure make-initial-history takes the following arguments:

(make-initial-history t h x(t) x(t − h) x(t − 2h))

使用 Scheme 的内置算术，以步长 h = .01 推进 100 步后，我们得到 sin(1) 的一个很好的近似值：Using Scheme's built-in arithmetic, after 100 steps of size h = .01 we get a good approximation to sin(1):

(x 0 ((evolver F .01 stormer-2) numeric-s0 100))

.8414709493275624

(sin 1)

.8414709848078965

3.1.2 调整算术运算符3.1.2 Modulating arithmetic operators

让我们考虑调整加法、乘法等运算的含义，使其适用于示例程序的编写者未曾设想过的新数据类型。假设我们改变算术运算符，让它们操作并产生符号表达式，而不是数值。这对调试纯数值计算很有用，因为只要提供符号参数，我们就可以检查所得的符号表达式，确认程序确实在计算我们想要的东西。这也可以成为部分求值器的基础，用于优化数值程序。Let's consider the possibility of modulating what is meant by addition, multiplication, etc., for new data types unimagined by our example's programmer. Suppose we change our arithmetic operators to operate on and produce symbolic expressions rather than numerical values. This can be useful in debugging purely numerical calculations, because if we supply symbolic arguments we can examine the resulting symbolic expressions to make sure that the program is calculating what we intend it to. This can also be the basis of a partial evaluator for optimization of numerical programs.

下面是实现这一目标的一种方法。我们引入算术包这一概念。算术包，或简称算术系统，是从运算符名称到其运算（实现）的映射。我们可以把一个算术系统安装到用户的读取—求值—打印环境中，用该算术系统的实现替换其中所命名运算符的默认绑定。Here is one way to accomplish this goal. We introduce the idea of an arithmetic package. An arithmetic package, or just arithmetic, is a map from operator names to their operations (implementations). We can install an arithmetic in the user's read-eval-print environment to replace the default bindings of the operators named in the arithmetic with the arithmetic's implementations.

过程 make-arithmetic-1 生成一个新的算术包。它接收新算术系统的名称，以及一个运算生成过程；给定运算符名称，后者会为该运算符构造一个运算，这里就是一个处理过程。过程 make-arithmetic-1 用每个算术运算符调用这个运算生成过程，并把结果汇集成一个新的算术包。对于符号算术，每个运算都实现为一个过程：通过 cons 将运算符名称接到其参数列表的前面，从而构造符号表达式。The procedure make-arithmetic-1 generates a new arithmetic package. It takes a name for the new arithmetic, and an operation-generator procedure that given an operator name constructs an operation, here a handler procedure, for that operator. The procedure make-arithmetic-1 calls the operation-generator procedure with each arithmetic operator, accumulating the results into a new arithmetic package. For symbolic arithmetic, the operation is implemented as a procedure that creates a symbolic expression by consing the operator name onto the list of its arguments.

(define symbolic-arithmetic-1

  (make-arithmetic-1 'symbolic

    (lambda (operator)

      (lambda args (cons operator args)))))

要使用这个新定义的算术系统，我们先安装它。这会重新定义算术运算符，使其采用这个算术系统：3To use this newly defined arithmetic, we install it. This redefines the arithmetic operators to use this arithmetic:3

(install-arithmetic! symbolic-arithmetic-1)

对于该算术系统中定义的各个算术运算符，install-arithmetic! 会把用户的同名全局变量的值，改为该算术系统中相应的值。例如，完成此次安装之后：install-arithmetic! changes the values of the user's global variables that are the names of the arithmetic operators defined in the arithmetic to their values in that arithmetic. For example, after this install:

(+ ’a ’b)

(+ a b)



(+ 1 2)

(+ 1 2)

现在，我们可以观察 Stormer 演化向前推进一步的结果：4 5Now we can observe the result of taking one step of the Stormer evolution:4 5

(pp (x 0

       ((evolver F ’h stormer-2)

        (make-initial-history 't ’h ’xt ’xt-h ’xt-2h)

        1)))

(+ (+ (* 2 xt) (* -1 xt-h))

   (* (/ (expt h 2) 12)

      (+ (+ (* 13 (negate xt)) (* -2 (negate xt-h)))

         (negate xt-2h))))

只需把 symbolic-arithmetic-1 中的 cons 换成代数化简器，就能轻松生成化简后的表达式，从而得到一个符号运算系统。（我们将在第 4.2 节探索代数化简。）We could easily produce simplified expressions by replacing the cons in symbolic-arithmetic-1 with an algebraic simplifier, and then we would have a symbolic manipulator. (We will explore algebraic simplification in section 4.2.)

这一转变简单得令人难以置信，而我们的原始设计并未为符号计算做任何准备。我们同样可以轻松加入对向量算术、矩阵算术等的支持。This transformation was ridiculously easy, and yet our original design didn't make any provisions for symbolic computation. We could just as easily add support for vector arithmetic, matrix arithmetic, etc.

重新定义运算符的问题Problems with redefining operators

事后重新定义运算符的能力，既带来了极大的灵活性，也让我们能够制造出全新类别的错误！（我们预见到 evolver 过程中可能出现这样的问题，因此使用专用算术运算符 n:> 和 n:- 来计数步数，从而避开了它。）The ability to redefine operators after the fact gives both extreme flexibility and ways to make whole new classes of bugs! (We anticipated such a problem in the evolver procedure and avoided it by using the special arithmetic operators n:> and n:- for counting steps.)

还有一些更微妙的问题。依赖整数运算精确性的程序，在使用不精确的浮点数时，可能无法正确工作。这正是生物或技术系统演化所伴随的风险——有些突变会致命！另一方面，有些突变又会极有价值。但我们必须将这种风险与结构狭隘而脆弱所带来的代价进行权衡。There are more subtle problems. A program that depends on the exactness of operations on integers may not work correctly for inexact floating-point numbers. This is exactly the risk that comes with the evolution of biological or technological systems— some mutations will be fatal! On the other hand, some mutations will be extremely valuable. But that risk must be balanced against the cost of narrow and brittle construction.

事实上，当基本过程可以被重新定义时，除了证明程序在限定于其原本针对的类型时能够工作之外，我们大概无法对它证明太多其他性质。这是一条简单却危险的泛化之路。Indeed, it is probably impossible to prove very much about a program when the primitive procedures can be redefined, except that it will work when restricted to the types it was defined for. This is an easy but dangerous path for generalization.

3.1.3 组合算术系统3.1.3 Combining arithmetics

符号算术无法进行数值计算，因此，替换运算符定义破坏了我们的积分示例。我们真正希望的是让运算符的行为取决于其参数：例如，(+ 1 2) 应执行数值加法，而 (+ ’a ’b) 应构造一个列表。因此，算术包必须能够判定，哪一个处理过程适用于传入的参数。The symbolic arithmetic cannot do numerical calculation, so we have broken our integration example by replacing the operator definitions. We really want an operator's action to depend on its arguments: for example, numerical addition for (+ 1 2) but building a list for (+ ’a ’b). Thus the arithmetic packages must be able to determine which handler is appropriate for the arguments tendered.

改进的算术抽象An improved arithmetic abstraction

为每个运算附加一个适用性规范，通常简称适用性，我们就可以组合不同种类的算术。例如，我们可以把符号算术与数值算术组合起来，使组合后的运算能够判定哪种实现适用于其参数。By annotating each operation with an applicability specification, often shortened to just an applicability, we can combine different kinds of arithmetic. For example, we can combine symbolic and numeric arithmetic so that a combined operation can determine which implementation is appropriate for its arguments.

适用性规范只是一个情况列表，其中每种情况又是一个谓词列表，例如 number? 或 symbolic?。如果一系列参数满足其中一种情况，也就是说，该情况中的每个谓词对相应参数都为真，那么就认为一个过程适用于这些参数。例如，对于二元算术运算符，我们希望数值运算仅适用于 (number? number?) 这种情况，而符号运算则适用于这些情况：((number? symbolic?) (symbolic? number?) (symbolic? symbolic?))。An applicability specification is just a list of cases, each of which is a list of predicates, such as number? or symbolic?. A procedure is deemed applicable to a sequence of arguments if the arguments satisfy one of the cases—that is, if each predicate in the case is true of the corresponding argument. For example, for binary arithmetic operators, we would like the numeric operations to be applicable in just the case (number? number?) and the symbolic operations to be applicable in these cases: ((number? symbolic?) (symbolic? number?) (symbolic? symbolic?)).

我们用 make-operation 构造一个运算，其中包含处理过程的适用性，如下所示：We use make-operation to make an operation that includes an applicability for the handler procedure, like this:

(define (make-operation operator applicability procedure)

  (list ’operation operator applicability procedure))

这样就可以获取一个运算的适用性：It is then possible to get the applicability for an operation:

(define (operation-applicability operation)

  (caddr operation))

我们引入一种抽象，用来编写运算的适用性信息。过程 all-args 接收两个参数：第一个是运算接收的参数个数（即其元数，见第 26 页），第二个是对每个参数都必须为真的谓词。它返回一个适用性规范，可用来判定该运算是否适用于所提供的参数。在数值算术中，每个运算的所有参数都必须是数。We introduce an abstraction for writing applicability information for an operation. The procedure all-args takes two arguments, the first being the number of arguments that the operation accepts (its arity, as on page 26), and the second being a predicate that must be true of each argument. It returns an applicability specification that can be used to determine if the operation is applicable to the arguments supplied to it. In a numeric arithmetic, each operation takes numbers for each of its arguments.

利用 all-args，我们可以为最简单的运算实现一个运算构造器：Using all-args we can implement an operation constructor for the simplest operations:

(define (simple-operation operator predicate procedure) 

  (make-operation operator

                  (all-args (operator-arity operator)

                            predicate)

                  procedure))

拥有一个定义域谓词也会很有用：对于某个算术系统的运算所接收的参数对象（如函数或矩阵），该谓词为真，例如数值算术的 number?。为了支持这一更复杂的构想，我们将为算术包创建一个构造器 make-arithmetic。过程 make-arithmetic 类似于 make-arithmetic-1（见第 71 页），但多了几个参数。We will also find it useful to have a domain predicate that is true for the objects (such as functions or matrices) that a given arithmetic's operations take as arguments—for example, number? for numeric arithmetic. To support this more elaborate idea we will create a constructor make-arithmetic for arithmetic packages. The procedure make-arithmetic is like make-arithmetic-1 (see page 71) but has additional arguments.

(make-arithmetic  name

                  domain-predicate

                  base-arithmetic-packages

                  map-of-constant-name-to-constant

                  map-of-operator-name-to-operation)

make-arithmetic 生成的算术包有一个便于调试的名称，也有上述定义域谓词。它还有一个算术包列表，称为基础算术系统，新算术系统将基于它们构造。此外，该算术系统还包含一组具名常量，以及一组运算符及其相应运算。最后两个参数用于生成这两组内容。An arithmetic package produced by make-arithmetic has a name that is useful for debugging. It has the domain predicate noted above. It has a list of arithmetic packages, called the bases, that the new arithmetic will be built from. In addition, the arithmetic will contain a set of named constants, and a set of operators along with their corresponding operations. The final two arguments are used to generate these sets.

向量是使用基础算术系统的一个例子。向量表示为有序的坐标序列，因此，向量上的算术是根据其坐标上的算术定义的。所以，向量算术的基础算术系统，就是适用于向量坐标的算术系统。坐标为数值的向量算术，会使用数值算术作为基础；坐标为符号的向量算术，则会使用符号算术作为基础。为简便起见，我们常用“之上”来指定基础，例如“数之上的向量”或“符号之上的向量”。An example of the use of a base arithmetic is vectors. A vector is represented as an ordered sequence of coordinates: consequently an arithmetic on vectors is defined in terms of arithmetic on its coordinates. So the base arithmetic for a vector arithmetic is the appropriate arithmetic for the vector's coordinates. A vector arithmetic with numeric coordinates will use a numeric arithmetic as its base, while a vector arithmetic with symbolic coordinates will use a symbolic arithmetic as its base. For brevity, we often use the term “over” to specify the base, as in “vectors over numbers” or “vectors over symbols.”

基础算术系统还决定了派生算术系统将定义哪些常量和运算符。所定义的常量，是各基础算术系统所定义常量的并集；所定义的运算符，则是它们的运算符的并集。如果没有基础算术系统，就定义标准的常量名称集和运算符名称集。The base arithmetics also determine the constants and operators that the derived arithmetic will define. The defined constants will be the union of the constants defined by the bases, and the defined operators will be the union of their operators. If there are no bases, then standard sets of constant and operator names will be defined.

利用这些新能力，我们可以定义一个带有适用性信息的数值算术系统。由于数值算术建立在 Scheme 底层之上，对于 Scheme 数值参数，适当的运算符处理过程就是该运算符符号在 Scheme 实现中的值。此外，某些符号，例如加法和乘法的单位元常量，会进行特殊映射。Using these new capabilities, we can define a numeric arithmetic with applicability information. Since numeric arithmetic is built on the Scheme substrate, the appropriate handler for the operator for Scheme number arguments is just the value of the operator symbol for the Scheme implementation. Also, certain symbols, such as the identity constants for addition and multiplication, are specially mapped.

(define numeric-arithmetic

  (make-arithmetic ’numeric number? ’()

    (lambda (name)                ;constant generator

      (case name

        ((additive-identity) 0)

        ((multiplicative-identity) 1)

        (else (default-object))))

    (lambda (operator)            ;operation generator

      (simple-operation operator number?

         (get-implementation-value

            (operator->procedure-name operator))))))

这段代码的最后两行，会找出 Scheme 实现中由该运算符命名的过程。6The last two lines of this code find the procedure defined by the Scheme implementation that is named by the operator.6

类似地，我们可以编写 symbolic-extender 构造器，在给定算术系统的基础上构造符号算术系统。We can similarly write the symbolic-extender constructor to construct a symbolic arithmetic based on a given arithmetic.

(define (symbolic-extender base-arithmetic)

  (make-arithmetic ’symbolic symbolic? (list base-arithmetic)

    (lambda (name base-constant)        ;constant generator

      base-constant)

    (let ((base-predicate

           (arithmetic-domain-predicate base-arithmetic)))

      (lambda (operator base-operation) ;operation generator

        (make-operation operator

                        (any-arg (operator-arity operator)

                                 symbolic?

                                 base-predicate)

                        (lambda args

                          (cons operator args)))))))

它与数值算术的一个区别在于：只要有任意一个参数是符号表达式，符号算术就适用。7 这一点通过使用 any-arg 而不是 all-args 来表示；如果至少一个参数满足作为第二个参数传入的谓词，而所有其他参数都满足作为第三个参数传入的谓词，any-arg 就匹配。8 还要注意，这个符号算术系统以所提供的 base-arithmetic 为基础，因此我们可以构造出多种这样的算术系统。One difference between this and the numeric arithmetic is that the symbolic arithmetic is applicable whenever any argument is a symbolic expression.7 This is indicated by the use of any-arg rather than all-args; any-arg matches if at least one of the arguments satisfies the predicate passed as the second argument, and all the other arguments satisfy the predicate passed as the third argument.8 Also notice that this symbolic arithmetic is based on a provided base-arithmetic, which will allow us to build a variety of such arithmetics.

适用性规范不充当处理过程的防护条件：它们不会阻止处理过程被应用于错误的参数。适用性规范只在组合算术系统时使用，用来区分某个运算符可能采用的不同运算，具体如下所述。Applicability specifications are not used as guards on the handlers: they do not prevent the application of a handler to the wrong arguments. The applicability specifications are used only to distinguish among the possible operations for an operator when arithmetics are combined, as explained below.

算术系统的组合子A combinator for arithmetics

按照构造方式，符号算术与数值算术具有相同的形状。symbolic-extender 过程生成的算术系统，拥有与传给它的基础算术系统相同的运算符。为利用部件构建复合算术系统而设计一门组合子语言，可能是个好办法。The symbolic and numeric arithmetics are of the same shape, by construction. The symbolic-extender procedure produces an arithmetic with the same operators as the base arithmetic it is given. Making a combinator language for building composite arithmetics from parts might be a good approach.

下面的过程 add-arithmetics 是一个算术系统组合子。它构造一个新的算术系统，其定义域谓词是各个给定算术系统定义域谓词的析取，而其中每个运算符都映射到给定算术系统中相应运算的并集。9The procedure add-arithmetics, below, is a combinator for arithmetics. It makes a new arithmetic whose domain predicate is the disjunction of the given arithmetics’ domain predicates, and each of whose operators is mapped to the union of the operations for the given arithmetics.9

(define (add-arithmetics . arithmetics)

  (add-arithmetics* arithmetics))



(define (add-arithmetics* arithmetics)

  (if (n:null? (cdr arithmetics))

      (car arithmetics)  ;only one arithmetic

      (make-arithmetic ’add

                       (disjoin*

                        (map arithmetic-domain-predicate

                             arithmetics))

                       arithmetics

                       constant-union

                       operation-union)))

make-arithmetic 的第三个参数是待组合的算术包列表。这些算术包必须相互兼容，即为相同名称的运算符指定运算。第四个参数是 constant-union，用于组合多个常量。这里，它选择参数中的一个常量，用于组合后的算术系统；稍后我们会对此加以扩充。10The third argument to make-arithmetic is a list of the arithmetic packages being combined. The arithmetic packages must be compatible in that they specify operations for the same named operators. The fourth argument is constant-union, which combines multiple constants. Here this selects one of the argument constants for use in the combined arithmetic; later we will elaborate on this.10

(define (constant-union name . constants)

  (let ((unique

         (remove default-object?

                 (delete-duplicates constants eqv?))))

    (if (n:pair? unique)

        (car unique)

        (default-object))))

最后一个参数是 operation-union，它为结果算术系统中的具名运算符构造运算。只要一个运算在被组合的任一算术系统中适用，它就适用。The last argument is operation-union, which constructs the operation for the named operator in the resulting arithmetic. An operation is applicable if it is applicable in any of the arithmetics that were combined.

(define (operation-union operator . operations)

  (operation-union* operator operations))



(define (operation-union* operator operations)

  (make-operation operator

                  (applicability-union*

                   (map operation-applicability operations))

                  (lambda args

                    (operation-union-dispatch operator

                                              operations

                                              args))))

过程 operation-union-dispatch 必须根据所提供的参数确定要使用哪个运算。它从给定算术系统中选出适用于给定参数的运算，再将其应用于这些参数。如果不止一个给定算术系统具有适用的运算，就选择 add-arithmetics 的参数中排在最前面的算术系统里的运算。The procedure operation-union-dispatch must determine the operation to use based on the arguments supplied. It chooses the operation from the given arithmetics that is appropriate to the given arguments and applies it to the arguments. If more than one of the given arithmetics has an applicable operation, the operation from the first arithmetic in the arguments to add-arithmetics is chosen.

(define (operation-union-dispatch operator operations args)

  (let ((operation

         (find (lambda (operation)

                 (is-operation-applicable? operation args))

               operations)))

    (if (not operation)

        (error "Inapplicable operation:" operator args))

    (apply-operation operation args)))

一种常见模式，是把基础算术系统与作用于该系统的扩展器组合起来。将数值算术与基于数值算术构造的符号算术组合起来，就是这样的例子。因此，我们为这一模式提供一个抽象：A common pattern is to combine a base arithmetic with an extender on that arithmetic. The combination of numeric arithmetic and a symbolic arithmetic built on numeric arithmetic is such a case. So we provide an abstraction for that pattern:

(define (extend-arithmetic extender base-arithmetic)

  (add-arithmetics base-arithmetic

                   (extender base-arithmetic)))

我们可以使用 extend-arithmetic 将数值算术与符号算术组合起来。由于适用情况互不相交——数值算术要求全部是数，而符号算术要求至少有一个符号表达式——因此，除可能的性能问题之外，add-arithmetics 的参数顺序在这里无关紧要。We can use extend-arithmetic to combine the numeric arithmetic and the symbolic arithmetic. Since the applicability cases are disjoint—all numbers for numeric arithmetic and at least one symbolic expression for symbolic arithmetic—the order of arguments to add-arithmetics is irrelevant here, except for possible performance issues.

(define combined-arithmetic

  (extend-arithmetic symbolic-extender numeric-arithmetic))



(install-arithmetic! combined-arithmetic)

让我们试试这个复合算术系统：Let's try the composite arithmetic:

(+ 1 2)

3



(+ 1 ’a)

(+ 1 a)



(+ ’a 2)

(+ a 2)



(+ ’a ’b)

(+ a b)

积分器仍然能够进行数值计算（比较第 70 页）：The integrator still works numerically (compare page 70):

(define numeric-s0

  (make-initial-history 0 .01 (sin 0) (sin -.01) (sin -.02)))



(x 0 ((evolver F .01 stormer-2) numeric-s0 100))

.8414709493275624

它也能够进行符号计算（比较第 72 页）：It works symbolically (compare page 72):

(pp (x 0

       ((evolver F ’h stormer-2)

        (make-initial-history 't ’h ’xt ’xt-h ’xt-2h)

        1)))

(+ (+ (* 2 xt) (* -1 xt-h))

   (* (/ (expt h 2) 12)

      (+ (+ (* 13 (negate xt)) (* -2 (negate xt-h)))

         (negate xt-2h))))

而且，它还能混合计算，使用数值历史记录和符号步长 h：And it works in combination, with numeric history but symbolic step size h:

(pp (x 0 ((evolver F ’h stormer-2) numeric-s0 1)))

(+ 9.999833334166664e-3

   (* (/ (expt h 2) 12)

      -9.999750002487318e-7))

请注意这里的强大之处。我们将能够进行符号算术的代码与能够进行数值算术的代码组合起来，创建了一个能够进行同时依赖这两种能力的算术运算的系统。这并不只是两种能力的并集，而是两种机制相互协作，解决任何一种机制单独都无法解决的问题。Notice the power here. We have combined code that can do symbolic arithmetic and code that can do numeric arithmetic. We have created a system that can do arithmetic that depends on both abilities. This is not just the union of the two abilities— it is the cooperation of two mechanisms to solve a problem that neither could solve by itself.

3.1.4 函数上的算术3.1.4 Arithmetic on functions

传统数学将数值量上的算术扩展到许多其他种类的对象。几个世纪以来，“算术”已被扩展到复数、向量、线性变换及其矩阵表示等。扩展到函数是一个尤其富有启发性的例子。我们可以使用算术运算符组合相同类型的函数：Traditional mathematics extends arithmetic on numerical quantities to many other kinds of objects. Over the centuries “arithmetic” has been extended to complex numbers, vectors, linear transformations and their representations as matrices, etc. One particularly revealing extension is to functions. We can combine functions of the same type using arithmetic operators:

(f + g)(x) = f (x) + g(x)

(f − g)(x) = f (x) − g(x)

(fg)(x) = f (x)g(x)(fg)(x) = f (x)g(x)

(f/g)(x) = f (x)/g(x)

⋮

参与组合的函数必须具有相同的定义域和值域，并且必须在值域上定义算术运算。The functions that are combined must have the same domain and codomain, and an arithmetic must be defined on the codomain.

扩展到函数并不困难。假定函数以过程实现，那么，只要给定我们希望组合的函数的值域上的算术包，就可以构造一个实现函数算术的算术包。The extension to functions is not hard. Given an arithmetic package for the codomain of the functions that we wish to combine, we can make an arithmetic package that implements the function arithmetic, assuming that functions are implemented as procedures.

(define (pure-function-extender codomain-arithmetic)

  (make-arithmetic ’pure-function function?

                   (list codomain-arithmetic)

    (lambda (name codomain-constant)    ; *** see below

      (lambda args codomain-constant))

    (lambda (operator codomain-operation)

      (simple-operation operator function?

        (lambda functions

          (lambda args

            (apply-operation codomain-operation

                             (map (lambda (function)

                                    (apply function args))

                                  functions))))))))

注意，常量生成器（标有注释 ***）必须为值域中的每个常量生成一个常函数。例如，函数的加法单位元必须是一个能够接收任意个参数、并返回值域加法单位元的函数。把函数算术与作用于值域的算术组合起来，就能得到一个有用的包：Notice that the constant generator (with comment ***) must produce a constant function for each codomain constant. For example, the additive identity for functions must be the function of any number of arguments that returns the codomain additive identity. Combining a functional arithmetic with the arithmetic that operates on the codomains makes a useful package:

(install-arithmetic!

  (extend-arithmetic pure-function-extender

                     numeric-arithmetic))



((+ cos sin) 3)

-.8488724885405782



(+ (cos 3) (sin 3))

-.8488724885405782

基于 combined-arithmetic 来构建，我们可以得到更有趣的结果：By building on combined-arithmetic we can get more interesting results:

(install-arithmetic!

  (extend-arithmetic pure-function-extender

                     combined-arithmetic))

((+ cos sin) 3)

-.8488724885405782



((+ cos sin) ’a)

(+ (cos a) (sin a))



(* ’b ((+ cos sin) (+ (+ 1 2) ’a)))

(* b (+ (cos (+ 3 a)) (sin (+ 3 a))))

数学传统还允许把数值量与函数混合使用，方法是把数值量视为常函数，其类型与将要同它组合的函数相同。The mathematical tradition also allows one to mix numerical quantities with functions by treating the numerical quantities as constant functions of the same type as the functions they will be combined with.

只需对过程 pure-function-extender 稍作修改，就可以很容易地实现把数值量强制转换为常函数：We can implement the coercion of numerical quantities to constant functions quite easily, by minor modifications to the procedure pure-function-extender:

(define (function-extender codomain-arithmetic)

  (let ((codomain-predicate

         (arithmetic-domain-predicate codomain-arithmetic)))

    (make-arithmetic ’function

                     (disjoin codomain-predicate function?)

                     (list codomain-arithmetic)

      (lambda (name codomain-constant)

        codomain-constant)

      (lambda (operator codomain-operation)

        (make-operation operator

                        (any-arg (operator-arity operator)

                                 function?

                                 codomain-predicate)

          (lambda things

            (lambda args

              (apply-operation codomain-operation

                 (map (lambda (thing)

                        ;; here is the coercion:

                        (if (function? thing)

                            (apply thing args)

                            thing))

                      things)))))))))

为了允许将数等值域中的量强制转换为常函数，新的函数算术的定义域必须同时包含函数，以及函数值域中的元素（即函数可能的取值）。只要任何一个参数是函数，运算符实现就适用；其中的函数会应用于所给的参数。注意，make-arithmetic 的常量生成器不再需要把值域常量改写为函数，因为现在可以直接使用这些常量。To allow the coercion of codomain quantities, such as numbers, to constant functions, the domain of the new function arithmetic must contain both the functions and the elements of the codomain of the functions (the possible values of the functions). The operator implementation is applicable if any of the arguments is a function; and functions are applied to the arguments that are given. Note that the constant generator for the make-arithmetic doesn't need to rewrite the codomain constants as functions, since the constants can now be used directly.

有了这个版本，我们就可以With this version we can

(install-arithmetic!

  (extend-arithmetic function-extender combined-arithmetic))



((+ 1 cos) ’a)

(+ 1 (cos a))



(* ’b ((+ 4 cos sin) (+ (+ 1 2) ’a)))

(* b (+ 4 (cos (+ 3 a)) (sin (+ 3 a))))

这引出了一个有趣的问题：我们有 a 和 b 这样的符号来表示字面数，却没有东西来表示字面函数。例如，如果我们写This raises an interesting problem: we have symbols, such as a and b, that represent literal numbers, but nothing to represent literal functions. For example, if we write

(* ’b ((+ ’c cos sin) (+ 3 ’a)))

我们的算术系统就会把 c 视为字面数。但我们可能希望 c 是一个字面函数，并作为函数参与组合。当前设计很难做到这一点，因为 c 不携带类型信息，而上下文也不足以区分这些用法。our arithmetic will treat c as a literal number. But we might wish to have c be a literal function that combines as a function. It's difficult to do this with our current design, because c carries no type information, and the context is insufficient to distinguish usages.

不过，我们可以构造一个除了名称之外没有任何性质的字面函数。这样的函数只需把自己的名称接到参数列表的前面。But we can make a literal function that has no properties except for a name. Such a function just attaches its name to the list of its arguments.

(define (literal-function name)

  (lambda args

    (cons name args)))

有了这个定义，字面函数 c 就可以正确地与其他函数组合：With this definition we can have a literal function c correctly combine with other functions:

(* ’b ((+ (literal-function ’c) cos sin) (+ (+ 1 2) ’a)))

(* b (+ (+ (c (+ 3 a)) (cos (+ 3 a))) (sin (+ 3 a))))

这是一个适用范围较窄的解决方案，但它处理了一种有用的情况。This is a narrow solution that handles a useful case.

3.1.5 组合子的问题3.1.5 Problems with combinators

到目前为止，我们逐步构造的算术结构，是通过组合子将简单结构组合成复杂结构的一个例子。但使用组合子构建这个系统存在一些严重缺点。首先，结构的某些性质由组合手段决定。例如，我们指出过，add-arithmetics 会为其参数赋予优先次序，因此参数顺序可能影响结果。其次，这个设计隐含着分层：必须先构造值域算术，才能构造函数算术；这意味着函数算术一旦构造完成，就不可能再扩充值域算术。最后，我们可能希望定义一种算术，处理那些返回函数的函数。在这个框架内，若不引入另一种自引用机制，就无法以一般的方式做到这一点，而安排自引用又很繁琐。The arithmetic structures we have been building up to now are an example of the use of combinators to build complex structures by combining simpler ones. But there are some serious drawbacks to building this system using combinators. First, some properties of the structure are determined by the means of combination. For example, we pointed out that add-arithmetics prioritized its arguments, such that their order can matter. Second, the layering implicit in this design, such that the codomain arithmetic must be constructed prior to the function arithmetic, means that it's impossible to augment the codomain arithmetic after the function arithmetic has been constructed. Finally, we might wish to define an arithmetic for functions that return functions. This cannot be done in a general way within this framework, without introducing another mechanism for self reference, and self reference is cumbersome to arrange.

组合子强大而有用，但由组合子构建的系统并不十分灵活。一个问题是，必须事先确定各部件的形状：能够获得的通用性取决于对各部件形状的详细规划，而且必须有一个集中明确的部件组合方案。对于算术这样已经得到充分理解的领域，这不成问题，但它不适合开放式构建。在Combinators are powerful and useful, but a system built of combinators is not very flexible. One problem is that the shapes of the parts must be worked out ahead of time: the generality that will be available depends on the detailed plan for the shapes of the parts, and there must be a localized plan for how the parts are combined. This is not a problem for a well-understood domain, such as arithmetic, but it is not appropriate for open-ended construction. In 第 3.2 节section 3.2中，我们将看到如何逐步加入新种类的算术，而无须决定它们在层次结构中的位置，也无须修改那些已经能够工作的现有部件。 we will see how to add new kinds of arithmetic incrementally, without having to decide where they go in a hierarchy, and without having to change the existing parts that already work.

组合子的另一个问题是，组合子系统中任何部件的行为都必须独立于其上下文。对设计者而言，一个强大的灵活性来源，就是构建确实依赖上下文的系统。通过改变系统的上下文，我们可以获得不同的行为。这相当危险，因为某种变化将如何表现可能很难预测。不过，经过谨慎控制的变化是有用的。Other problems with combinators are that the behavior of any part of a combinator system must be independent of its context. A powerful source of flexibility that is available to a designer is to build systems that do depend upon their context. By varying the context of a system we can obtain variation of the behavior. This is quite dangerous, because it may be hard to predict how a variation will behave. However, carefully controlled variations can be useful.

练习 3.1：用布尔算术热身Exercise 3.1: Warmup with boolean arithmetic

在数字电路设计中，布尔运算 and、or 和 not 分别用运算符 *、+ 和 - 表示。In digital design the boolean operations and, or, and not are written with the operators *, +, and -, respectively.

Scheme 中有一个谓词 boolean?，它仅对 #t 和 #f 为真。利用它构造一个布尔算术包，使其能与我们已有的算术系统组合。注意，所有其他算术运算符对布尔值都没有定义，因此，把 cos 之类的运算应用于布尔值时，恰当的结果应是报告错误。There is a Scheme predicate boolean? that is true only of #t and #f. Use this to make a boolean arithmetic package that can be combined with the arithmetics we have. Note that all other arithmetic operators are undefined for booleans, so the appropriate result of applying something like cos to a boolean is to report an error.

下面的模板可以帮助你起步：The following template could help get you started:

(define boolean-arithmetic

  (make-arithmetic ’boolean boolean? ’()

    (lambda (name)

      (case name

        ((additive-identity) #f)

        ((multiplicative-identity) #t)

        (else (default-object))))

    (lambda (operator)

      (let ((procedure

             (case operator

               ((+) <...>)

               ((-) <...>)

               ((*) <...>)

               ((negate) <...>)

               (else

                (lambda args

                  (error "Operator undefined in Boolean"

                         operator))))))

        (simple-operation operator boolean? procedure)))))

在数字电路设计中，运算符 - 通常只用作一元运算符，并以 negate 实现。安装算术系统时，二元运算符 +、*、- 和 / 会被推广为 n 元运算符。In digital design the operator - is typically used only as a unary operator and is realized as negate. When an arithmetic is installed, the binary operators +, *, -, and / are generalized to be n-ary operators.

安装器会把一元应用 (- operand) 转换成 (negate operand)。因此，要让 - 正常工作，你需要为运算符 negate 定义一元布尔运算。The unary application (- operand) is transformed by the installer into (negate operand). Thus to make - work, you will need to define the unary boolean operation for the operator negate.

练习 3.2：向量算术Exercise 3.2: Vector arithmetic

我们将构造并安装一个几何向量的算术包。这是一项较大的作业，会暴露出迄今为止我们所开发系统的许多困难和不足。We will make and install an arithmetic package on geometric vectors. This is a big assignment that will bring to the surface many of the difficulties and inadequacies of the system we have developed so far.

  1. a. 我们将用由数值量组成的 Scheme vector 来表示向量。向量的元素是相对于某组笛卡尔坐标轴的坐标。这里有几个问题。加法（以及减法）只对维数相同的向量有定义，因此你的算术系统必须了解维数。首先，以适用于向量坐标的运算构成的算术系统为基础，构造一个仅定义向量加法、取负和减法的算术系统。对向量应用任何其他运算都应报告错误。提示：以下过程会有所帮助：a. We will represent a vector as a Scheme vector of numerical quantities. The elements of a vector are coordinates relative to some Cartesian axes. There are a few issues here. Addition (and subtraction) is defined only for vectors of the same dimension, so your arithmetic must know about dimensions. First, make an arithmetic that defines only addition, negation, and subtraction of vectors over a base arithmetic of operations applicable to the coordinates of vectors. Applying any other operation to a vector should report an error. Hint: The following procedures will be helpful:

(define (vector-element-wise element-procedure)

  (lambda vecs    ; Note: this takes multiple vectors

    (ensure-vector-lengths-match vecs)

    (apply vector-map element-procedure vecs)))



(define (ensure-vector-lengths-match vecs)

  (let ((first-vec-length (vector-length (car vecs))))

    (if (any (lambda (v)

               (not (n:= (vector-length v)

                         first-vec-length)))

             vecs)

        (error "Vector dimension mismatch:" vecs))))

这里对 apply 的使用颇为微妙。理解它的一种方法，是设想语言支持如下这样的省略号：The use of apply here is subtle. One way to think about it is to imagine that the language supported an ellipsis like this:

(define (vector-element-wise element-procedure)

  (lambda (v1 v2 ...)

    (vector-map element-procedure v1 v2 ...)))

构建所要求的算术系统，并证明它既适用于数值向量，也适用于坐标混合使用数值和符号的向量。Build the required arithmetic and show that it works for numerical vectors and for vectors with mixed numerical and symbolic coordinates.

  1. b. 你的向量加法需要对坐标做加法。坐标加法过程可以是 install-arithmetic! 将在用户环境中提供的 + 运算符的值，也可以是向量扩展的基础算术系统中的加法运算。这两种做法都能通过许多测试，而且使用已安装的加法实际上可能更通用。你采用了哪一种？展示另一种选择的实现方式。这一选择如何影响你日后扩展这个系统的能力？说明你的理由。b. Your vector addition required addition of the coordinates. The coordinate addition procedure could be the value of the + operator that will be made available in the user environment by install-arithmetic!, or it could be the addition operation from the base arithmetic of your vector extension. Either of these would satisfy many tests, and using the installed addition may actually be more general. Which did you use? Show how to implement the other choice. How does this choice affect your ability to make future extensions to this system? Explain your reasoning.

提示：控制一个过程中运算符解释方式的一种好办法，是把每个运算符要使用的过程作为参数，传给一个“生成器过程”，由它返回所需的过程。例如，要控制 vector-magnitude 中使用的算术运算，可以写：Hint: A nice way to control the interpretation of operators in a procedure is to provide the procedure to use for each operator as arguments to a “maker procedure” that returns the procedure needed. For example, to control the arithmetic operations used in vector-magnitude one might write:

(define (vector-magnitude-maker + * sqrt)

  (let ((dot-product (dot-product-maker + *)))

    (define (vector-magnitude v)

      (sqrt (dot-product v v)))

    vector-magnitude))
  1. c. 乘法该怎么处理？首先，对于两个向量，把乘法定义为它们的点积是合理的。但这里有一个小问题。你需要同时使用加法和乘法运算，它们或许来自坐标上的算术系统。这并不难解决。修改你的向量算术，把两个向量的乘法定义为它们的点积。证明你的点积运算能够正常工作。c. What shall we do about multiplication? First, for two vectors it is reasonable to define multiplication to be their dot product. But there is a bit of a problem here. You need to be able to use both the addition and multiplication operations, perhaps from the arithmetic on the coordinates. This is not hard to solve. Modify your vector arithmetic to define multiplication of two vectors as their dot product. Show that your dot product works.
  2. d. 为你的向量算术加入向量模长，将数值运算符 magnitude 扩展为能够给出向量的长度。上面提供的代码已经完成了大部分工作！d. Add vector magnitude to your vector arithmetic, extending the numerical operator magnitude to give the length of a vector. The code given above is most of the work!
  3. e. 向量乘以标量，或标量乘以向量，都应产生标量乘法的结果（即每个坐标都乘以该标量的向量）。所以，根据参数类型的不同，乘法可以表示点积，也可以表示标量乘法。修改你的向量算术，实现这一点。证明你的向量算术既能处理点积，也能处理标量乘法。提示：第 78 页的 operation-union 过程可以让这个问题得到非常优雅的解决。e. Multiplication of a vector by a scalar or multiplication of a scalar by a vector should produce the scalar product (the vector with each coordinate multiplied by the scalar). So multiplication can mean either dot product or scalar product, depending on the types of its arguments. Modify your vector arithmetic to make this work. Show that your vector arithmetic can handle both dot product and scalar product. Hint: The operation-union procedure on page 78 enables a very elegant way to solve this problem.

练习 3.3：扩展的顺序Exercise 3.3: Ordering of extensions

考虑将你的向量扩展（练习 3.2）与现有算术系统组合的两种可能顺序：Consider two possible orderings for combining your vector extension (exercise 3.2) with the existing arithmetics:

(define vec-before-func

 (extend-arithmetic

  function-extender

  (extend-arithmetic vector-extender combined-arithmetic)))



(define func-before-vec

 (extend-arithmetic

  vector-extender

  (extend-arithmetic function-extender combined-arithmetic)))

扩展的顺序如何影响所得算术系统的性质？下面的过程构造单位圆上的点：How does the ordering of extensions affect the properties of the resulting arithmetic? The following procedure makes points on the unit circle:

(define (unit-circle x)

  (vector (sin x) (cos x)))

如果分别在安装 vec-before-func 和 func-before-vec 后得到的环境中，执行以下各个表达式：If we execute each of the following expressions in environments resulting from installing vec-before-func and func-before-vec:

((magnitude unit-circle) ’a)



((magnitude (vector sin cos)) ’a)

结果（未经化简）应为：The result (unsimplified) should be:

(sqrt (+ (* (sin a) (sin a)) (* (cos a) (cos a))))

然而，这两个表达式各自都会在两种扩展顺序之一的情况下失败。能否构造一个算术系统，让两者都能正确求值？请解释。However, each of these expressions fails with one of the two orderings of the extensions. Is it possible to make an arithmetic for which both evaluate correctly? Explain.

3.2 可扩展的泛型过程3.2 Extensible generic procedures

像Systems built by combinators, as in 第 3.1 节section 3.1那样通过组合子构建的系统，会成为美丽的钻石般的系统。有时候，这正是正确的思路，我们还会再次遇到它，但要给钻石添东西非常困难。如果把系统构建成一团泥，那么再添些泥就很容易了。11, result in beautiful diamond-like systems. This is sometimes the right idea, and we will see it arise again, but it is very hard to add to a diamond. If a system is built as a ball of mud, it is easy to add more mud.11

组织这团泥的一种方式，是把系统建立在可扩展泛型过程的底层基础之上。Lisp、Scheme 和 Python 等现代动态类型编程语言，通常都提供内置算术，能够泛型地处理整数、浮点数、有理数、复数等多种数值量 [115, 64, 105]。但建立在这些语言之上的系统，通常并不容易在事后扩展。One organization for a ball of mud is a system erected on a substrate of extensible generic procedures. Modern dynamically typed programming languages, such as Lisp, Scheme, and Python, usually have built-in arithmetic that is generic over a variety of types of numerical quantities, such as integers, floats, rationals, and complex numbers [115, 64, 105]. But systems built on these languages are usually not easily extensible after the fact.

我们在The problems we indicated in 第 3.1.5 节section 3.1.5指出的问题，是使用组合子 add-arithmetics 的结果。为了解决这些问题，我们将放弃这个组合子。不过，算术包抽象和扩展器的思想仍然有用。我们将构建一个算术包，其运算使用能够动态增添新行为的泛型过程。随后，我们就可以扩展泛型算术，并将这些扩展加入泛型算术中。12 are the result of using the combinator add-arithmetics. To solve these problems we will abandon that combinator. However, the arithmetic package abstraction is still useful, as is the idea of an extender. We will build an arithmetic package in which the operations use generic procedures that can be dynamically augmented with new behavior. We can then extend the generic arithmetic and add the extensions to the generic arithmetic.12

我们将从实现泛型过程开始。这类过程在定义之后，还可以通过添加处理过程来进行动态扩展。一个泛型过程由一个分派器与一组规则组合而成，每条规则描述一个适用于给定参数集合的处理过程。这样的规则把处理过程与其适用性结合在一起。We will start by implementing generic procedures, which are procedures that can be dynamically extended by adding handlers after the generic procedures are defined. A generic procedure is a dispatcher combined with a set of rules, each of which describes a handler that is appropriate for a given set of arguments. Such a rule combines a handler with its applicability.

让我们定义一个名为 plus 的泛型过程，使其像加法一样处理数值量和符号量，借此考察这种机制如何工作：Let's examine how this might work, by defining a generic procedure named plus that works like addition with numeric and symbolic quantities:

(define plus (simple-generic-procedure ’plus 2 #f))



(define-generic-procedure-handler plus

  (all-args 2 number?)

  (lambda (a b) (+ a b)))



(define-generic-procedure-handler plus

  (any-arg 2 symbolic? number?)

  (lambda (a b) (list ’+ a b)))



(plus 1 2)

3



(plus 1 ’a)

(+ 1 a)



(plus ’a 2)

(+ a 2)



(plus ’a ’b)

(+ a b)

过程 simple-generic-procedure 接收三个参数。第一个是任意名称，用于在调试时标识该过程；第二个是过程的元数。第三个参数用于提供默认处理过程；如果未提供（以 #f 表示），那么在没有任何特定处理过程适用时，就会发出错误信号。这里，plus 绑定到 simple-generic-procedure 返回的新泛型过程。它是一个 Scheme 过程，可以用指定个数的参数调用。The procedure simple-generic-procedure takes three arguments: The first is an arbitrary name to identify the procedure when debugging; the second is the procedure's arity. The third argument is used to provide a default handler; if none is supplied (indicated by #f), then if no specific handler is applicable an error is signaled. Here plus is bound to the new generic procedure returned by simple-generic-procedure. It is a Scheme procedure that can be called with the specified number of arguments.

过程 define-generic-procedure-handler 为现有泛型过程添加一条规则。第一个参数是要扩展的泛型过程；第二个参数是待添加规则的适用性规范（见第 73 页）；第三个参数是处理满足该规范的参数的处理过程。The procedure define-generic-procedure-handler adds a rule to an existing generic procedure. Its first argument is the generic procedure to be extended; the second argument is an applicability specification (as on page 73) for the rule being added; and the third argument is the handler for arguments that satisfy that specification.

(define-generic-procedure-handler generic-procedure

                                  applicability

                                  handler-procedure)

我们经常需要指定一条规则，其中不同参数具有不同类型。例如，要构造一个向量算术包，就需要指定 * 运算符的解释方式。如果两个参数都是向量，恰当的处理过程会计算点积。如果一个参数是标量，另一个是向量，那么恰当的处理过程会用该标量缩放向量的各个元素。适用性参数正是实现这一点的手段。It is often necessary to specify a rule in which different arguments are of different types. For example, to make a vector arithmetic package we need to specify the interpretation of the * operator. If both arguments are vectors, the appropriate handler computes the dot product. If one argument is a scalar and the other is a vector, then the appropriate handler scales the vector elements by the scalar. The applicability argument is the means by which this is accomplished.

我们在上面用来构造泛型过程 plus 的 simple-generic-procedure 构造器，是用过程 generic-procedure-constructor 创建的The simple-generic-procedure constructor we used above to make the generic procedure plus is created with the procedure generic-procedure-constructor

(define simple-generic-procedure

  (generic-procedure-constructor make-simple-dispatch-store))

其中，make-simple-dispatch-store 是一个封装了保存、检索和选择处理过程策略的过程。where make-simple-dispatch-store is a procedure that encapsulates a strategy for saving, retrieving, and choosing a handler.

generic-procedure-constructor 接收一个分派存储构造器，并生成一个泛型过程构造器；后者本身接收三个参数——便于调试的名称、元数，以及在没有适用处理过程时使用的默认处理过程。如果默认处理过程参数为 #f，则默认处理过程会发出错误信号：The generic-procedure-constructor takes a dispatch-store constructor and produces a generic-procedure constructor that itself takes three arguments—a name that is useful in debugging, an arity, and a default handler to be used if there are no applicable handlers. If the default handler argument is #f, the default handler signals an error:

((generic-procedure-constructor dispatch-store-constructor)

 name

 arity

 default-handler)

之所以用这种方式构造泛型过程，是因为我们将需要一系列泛型过程，它们的区别在于分派存储的选择。The reason why generic procedures are made in this way is that we will need families of generic procedures that differ in the choice of dispatch store.

在In 第 3.2.3 节section 3.2.3中，我们将看到实现这一机制的一种方法。但首先，让我们看看如何使用它。, we will see one way to implement this mechanism. But first let's see how to use it.

3.2.1 泛型算术3.2.1 Generic arithmetic

我们可以利用这个新的泛型过程机制构建算术包，其中运算符映射到以泛型过程实现的运算。这将使我们能够构造自引用结构。例如，我们可能希望构造一个包含向量算术的泛型算术系统，其中向量及向量的分量都由同一组泛型过程来操作。仅使用前面引入的 add-arithmetics，我们无法构建这样的结构。We can use this new generic-procedure mechanism to build arithmetic packages in which the operators map to operations that are implemented as generic procedures. This will allow us to make self-referential structures. For example, we might want to make a generic arithmetic that includes vector arithmetic where both the vectors and the components of a vector are manipulated by the same generic procedures. We could not build such a structure using just add-arithmetics introduced earlier.

(define (make-generic-arithmetic dispatch-store-maker)

  (make-arithmetic ’generic any-object? ’()

    constant-union

    (let ((make-generic-procedure

           (generic-procedure-constructor

            dispatch-store-maker)))

      (lambda (operator)

        (simple-operation operator

                any-object?

                (make-generic-procedure

                 operator

                 (operator-arity operator)

                 #f))))))

make-generic-arithmetic 过程创建一个新的算术系统。对于每个算术运算符，它都构造一个适用于任何参数、并由泛型过程实现的运算。（谓词 any-object? 对任何对象都为真。）我们可以用通常的方式安装这个算术系统。The make-generic-arithmetic procedure creates a new arithmetic. For each arithmetic operator, it constructs an operation that is applicable to any arguments and is implemented by a generic procedure. (The predicate any-object? is true of anything.) We can install this arithmetic in the usual way.

但首先，让我们为这些泛型过程定义一些处理过程。现在我们有了泛型算术对象，做这件事相当简单。例如，我们可以从任何已经构造好的算术系统中取出运算和常量。But first, let's define some handlers for the generic procedures. It's pretty simple to do now that we have the generic arithmetic object. For example, we can grab the operations and constants from any already-constructed arithmetic.

(define (add-to-generic-arithmetic! generic-arithmetic

                                    arithmetic)

  (add-generic-arith-constants! generic-arithmetic

                                arithmetic)

  (add-generic-arith-operations! generic-arithmetic

                                 arithmetic))

这个过程接收一个泛型算术包，以及一个拥有相同运算符的普通算术包。它使用 constant-union 将常量并入泛型算术。对于给定算术系统的每个运算符，它都会为相应的泛型过程添加一个处理过程。This takes a generic arithmetic package and an ordinary arithmetic package with the same operators. It merges constants into the generic arithmetic using constant-union. And for each operator of the given arithmetic it adds a handler to the corresponding generic procedure.

为某个特定运算符添加处理过程时，使用标准的泛型过程机制，从算术系统的运算中提取所需的适用性和过程。Adding a handler for a particular operator uses the standard generic procedure mechanism, extracting the necessary applicability and procedure from the arithmetic's operation.

(define (add-generic-arith-operations! generic-arithmetic

                                       arithmetic)

  (for-each

   (lambda (operator)

     (let ((generic-procedure

            (simple-operation-procedure

             (arithmetic-operation operator

                                   generic-arithmetic)))

           (operation

            (arithmetic-operation operator arithmetic)))

       (define-generic-procedure-handler

           generic-procedure

           (operation-applicability operation)

           (operation-procedure operation))))

   (arithmetic-operators arithmetic)))

对于给定算术系统中的每个运算符，add-generic-arith-operations! 过程会找出需要扩充的泛型过程。然后，它使用给定算术系统中相应处理过程的适用性，为该泛型过程定义一个处理过程，这就是该运算符在给定算术系统中的处理过程。The add-generic-arith-operations! procedure finds, for each operator in the given arithmetic, the generic procedure that must be augmented. It then defines a handler for that generic procedure that is the handler for that operator in the given arithmetic, using the applicability for that handler in the given arithmetic.

将某个算术系统的常量加入泛型算术的代码与此类似。对于泛型算术中的每个常量名，它会在泛型算术的名称—常量值关联表中找到相应条目。然后，用现有常量与从给定算术系统中获取的同名常量的 constant-union 结果，替换该常量值。The code for adding the constants from an arithmetic to the generic arithmetic is similar. For each constant name in the generic arithmetic it finds the entry in the association of names to constant values in the generic arithmetic. It then replaces the constant value with the constant-union of the existing constant and the constant it got for that same name from the given arithmetic.

(define (add-generic-arith-constants! generic-arithmetic

                                      arithmetic)

  (for-each

   (lambda (name)

     (let ((binding

            (arithmetic-constant-binding name

                                         generic-arithmetic))

           (element

            (find-arithmetic-constant name arithmetic)))

       (set-cdr! binding

                 (constant-union name

                                 (cdr binding)

                                 element))))

   (arithmetic-constant-names generic-arithmetic)))

泛型算术的乐趣Fun with generic arithmetics

我们可以给泛型算术加入许多算术系统，使其呈现有趣的行为：We can add many arithmetics to a generic arithmetic to give it interesting behavior:

(let ((g

       (make-generic-arithmetic make-simple-dispatch-store)))

  (add-to-generic-arithmetic! g numeric-arithmetic)

  (add-to-generic-arithmetic! g

    (function-extender numeric-arithmetic))

  (add-to-generic-arithmetic! g

    (symbolic-extender numeric-arithmetic))

  (install-arithmetic! g))

这样得到的泛型算术，将数值算术、数值算术之上的符号算术，以及数值算术之上的函数算术组合在一起：This produces a generic arithmetic that combines numeric arithmetic with symbolic arithmetic over numeric arithmetic and function arithmetic over numeric arithmetic:

(+ 1 3 ’a ’b)

(+ (+ 4 a) b)

我们甚至还能运行一些更复杂的问题，如第 79 页所示：And we can even run some more complex problems, as on page 79:

(pp (x 0 ((evolver F ’h stormer-2) numeric-s0 1)))

(+ 9.999833334166664e-3

   (* (/ (expt h 2) 12)

      -9.999750002487318e-7))

和以前一样，我们可以混合使用符号与函数：As before, we can mix symbols and functions:

(* ’b ((+ cos sin) 3))

(* b -.8488724885405782)

但下面的表达式会发出错误信号，因为它试图把符号量 (cos a) 和 (sin a) 当作数来相加：but the following will signal an error, trying to add the symbolic quantities (cos a) and (sin a) as numbers:

(* ’b ((+ cos sin) ’a))

出现这个错误，是因为 cos 和 sin 都像 + 一样，是数值运算符。由于我们有建立在数值算术之上的符号算术，这些运算符得到扩展，对于符号输入（这里是 a），会产生符号输出 (cos a) 和 (sin a)。我们还加入了数值算术之上的函数算术，因此，如果以数值运算组合函数（这里用的是 +），就只有在函数输出是数时，才能组合这些输出。但符号结果无法按数值方式相加。这是我们构建算术系统 g 的方式所导致的。We get this error because cos and sin are numeric operators, like +. Since we have symbolic arithmetic over numeric arithmetic, these operators are extended so that for symbolic input, here a, they produce symbolic outputs, (cos a) and (sin a). We also added function arithmetic over numeric arithmetic, so if functions are numerically combined (here by +) their outputs may be combined only if the outputs are numbers. But the symbolic results cannot be added numerically. This is a consequence of the way we built the arithmetic g.

不过，泛型算术有一种魔力。它可以形成闭包：泛型算术的所有扩展，都可以建立在泛型算术本身之上！But there is magic in generic arithmetic. It can be closed: all extensions to the generic arithmetic can be made over the generic arithmetic!

(let ((g

       (make-generic-arithmetic make-simple-dispatch-store)))

  (add-to-generic-arithmetic! g numeric-arithmetic)

  (extend-generic-arithmetic! g symbolic-extender)

  (extend-generic-arithmetic! g function-extender)

  (install-arithmetic! g))

这里我们使用一个新过程 extend-generic-arithmetic!，它表达了一种常见模式。Here we use a new procedure extend-generic-arithmetic! that captures a common pattern.

(define (extend-generic-arithmetic! generic-arithmetic

                                    extender)

  (add-to-generic-arithmetic! generic-arithmetic

      (extender generic-arithmetic)))

现在，由于函数定义在泛型算术之上，我们就可以使用复杂的混合表达式了：Now we can use complex mixed expressions, because the functions are defined over the generic arithmetic:

(* ’b ((+ ’c cos sin) (+ 3 ’a)))

(* b (+ (+ c (cos (+ 3 a))) (sin (+ 3 a))))

我们甚至可以使用返回函数的函数：We can even use functions that return functions:

(((+ (lambda (x) (lambda (y) (cons x y)))

      (lambda (x) (lambda (y) (cons y x))))

  3)

4)

(+ (3 . 4) (4 . 3))

这么说，我们或许已经达到了理想境界？So perhaps we have achieved nirvana?

3.2.2 构造依赖于顺序！3.2.2 Construction depends on order!

遗憾的是，这严重依赖于向泛型过程添加规则的顺序。这并不奇怪，因为泛型过程系统是通过赋值构造的。改变构造顺序，就能看出这一点：Unfortunately, there is a severe dependence on the order in which rules are added to the generic procedures. This is not surprising, because the construction of the generic procedure system is by assignment. We can see this by changing the order of construction:

(let ((g

       (make-generic-arithmetic make-simple-dispatch-store)))

  (add-to-generic-arithmetic! g numeric-arithmetic)

  (extend-generic-arithmetic! g function-extender) ;*

  (extend-generic-arithmetic! g symbolic-extender) ;*

  (install-arithmetic! g))

接着，我们就会发现，下面这个示例and then we will find that the example

(* ’b ((+ ’c cos sin) (+ 3 ’a)))

虽然在之前的算术系统中能够工作，现在却失败了。这是因为符号算术截获了 (+ ’c cos sin)，产生一个符号表达式，而这个表达式并不是能够应用于 (+ 3 a) 的函数。问题在于，+ 的符号运算的适用性会接受这样的参数：至少一个参数是符号参数，其他参数满足基础算术系统的定义域谓词。然而，符号算术是以泛型算术为基础创建的，而泛型算术的定义域谓词会接受任何东西！同样适用于这些参数的，还有一个 + 的函数运算，但由于扩展顺序的偶然安排，它没有被选中。不幸的是，规则的选择存在歧义。最好不要出现多个运算同时适用的情况。which worked in the previous arithmetic, fails because the symbolic arithmetic captures (+ ’c cos sin) to produce a symbolic expression, which is not a function that can be applied to (+ 3 a). The problem is that the applicability of the symbolic operation for + accepts arguments with at least one symbolic argument and other arguments from the domain predicate of the base. But the symbolic arithmetic was created over the generic arithmetic as a base, and the domain predicate of a generic arithmetic accepts anything! There is also a function operation for + that is applicable to the same arguments, but it has not been chosen because of the accidental ordering of the extensions. Unfortunately, the choice of rule is ambiguous. It would be better to not have more than one applicable operation.

解决这一问题的一种办法，是限制符号量只能表示数。我们可以像第 92 页那样构建泛型算术，使符号算术建立在数值算术之上，而不是整个泛型算术之上：One way to resolve this problem is to restrict the symbolic quantities to represent numbers. We can do this by building our generic arithmetic so that the symbolic arithmetic is over the numeric arithmetic, as we did on page 92, rather than over the entire generic arithmetic:

(let ((g

       (make-generic-arithmetic make-simple-dispatch-store)))

  (add-to-generic-arithmetic! g numeric-arithmetic)

  (extend-generic-arithmetic! g function-extender)

  (add-to-generic-arithmetic! g

      (symbolic-extender numeric-arithmetic))

  (install-arithmetic! g))

这种方式能够工作，而且与顺序无关，因为规则选择不再有歧义。因此，现在 ’c 会被解释为一个常量，由函数扩展器将其强制转换为常函数。This works, independent of the ordering, because there is no ambiguity in the choice of rules. So now the ’c will be interpreted as a constant to be coerced to a constant function by the function extender.

(* ’b ((+ ’c cos sin) (+ 3 ’a)))

(* b (+ (+ c (cos (+ 3 a))) (sin (+ 3 a))))

遗憾的是，除了数以外，我们还可能希望构造其他量之上的符号表达式。目前，我们还无法为这个问题实现通用的解决方案。不过，如果确实想要一个名为 c 的字面函数，我们可以像前面那样使用 literal-function：Unfortunately, we may want to have symbolic expressions over other quantities besides numbers. We cannot yet implement a general solution to this problem. But if we really want a literal function named c, we can use literal-function as we did earlier:

(* ’b ((+ (literal-function ’c) cos sin) (+ 3 ’a)))

(* b (+ (+ (c (+ 3 a)) (cos (+ 3 a))) (sin (+ 3 a))))

这种方式能够工作，而且与泛型算术的构造顺序无关。This will work independent of the order of construction of the generic arithmetic.

有了这一机制，我们现在就可以用字面函数对 Stormer 积分器求值：With this mechanism we are now in a position to evaluate the Stormer integrator with a literal function:

(pp (x 0 ((evolver (literal-function ’F) ’h stormer-2)

          (make-initial-history 't ’h ’xt ’xt-h ’xt-2h)

          1))

(+ (+ (* 2 xt) (* -1 xt-h))

   (* (/ (expt h 2) 12)

      (+ (+ (* 13 (f t xt))

            (* -2 (f (- t h) xt-h)))

         (f (- t (* 2 h)) xt-2h))))

这相当难看，如果查看两个积分步的输出，还会更糟。不过，看看两步积分的化简结果还是很有趣的。使用一个神奇的符号表达式化简器，我们就能得到相当易读的表达式。这对于调试数值过程很有用。This is pretty ugly, and it would be worse if we looked at the output of two integration steps. But it is interesting to look at the result of simplifying a two-step integration. Using a magic symbolic-expression simplifier we get a pretty readable expression. This can be useful for debugging a numerical process.

(+ (* 2 (expt h 2) (f t xt))

   (* -1/4 (expt h 2) (f (+ (* -1 h) t) xt-h))

   (* 1/6 (expt h 2) (f (+ (* -2 h) t) xt-2h))

   (* 13/12

      (expt h 2)

      (f (+ h t)

         (+ (* 13/12 (expt h 2) (f t xt))

            (* -1/6 (expt h 2) (f (+ (* -1 h) t) xt-h))

            (* 1/12 (expt h 2) (f (+ (* -2 h) t) xt-2h))

            (* 2 xt)

            (* -1 xt-h))))

   (* 3 xt)

   (* -2 xt-h))

例如，注意，对加速度函数 f 的不同顶层调用只有四次。第四次顶层调用的第二个参数，使用了对 f 的三次已经计算过的调用。如果消除公共子表达式，就得到：For example, notice that there are only four distinct top-level calls to the acceleration function f. The second argument to the fourth top-level call uses three calls to f that have already been computed. If we eliminate common subexpressions we get:

(let* ((G84 (expt h 2)) (G85 (f t xt)) (G87 (* -1 h))

       (G88 (+ G87 t)) (G89 (f G88 xt-h)) (G91 (* -2 h))

       (G92 (+ G91 t)) (G93 (f G92 xt-2h)))

  (+ (* 2 G84 G85)

     (* -1/4 G84 G89)

     (* 1/6 G84 G93)

     (* 13/12 G84

        (f (+ h t)

           (+ (* 13/12 G84 G85)

              (* -1/6 G84 G89)

              (* 1/12 G84 G93)

              (* 2 xt)

              (* -1 xt-h))))

     (* 3 xt)

     (* -2 xt-h)))

这里可以清楚看出，对 f 的不同调用只有四次。虽然基本积分器在每个积分步中都会调用 f 三次，但这两步有两次中间调用是重叠的。对于这样简单的例子，这一点固然显而易见，但我们由此可以看到，符号求值如何帮助我们理解数值计算。Here we clearly see that there are only four distinct calls to f. Though each integration step in the basic integrator makes three calls to f, the two steps overlap on two intermediate calls. While this is obvious for such a simple example, we see how symbolic evaluation might help in understanding a numerical computation.

3.2.3 实现泛型过程3.2.3 Implementing generic procedures

我们已经利用泛型过程做了许多惊人的事情。但怎样才能让这样的机制运转起来呢？We have used generic procedures to do amazing things. But how do we make such a thing work?

为泛型过程构造构造器Making constructors for generic procedures

在第 89 页，我们构造了一个简单的泛型过程构造器：On page 89 we made a simple generic procedure constructor:

(define simple-generic-procedure

  (generic-procedure-constructor make-simple-dispatch-store))

过程 generic-procedure-constructor 接收一个“分派策略”过程，返回一个泛型过程构造器；后者接收名称、元数和默认处理过程规范。当用这三个参数调用该构造器时，它会返回一个泛型过程，并将其与一个为该过程新建的元数据存储关联起来。该存储保存名称、元数、分派策略的一个实例，以及默认处理过程（如果有的话）。分派策略实例会维护处理过程、它们的适用性，以及根据传给泛型过程的给定参数决定选择哪个处理过程的机制。The procedure generic-procedure-constructor is given a “dispatch strategy” procedure; it returns a generic-procedure constructor that takes a name, an arity, and a default-handler specification. When this procedure is called with these three arguments it returns a generic procedure that it associates with a newly constructed metadata store for that procedure, which holds the name, the arity, an instance of the dispatch strategy, and the default handler, if any. The dispatch-strategy instance will maintain the handlers, their applicabilities, and the mechanism for deciding which handler to choose for given arguments to the generic procedure.

generic-procedure-constructor 的实现代码如下：The code that implements generic-procedure-constructor is:

(define (generic-procedure-constructor dispatch-store-maker)

  (lambda (name arity default-handler)

    (let ((metadata

           (make-generic-metadata

             name arity (dispatch-store-maker)

             (or default-handler

                 (error-generic-procedure-handler name)))))

      (define (the-generic-procedure . args)

        (generic-procedure-dispatch metadata args))

      (set-generic-procedure-metadata! the-generic-procedure

                                       metadata)

      the-generic-procedure)))

该实现用一个普通的 Scheme 过程 the-generic-procedure 表示泛型过程，并用一个元数据存储（保存规则等）来决定过程的行为。这个存储通过“便签”（如第 28 页所述）与泛型过程关联起来，日后可以通过调用 generic-procedure-metadata 取得。这使得 define-generic-procedure-handler 之类的过程能够修改给定泛型过程的元数据。This implementation uses the-generic-procedure, an ordinary Scheme procedure, to represent the generic procedure, and a metadata store (for rules, etc.) that determines the procedure's behavior. This store is associated with the generic procedure using a “sticky note” (as on page 28) and can later be obtained by calling generic-procedure-metadata. This allows procedures such as define-generic-procedure-handler to modify the metadata of a given generic procedure.

generic-procedure-constructor 的参数是一个过程，它创建用于保存和检索处理过程的分派存储。分派存储封装了选择处理过程的策略。The argument to generic-procedure-constructor is a procedure that creates a dispatch store for saving and retrieving handlers. The dispatch store encapsulates the strategy for choosing a handler.

下面是我们一直使用的简单分派存储构造器。分派存储实现为一个接收消息的过程：Here is the simple dispatch-store constructor we have used so far. The dispatch store is implemented as a message-accepting procedure:

(define (make-simple-dispatch-store)

  (let ((rules ’()) (default-handler #f))

    (define (get-handler args)

      ;; body will be shown in text below.

      ...)

    (define (add-handler! applicability handler)

      ;; body will be shown in text below.

      ...)

    (define (get-default-handler) default-handler)

    (define (set-default-handler! handler)

      (set! default-handler handler))

    (lambda (message)      ; the simple dispatch store

      (case message

        ((get-handler) get-handler)

        ((add-handler!) add-handler!)

        ((get-default-handler) get-default-handler)

        ((set-default-handler!) set-default-handler!)

        ((get-rules) (lambda () rules))

        (else (error "Unknown message:" message))))))

简单分派存储只维护一个规则列表，每条规则将一个适用性与一个处理过程配对。当以泛型过程的参数调用内部过程 get-handler 时，它会顺序扫描列表，寻找适用性能够被传入参数满足的处理过程；找到则返回该处理过程，否则返回 #f：The simple dispatch store just maintains a list of the rules, each of which pairs an applicability with a handler. When the get-handler internal procedure is called with arguments for the generic procedure, it scans the list sequentially for a handler whose applicability is satisfied by the arguments tendered; it returns the handler, or #f if it doesn't find one:

(define (get-handler args)

  (let ((rule

         (find (lambda (rule)

                 (predicates-match? (car rule) args))

               rules)))

    (and rule (cdr rule))))

选择要运行的处理过程，可以采用许多策略。上面的代码返回列表中第一个适用的处理过程。另一种策略是返回所有适用的处理过程。如果不止一个处理过程适用，或许应该尝试执行全部处理过程（并行执行？），再比较结果！将分派存储构造器作为参数传给 generic-procedure-constructor，可以在创建泛型过程构造器时选择策略，而不是将策略硬编码在实现中。There are many possible strategies for choosing handlers to run. The above code returns the first applicable handler in the list. Another strategy is to return all applicable handlers. If more than one handler is applicable, perhaps all should be tried (in parallel?) and the results compared! Passing a dispatch-store constructor as an argument to generic-procedure-constructor allows the strategy to be chosen when the generic-procedure constructor is created, rather than being hard-coded into the implementation.

为泛型过程添加处理过程Adding handlers to generic procedures

处理过程定义过程（见下文）通过调用分派存储的内部过程 add-handler，来添加新规则。对于上面的 make-simple-dispatch-store，add-handler 会把新规则添加到规则列表的最前面。（但如果已经有一条处理该适用性的规则，就只替换处理过程。）The handler definition procedure (see below) adds new rules by calling the internal procedure add-handler of the dispatch store. For make-simple-dispatch-store above, add-handler adds the new rule to the front of the list of rules. (But if there was already a rule for handling that applicability, it just replaces the handler.)

(define (add-handler! applicability handler)

  (for-each (lambda (predicates)

              (let ((p (assoc predicates rules)))

                (if p

                    (set-cdr! p handler)

                    (set! rules

                          (cons (cons predicates handler)

                                rules)))))

            applicability))

define-generic-procedure-handler 过程使用元数据表，取得泛型过程的元数据记录。它向分派存储索取 add-handler! 过程，并用这个过程向元数据添加一条规则，将适用性与处理过程关联起来。分派存储实例由 generic-metadata-dispatch-store 从泛型过程的元数据中取出。The define-generic-procedure-handler procedure uses the metadata table to get the metadata record for the generic procedure. It asks the dispatch store for the add-handler! procedure and uses that procedure to add a rule to the metadata that associates the applicability with the handler. The dispatch-store instance is retrieved from the metadata of the generic procedure by generic-metadata-dispatch-store.

(define (define-generic-procedure-handler generic-procedure

                                          applicability

                                          handler)

  (((generic-metadata-dispatch-store

     (generic-procedure-metadata generic-procedure))

    ’add-handler!)

   applicability

   handler))

最后，这一机制的核心是分派，它由泛型过程（第 97 页的 the-generic-procedure）调用，负责寻找合适的处理过程并应用它。如果没有适用的处理过程，就调用在构造泛型过程时提供的默认处理过程。13Finally, the heart of the mechanism is the dispatch, called by a generic procedure (the-generic-procedure on page 97), which finds an appropriate handler and applies it. The default handler, as supplied during construction of the generic procedure, is called if there is no applicable handler.13

(define (generic-procedure-dispatch metadata args)

  (let ((handler

         (get-generic-procedure-handler metadata args)))

    (apply handler args)))



(define (get-generic-procedure-handler metadata args)

  (or ((generic-metadata-getter metadata) args)

      ((generic-metadata-default-getter metadata))))

可扩展泛型过程的威力The power of extensible generics

在可扩展泛型过程这一底层基础之上构造系统，是一个强大的思想。在我们的例子中，可以为语言设计者未曾设想过的新数据类型，定义加法、乘法等的含义。例如，如果系统的算术运算符实现为可扩展的泛型过程，用户就可以扩展它们，以支持四元数、向量、矩阵、模素数整数、函数、张量、微分形式等对象上的算术。这不仅使新的能力成为可能，还能扩展旧程序，让一个原本用于操作简单数值量的程序，变得能够操作标量值函数。Construction of a system on a substrate of extensible generic procedures is a powerful idea. In our example it is possible to define what is meant by addition, multiplication, etc., for new data types unimagined by the language designer. For example, if the arithmetic operators of a system are implemented as extensible generics, a user may extend them to support arithmetic on quaternions, vectors, matrices, integers modulo a prime, functions, tensors, differential forms, This is not just making new capabilities possible; it also extends old programs, so a program that was written to manipulate simple numerical quantities may become useful for manipulating scalar-valued functions.

我们已经看到，以这种方式使用可扩展泛型过程，可能会伴随一些问题。另一方面，有些“突变”会极有价值。例如，可以把算术扩展到符号量。最简单的办法，是为所有运算符加入泛型扩展，使其接收符号量作为参数，并返回一个数据结构，表示对这些参数执行所指定的运算。再加入一个代数表达式化简器，我们就突然拥有了一个符号运算系统。这对调试纯数值计算很有用，因为只要为它们提供符号参数，我们就可以检查所得符号表达式，确认程序计算的确实是我们想要的东西。这也是用于优化数值程序的部分求值器的基础。而函数求导，可以看作将算术泛型扩展到一种复合数据类型（见We have seen that there are potential problems associated with this use of extensible generic procedures. On the other hand, some “mutations” will be extremely valuable. For example, it is possible to extend arithmetic to symbolic quantities. The simplest way to do this is to make a generic extension to all of the operators to take symbolic quantities as arguments and return a data structure representing the indicated operation on the arguments. With the addition of a simplifier of algebraic expressions we suddenly have a symbolic manipulator. This is useful in debugging purely numerical calculations, because if we give them symbolic arguments we can examine the resulting symbolic expressions to make sure that the program is calculating what we intend it to. It is also the basis of a partial evaluator for optimization of numerical programs. And functional differentiation can be viewed as a generic extension of arithmetic to a compound data type (see 第 3.3 节section 3.3）。我们用于教授经典力学 [121] 的 scmutils 系统，正是以这种方式实现求导的。). The scmutils system we use to teach classical mechanics [121] implements differentiation in exactly this way.

练习 3.5：一个古怪的错误Exercise 3.5: A weird bug

考虑 arith.scm 中的 +-like（“类似加法”）过程，如下所示，它在安装算术系统时实现 n 元过程 + 和 *。它返回一个由名称和过程组成的对；安装器会将该名称绑定到该过程。Consider the +-like (“plus-like”) procedure in arith.scm, shown below, which implements n-ary procedures + and * as part of installing an arithmetic. It returns a pair of a name and a procedure; the installer will bind the name to the procedure.

看起来，它的写法会使得每次以零个参数调用该运算时，都执行计算单位元的 get-identity 过程。It seems that it is written to execute the get-identity procedure that computes the identity every time the operation is called with no arguments.

(define (+-like operator identity-name)

  (lambda (arithmetic)

    (let ((binary-operation

           (find-arithmetic-operation operator arithmetic)))

      (and binary-operation

           (let ((binary

                  (operation-procedure binary-operation))

                 (get-identity

                  (identity-name->getter identity-name

                                         arithmetic)))

             (cons operator

                   (lambda args

                     (case (length args)

                       ((0) (get-identity))

                       ((1) (car args))

                       (else (pairwise binary args))))))))))

或许某个运算符的单位元应该只计算一次，而不是每次调用处理过程时都计算。因此，有人提议把代码改成下面这样：Perhaps the identity for an operator should be computed only once, not every time the handler is called. As a consequence, it is proposed that the code should be modified as follows:

(define (+-like operator identity-name)

  (lambda (arithmetic)

    (let ((binary-operation

           (find-arithmetic-operation operator arithmetic)))

      (and binary-operation

           (let ((binary

                  (operation-procedure binary-operation))

                 (identity

                  ((identity-name->getter identity-name

                                          arithmetic))))

             (cons operator

                   (lambda args

                     (case (length args)

                       ((0) identity)

                       ((1) (car args))

                       (else (pairwise binary args))))))))))

然而，这里面有一个微妙的错误！你能触发这个错误吗？你能解释它吗？However, this has a subtle bug! Can you elicit the bug? Can you explain it?
