对象类型The object types

要在游戏中创建一个对象，我们先用 make-property 定义一些属性，用 make-type 定义类型谓词，用 type-instantiator 获取与该谓词相关联的实例化器，再用适当的参数调用这个实例化器。To create an object in our game, we define some properties with make-property, define a type predicate with make-type, get the predicate's associated instantiator with type-instantiator, and call that instantiator with appropriate arguments.

怎样创建一只巨魔？巨魔构造器 make-troll 接受一些参数，用来指定正在构造的这只巨魔的各项特定属性值。巨魔将在给定地点被创建，并具有 restlessness（四处走动的倾向）、acquisitiveness（拿取物品的倾向）和 hunger（咬其他人的倾向）。How do we make a troll? The make-troll constructor for a troll takes arguments that specify the values for properties that are specific to the particular troll being constructed. The troll will be created in a given place with a restlessness (proclivity to move around), an acquisitiveness (proclivity to take things), and a hunger (proclivity to bite other people).

(define (create-troll name place restlessness hunger)

  (make-troll ’name name

              ’location place

              ’restlessness restlessness

              ’acquisitiveness 1/10

              ’hunger hunger))

我们创建两只巨魔：grendel 和 registrar。最初将它们放在随机地点，并赋予一些随机的倾向。We create two trolls: grendel and registrar. They are initially placed in random places, with some random proclivities.

(define (create-trolls places)

  (map (lambda (name)

         (create-troll name

                       (random-choice places)

                       (random-bias 3)

                       (random-bias 3)))

       ’(grendel registrar)))

过程 random-choice 从给定的列表中随机选择一项。过程 random-bias 选择一个数（这里是 1、2 或 3），并返回它的倒数。The procedure random-choice randomly selects one item from the list it is given. The procedure random-bias chooses a number (in this case 1, 2, or 3) and returns its reciprocal.

巨魔类型被定义为一个仅对巨魔返回真的谓词。传给 make-type 过程的参数，是类型的名字以及巨魔特有属性的描述。（只有巨魔才有 hunger 属性。）The troll type is defined as a predicate that is true only of trolls. The make-type procedure is given a name for the type and a descriptor of the properties that are specific to trolls. (Only trolls have a hunger property.)

(define troll:hunger

  (make-property ’hunger ’predicate bias?))



(define troll?

  (make-type 'troll (list troll:hunger)))

巨魔是一种特定类型的自主智能体。因此，巨魔集合是自主智能体集合的子集（<=）。The troll is a specific type of autonomous agent. Thus the set of trolls is a subset of (<=) the set of autonomous agents.

(set-predicate<=! troll? autonomous-agent?)

巨魔的构造器直接由定义该类型的谓词导出，hunger 属性的访问器也是如此。The constructor for trolls is directly derived from the predicate that defines the type, as is the accessor for the hunger property.

(define make-troll

  (type-instantiator troll?))



(define get-hunger

  (property-getter troll:hunger troll?))

自主智能体偶尔会受到“时钟”的刺激而采取某种行动。巨魔特有的行动是咬其他人。Autonomous agents are occasionally stimulated by the “clock” to take some action. The distinctive action of the troll is to bite other people.

(define-clock-handler troll? eat-people!)

通过抛掷一枚有偏硬币，来决定巨魔此刻是否饥饿。如果饥饿，它就寻找其他人（巨魔也是人！）；如果找到了，就选一个来咬，使受害者受到一些伤害。叙述者会描述发生的事情。A biased coin is flipped to determine whether the troll is hungry at the moment. If it is hungry it looks for other people (trolls are people too!), and if there are some it chooses one to bite, causing the victim to suffer some damage. The narrator describes what happens.

(define (eat-people! troll)

  (if (flip-coin (get-hunger troll))

      (let ((people (people-here troll)))

        (if (n:null? people)

            (narrate! (list (possessive troll) "belly rumbles")

                      troll)

            (let ((victim (random-choice people)))

              (narrate! (list troll "takes a bite out of"

                              victim)

                        troll)

              (suffer! (random-number 3) victim))))))

过程 flip-coin 生成一个介于 0 与 1 之间的随机小数。如果这个小数大于参数，就返回真。过程 random-number 返回一个小于等于其参数的正数。The procedure flip-coin generates a random fraction between 0 and 1. If that fraction is greater than the argument, it returns true. The procedure random-number returns a positive number less than or equal to its argument.

过程 narrate! 用于给故事添加叙述。narrate! 的第二个参数（上述代码中的 troll）可以是任何具有位置的东西。叙述者会在由此确定的地点播报第一个参数中的内容。只有身处那个地点，才能听到这条播报。The procedure narrate! is used to add narration to the story. The second argument to narrate! (troll in the above code) may be anything that has a location. The narrator announces its first argument in the location thus determined. One can only hear that announcement if one is in that location.

我们说过，巨魔是一种自主智能体。自主智能体类型由其谓词定义，该谓词指定这类智能体所需的属性。我们还指定，自主智能体集合是全体人物集合的子集。We said that a troll is a kind of autonomous agent. The autonomous agent type is defined by its predicate, which specifies the properties that are needed for such an agent. We also specify that the set of autonomous agents is a subset of the set of all persons.

(define autonomous-agent:restlessness

  (make-property 'restlessness ’predicate bias?))



(define autonomous-agent:acquisitiveness

  (make-property ’acquisitiveness ’predicate bias?))



(define autonomous-agent?

  (make-type ’autonomous-agent

             (list autonomous-agent:restlessness

                   autonomous-agent:acquisitiveness)))



(set-predicate<=! autonomous-agent? person?)

巨魔构造器除了指定巨魔特有的 hunger 属性，还指定了构造自主智能体所需的属性 restlessness 和 acquisitiveness 的值。由于巨魔是自主智能体，而自主智能体是人物，因此人物及其所有超集的属性也都必须有值。在这个系统中，几乎所有属性都有默认值，未指定时会自动填入。例如，所有对象都需要名字；巨魔构造器中指定了 name。但人物还有一个 health 属性，用于累计伤害，而巨魔构造器并未显式指定这个属性的值。The constructor for trolls specified values for the properties restlessness and acquisitiveness, which are needed to make an autonomous agent, in addition to the hunger property specific to trolls. Since trolls are autonomous agents, and autonomous agents are persons, there must also be values for the properties of a person and all its supersets. In this system almost all properties have default values that are automatically filled if not specified. For example, all objects need names; the name was specified in the constructor for trolls. But a person also has a health property, necessary to accumulate damage, and this property value was not explicitly specified in the constructor for trolls.

泛型过程The generic procedures

现在已经看到对象是如何构造的，接下来看看如何实现它们的行为。具体来说，我们将看到，泛型过程是描述复杂行为的有效工具。Now that we have seen how objects are built, we will look at how to implement their behavior. Specifically, we will see how generic procedures are an effective tool for describing complex behavior.

我们用 property-getter 定义了 eat-people! 中使用的 get-hunger。给定类型对象的某个属性的取值器，被实现为一个泛型过程；它接受对象作为参数，并返回该属性的值。We defined get-hunger, which is used in eat-people!, in terms of property-getter. A getter for a property of objects of a given type is implemented as a generic procedure that takes an object as an argument and returns the value of the property.

(define (property-getter property type)

  (let ((procedure    ; the getter

         (most-specific-generic-procedure

          (symbol ’get- (property-name property))

          1           ; arity

          #f)))       ; default handler

    (define-generic-procedure-handler procedure

      (match-args type)

      (lambda (object)

        (get-property-value property object)))

    procedure))

这里展示了如何构造一个名称自动生成（例如 get-hunger）、接受一个参数的泛型过程，以及如何添加一个执行实际访问操作的处理过程。most-specific-generic-procedure 的最后一个参数是该过程的默认处理过程；指定为 #f，意味着默认行为是报告错误。This shows the construction of a generic procedure with a generated name (for example get-hunger) that takes one argument, and the addition of a handler that does the actual access. The last argument to most-specific-generic-procedure is the default handler for the procedure; specifying #f means that the default is to signal an error.

我们还用 define-clock-handler 描述时钟滴答时要采取的行动。该过程只是给已经构造好的泛型过程 clock-tick! 添加一个处理过程。We also used define-clock-handler to describe an action to take when the clock ticks. That procedure just adds a handler to a generic procedure clock-tick!, which is already constructed.

(define (define-clock-handler type action)

  (define-generic-procedure-handler clock-tick!

    (match-args type)

    (lambda (super object)

      (super object)

      (action object))))

这个泛型过程支持“链式调用”：每个处理过程都获得一个额外参数（这里是 super），调用它就会调用为给定对象所属超集定义的处理过程。传给 super 的参数与这里收到的参数含义相同；在本例中只有一个参数，将它继续传下去即可。这与 Java 等语言所用的机制本质相同，只不过那些语言用一个特殊关键字，而不是参数来实现。This generic procedure supports “chaining,” in which each handler gets an extra argument (in this case super) that when called causes any handlers defined on the supersets of the given object to be called. The arguments passed to super have the same meaning as the arguments received here; in this case there's just one argument and it is passed along. This is essentially the same mechanism used in languages such as Java, though in that case it's done with a magic keyword rather than an argument.

调用 clock-tick! 过程是为了触发行动，而不是计算值。注意，我们指定的行动，会在超集指定的所有行动之后执行。只需改变调用顺序，也可以选择先执行这里的行动，再执行其他行动。The clock-tick! procedure is called to trigger an action, not to compute a value. Notice that the action we specify will be taken after any actions specified by the supersets. We could have chosen to do the given action first and the others later, just by changing the order of the calls.

移动东西的机制体现了用泛型过程组织程序的真正威力。例如，拿起工程学书时，我们把它从房间移入自己的袋子。这通过 move! 过程实现：The real power of the generic procedure organization is illustrated by the mechanisms for moving things around. For example, when we pick up the engineering book, we move it from the room to our bag. This is implemented with the move! procedure:

(define (move! thing destination actor)

  (generic-move! thing

                 (get-location thing)

                 destination

                 actor))

move! 过程借助更一般的过程 generic-move! 实现，后者接受四个参数：要移动的东西、它当前所在的位置、它的目的地，以及执行移动操作的行动者。这个过程是泛型的，因为移动行为可能依赖所有参数的类型。The move! procedure is implemented in terms of a more general procedure generic-move! that takes four arguments: the thing to be moved, the thing's current location, its destination location, and the actor of the move procedure. This procedure is generic because the movement behavior potentially depends on the types of all of the arguments.

创建 generic-move! 时，我们还指定了一个非常通用的处理过程，接住那些未被更特定的处理过程（针对特定参数类型）涵盖的情况。When we create generic-move! we also specify a very general handler to catch cases that are not covered by more specific handlers (for specific argument types).

(define generic-move!

  (most-specific-generic-procedure ’generic-move! 4 #f))



(define-generic-procedure-handler generic-move!

  (match-args thing? container? container? person?)

  (lambda (thing from to actor)

    (tell! (list thing "is not movable")

           actor)))

过程 tell! 将消息（它的第一个参数）发送给正在尝试移动 thing 的 actor。如果 actor 是化身，消息就会显示出来。The procedure tell! sends the message (its first argument) to the actor that is trying to move the thing. If the actor is the avatar, the message is displayed.

在演示中，我们拿起了那本书。为此，我们以名字 engineering-book 调用过程 take-thing。这个过程将名字解析为相应的东西，然后调用 take-thing!，后者又调用 move!：In the demo we picked up the book. We did that by calling the procedure take-thing with the name engineering-book. This procedure resolves the name to the thing and then calls take-thing!, which invokes move!:

(define (take-thing name)

  (let ((thing (find-thing name (here))))

    (if thing

        (take-thing! thing my-avatar)))

  'done)



(define (take-thing! thing person)

  (move! thing (get-bag person) person))

这里有两个过程。第一个是用户界面过程，让玩家可以方便地用名字来描述要拿走的东西。它调用第二个过程，即一个在其他地方也会使用的内部过程。There are two procedures here. The first is a user-interface procedure to give the player a convenient way of describing the thing to be taken by giving its name. It calls the second, an internal procedure that is also used in other places.

为使其工作，我们为 generic-move! 提供一个专门将可移动物品从地点移入袋子的处理过程：To make this work we supply a handler for generic-move! that is specialized to moving mobile things from places to bags:

(define-generic-procedure-handler generic-move!

  (match-args mobile-thing? place? bag? person?)

  (lambda (mobile-thing from to actor)

    (let ((new-holder (get-holder to)))

      (cond ((eqv? actor new-holder)

             (narrate! (list actor

                             "picks up" mobile-thing)

                       actor))

            (else

             (narrate! (list actor

                             "picks up" mobile-thing

                             "and gives it to" new-holder)

                       actor)))

      (if (not (eqv? actor new-holder))

          (say! new-holder (list "Whoa! Thanks, dude!")))

      (move-internal! mobile-thing from to))))

如果 actor 正在为自己拿取 thing，那么 actor 就是 new-holder。不过，也可能是 actor 正在捡起 place 中的 thing，并把它放进另一个人的袋子！If the actor is taking the thing, the actor is the new-holder. But it is possible that the actor is picking up the thing in the place and putting it into someone else's bag!

say! 过程用于表示某个人说了某句话。它的第一个参数是说话的人，第二个参数是所说的文本。move-internal! 过程则真正将对象从一个位置移到另一个位置。The say! procedure is used to indicate that a person has said something. Its first argument is the person speaking, and the second argument is the text being spoken. The move-internal! procedure actually moves the object from one place to another.

要放下一件东西，我们用过程 drop-thing 把它从自己的袋子移到当前所在的地点：To drop a thing we use the procedure drop-thing to move it from our bag to our current location:

(define (drop-thing name)

  (let ((thing (find-thing name my-avatar)))

    (if thing

        (drop-thing! thing my-avatar)))

  'done)



(define (drop-thing! thing person)

  (move! thing (get-location person) person))

下面这个 generic-move! 的处理过程支持放下东西。actor 可以从自己的 bag 中放下 thing，也可以从另一个人的 bag 中取出某件东西，再把它放下。The following handler for generic-move! enables dropping a thing. The actor may be dropping a thing from its own bag or it might pick up something from another person's bag and drop it.

(define-generic-procedure-handler generic-move!

  (match-args mobile-thing? bag? place? person?)

  (lambda (mobile-thing from to actor)

    (let ((former-holder (get-holder from)))

      (cond ((eqv? actor former-holder)

             (narrate! (list actor

                             "drops" mobile-thing)

                       actor))

            (else

             (narrate! (list actor

                             "takes" mobile-thing

                             "from" former-holder

                             "and drops it")

                       actor)))

      (if (not (eqv? actor former-holder))

          (say! former-holder

                (list "What did you do that for?")))

      (move-internal! mobile-thing from to))))

另一个 generic-move! 处理过程，通过将东西从一个袋子移到另一个袋子，支持赠送或偷取东西。在这里，行为取决于行动者、东西的原持有者与最终持有者之间的关系。Yet another generic-move! handler provides for gifting or stealing something, by moving a thing from one bag to another bag. Here the behavior depends on the relationships among the actor, the original holder of the thing, and the final holder of the thing.

(define-generic-procedure-handler generic-move!

  (match-args mobile-thing? bag? bag? person?)

  (lambda (mobile-thing from to actor)

    (let ((former-holder (get-holder from))

          (new-holder (get-holder to)))

      (cond ((eqv? from to)

             (tell! (list new-holder "is already carrying"

                          mobile-thing)

                    actor))

            ((eqv? actor former-holder)

             (narrate! (list actor

                             "gives" mobile-thing

                             "to" new-holder)

                       actor))

            ((eqv? actor new-holder)

             (narrate! (list actor

                             "takes" mobile-thing

                             "from" former-holder)

                       actor))

            (else

             (narrate! (list actor

                             "takes" mobile-thing

                             "from" former-holder

                             "and gives it to" new-holder)

                       actor)))

      (if (not (eqv? actor former-holder))

          (say! former-holder (list "Yaaaah! I am upset!")))

      (if (not (eqv? actor new-holder))

          (say! new-holder

                (list "Whoa! Where'd you get this?")))

      (if (not (eqv? from to))

          (move-internal! mobile-thing from to)))))

另一个有趣的情形，是人物从一个地点移动到另一个地点。这通过以下处理过程实现：Another interesting case is the motion of a person from one place to another. This is implemented by the following handler:

(define-generic-procedure-handler generic-move!

  (match-args person? place? place? person?)

  (lambda (person from to actor)

    (let ((exit (find-exit from to)))

      (cond ((or (eqv? from (get-heaven))

                 (eqv? to (get-heaven)))

             (move-internal! person from to))

            ((not exit)

             (tell! (list "There is no exit from" from

                          "to" to)

                    actor))

            ((eqv? person actor)

             (narrate! (list person "leaves via the"

                             (get-direction exit) "exit")

                       from)

             (move-internal! person from to))

            (else

             (tell! (list "You can't force"

                          person

                          "to move!")

                    actor))))))

还可以有许多其他处理过程，但要点在于，移动过程的行为可以依赖所有参数的类型。这让我们能将行为清晰地分解为可独立理解的各个部分。在传统面向对象设计中，要实现如此优雅的分解相当困难，因为那种设计必须选择某一个参数作为主要的分派中心。应当选被移动的东西吗？来源位置？目标位置？还是行动者？无论选择哪一个，都会使情况变得比必要的更加复杂。There can be many other handlers, but the important thing to see is that the behavior of the move procedure can depend on the types of all of the arguments. This provides a clean decomposition of the behavior into separately understandable chunks. It is rather difficult to achieve such an elegant decomposition in a traditional object-oriented design, because in such a design one must choose one of the arguments to be the principal dispatch center. Should it be the thing being moved? the source location? the target location? the actor? Any one choice will make the situation more complex than necessary.

正如 Alan Perlis 所写：“让 100 个函数操作一种数据结构，胜过让 10 个函数操作 10 种数据结构。”As Alan Perlis wrote: “It is better to have 100 functions operate on one data structure than 10 functions on 10 data structures.”

属性的实现Implementing properties

我们已经看到，游戏中的对象是这样创建的：用 make-property 定义一些属性，用 make-type 定义类型谓词，用 type-instantiator 获取与谓词相关联的实例化器，再用适当的参数调用这个实例化器。这个简单的描述背后隐藏着复杂的实现，值得深入探索。We saw that the objects in our game are created by defining some properties with make-property, defining a type predicate with make-type, getting the predicate's associated instantiator with type-instantiator, and calling that instantiator with appropriate arguments. This simple description hides a complex implementation that is worth exploring.

这段代码有趣之处在于，它为管理类型实例所关联的属性提供了一种简单而灵活的机制，在使用子类型时依然稳健。属性用抽象对象而非名字来表示，以避免定义子类型时出现命名空间冲突。例如，类型 mammal 可能有一个名为 forelimb 的属性，指通常意义上的前腿。mammal 的子类型 bat 可能有一个同名属性，却指另一种对象——翅膀！如果用名字指定属性，那么其中一个类型就得更改属性名。在这个实现中，属性对象由其自身指定，两个同名属性仍是不同的。The interesting aspect of this code is that it provides a simple and flexible mechanism for managing the properties that are associated with a type instance, which is robust when subtyping is used. Properties are represented by abstract objects rather than names, in order to avoid namespace conflicts when subtyping. For example, a type mammal might have a property named forelimb that refers to a typical front leg. A subtype bat of mammal might have a property with the same name that refers to a different object, a wing! If the properties were specified by their names, then one of these types would need to change its name. In this implementation, the property objects are specified by themselves, and two properties with the same name are distinct.

过程 make-property 创建一种数据类型，其中包含名字、谓词和默认值提供过程。它的第一个参数是属性名，其余参数构成一个属性列表，提供有关该属性的附加元数据。例如，可参见第 143 页 troll:hunger 的定义。我们将略过属性列表的解析方式，因为那没有什么趣味。32The procedure make-property creates a data type containing a name, a predicate, and a default-value supplier. Its first argument is the property's name, and the rest of the arguments are a property list with additional metadata about the property. For example, see the definition of troll:hunger on page 143. We will ignore how the property list is parsed since it's not interesting.32

(define (make-property name . plist)

  (guarantee n:symbol? name)

  (guarantee property-list? plist)

  (%make-property name

                  (get-predicate-property plist)

                  (get-default-supplier-property plist)))

属性用 Scheme 记录 [65] 实现，这是一种由一组具名字段组成的数据结构。它通过一套详尽的语法来定义，其中指定构造器、类型谓词以及各字段的访问器：A property is implemented as a Scheme record [65], which is a data structure that consists of a set of named fields. It is defined by elaborate syntax that specifies a constructor, a type predicate, and an accessor for each field:

(define-record-type <property>

    (%make-property name predicate default-supplier) 

    property?

  (name property-name)

  (predicate property-predicate)

  (default-supplier property-default-supplier))

我们选择给基本记录构造器 %make-property 起一个以百分号（%）开头的名字。我们常用开头的百分号表示低层过程，这类过程仅用于支持较高层的抽象，不在其他地方使用。%make-property 过程只在 make-property 中使用，而后者才由系统其他部分使用。We chose to give the primitive record constructor %make-property a name with an initial percent sign (%). We often use the initial percent sign to indicate a low-level procedure that will not be used except to support a higher-level abstraction. The %make-property procedure is used only in make-property, which in turn is used by other parts of the system.

给定一组属性，就能构造一个类型谓词：Given a set of properties, we can construct a type predicate:

(define (make-type name properties)

  (guarantee-list-of property? properties)

  (let ((type

         (simple-abstract-predicate name instance-data?)))

    (%set-type-properties! type properties)

    type))

类型谓词由一个普通抽象谓词（见第 134 页）和指定的属性组成，这些属性通过 %set-type-properties! 存储在一个关联项中。这些指定的属性并不单独使用，而是与该类型的各个超集的属性汇总起来。被加上标记的对象满足 instance-data?。它是一种关联结构，将该类型的各项属性映射到对应的值。A type predicate is an ordinary abstract predicate (see page 134) along with the specified properties, which are stored in an association using %set-type-properties!. Those specified properties aren't used by themselves; instead they are aggregated with the properties of the supersets of this type. The object being tagged satisfies instance-data?. It is an association from the properties of this type to their values.

(define (type-properties type)

  (append-map %type-properties

              (cons type (all-supertypes type))))

type-instantiator 则构造实例化器。实例化器接受一个以属性名为键的属性列表，解析该列表，再用所得的值创建实例数据，将该实例的每项属性与相应的值关联起来。它还会调用 set-up! 过程，使我们能够执行特定于类型的初始化。And type-instantiator builds the instantiator, which accepts a property list using property names as keys, parses that list, and uses the resulting values to create the instance data, which associates each property of this instance with its value. It also calls the set-up! procedure, which gives us the ability to do type-specific initialization.

(define (type-instantiator type)

  (let ((constructor (predicate-constructor type))

        (properties (type-properties type)))

    (lambda plist

      (let ((object

             (constructor (parse-plist plist properties))))

        (set-up! object)

        object))))

练习 3.16：冒险热身Exercise 3.16: Adventure warmup

加载冒险游戏，执行命令 (start-adventure your-name) 开始模拟。让你的化身四处走走。找到某件可以拿走的对象并拿走它。把拿到的东西放到别的地方。Load the adventure game and start the simulation by executing the command (start-adventure your-name). Walk your avatar around. Find some takable object and take it. Drop the thing you took in some other place.

练习 3.17：健康Exercise 3.17: Health

改变人物健康状况的表示方式，使它比初始游戏中的表示具有更多可能的值。对新表示进行适当缩放，使被巨魔咬死的概率与改变表示之前相同。还要使人物在被巨魔咬伤但未致命，或因其他原因损失健康后，可以通过休息若干周期来恢复。Change the representation of the health of a person to have more possible values than are given in the initial game. Scale your representation so that the probability of death from a troll bite is the same as it was before you changed the representation. Also make it possible to recover from a nonfatal troll bite, or other loss of health, by some cycles of rest.

练习 3.18：医疗援助Exercise 3.18: Medical help

创建一个新地点：医疗中心。让人们能从 Green 大楼和 Gates 塔楼方便地到达它。如果一个受到非致命伤害（也许是被巨魔咬伤）的人设法到达医疗中心，就可以恢复健康。Make a new place, the medical center. Make it easily accessible from the Green building and the Gates tower. If a person who suffers a nonfatal injury (perhaps from a troll bite) makes it to the medical center, their health may be restored.

练习 3.19：真知晶球Exercise 3.19: A palantir

创建一种称为 palantir 的新物品（即 Tolkien 的《指环王》中的“真知晶球”）。每个真知晶球实例都可以与其他任意实例通信；因此，如果 lobby-10 有一个真知晶球，而 dorm-row 有另一个，那么透过 lobby-10 的真知晶球，就可以观察 dorm-row 发生的事情。（基本上，真知晶球就是一套魔法监控摄像头和显示器。）Make a new kind of thing called a palantir (a “seeing stone,” as in Tolkien's Lord of the Rings). Each instance of a palantir can communicate with any other instance; so if there is a palantir in lobby-10 and another in dorm-row, you can observe the goings-on in dorm-row by looking into a palantir in lobby-10. (Basically, a palantir is a magical surveillance camera and display.)

在校园各处安放几个不可移动的真知晶球，并使你的化身能够使用它们。你能监视朋友们的位置吗？能监视巨魔的位置吗？Plant a few immovable palantiri in various parts of the campus, and enable your avatar to use one. Can you keep watch on the positions of your friends? Of the trolls?

你能让化身以外的某个自主人物，出于某种有趣的目的使用真知晶球吗？大学校长或许是个合适的选择。Can you make an autonomous person other than your avatar use a palantir for some interesting purpose? The university's president might be a suitable choice.

练习 3.20：隐身Exercise 3.20: Invisibility

制作一件“隐身斗篷”，任何人物（包括化身）都可以取得它来隐身，从而免遭巨魔的攻击。但是，过一小段时间后就必须丢弃（放下）斗篷，因为持有斗篷会使人物的健康缓慢恶化。Make an “Invisibility Cloak” that any person (including an avatar) can acquire to become invisible, thus invulnerable to attacks by trolls. However, the cloak must be discarded (dropped) after a short time, because possession of the cloak slowly degrades the person's health.

练习 3.21：轮到你了Exercise 3.21: Your turn

现在，你已经有机会体验这个由人物、地点和物品构成的“世界”，请对它做出某种实质性的扩展，唯一的限制就是你的创造力。一种想法是加入可移动的地点，例如电梯，其入口和出口随时间变化，而且也许可以由人物控制。但这只是一个建议——创造一些你喜欢的东西吧！Now that you have had an opportunity to play with our “world” of characters, places, and things, extend this world in some substantial way, limited only by your creativity. One idea is to have mobile places, such as elevators, which have entrances and exits that change with time, and are perhaps controllable by persons. But that is just one suggestion—invent something you like!

练习 3.22：多个玩家Exercise 3.22: Multiple players

这不是一个简单的练习，而是一个相当大的项目。This is a pretty big project rather than a simple exercise.

  1. a. 扩展冒险游戏，使其能够有多个玩家，每个玩家控制自己的化身。a. Extend the adventure game so that there can be multiple players, each controlling a personal avatar.
  2. b. 让玩家可以使用不同的终端。b. Make it possible for players to be on different terminals.

3.6 小结3.6 Summary

本章介绍的泛型过程用法既强大又危险——胆小者不宜尝试。允许程序员动态改变语言中基本运算符的含义，可能导致代码变得无法管理。但如果我们谨慎地只将运算符扩展到新的参数类型，而不改变它们对原有类型的行为，就能在不破坏任何旧软件的情况下获得强大的扩展。大多数编程语言不允许自由修改基本运算符现有的行为，这是有充分理由的。不过，这里的许多思想可以移植，也可以安全地使用。例如，在 C++ 和 Haskell 等差别很大的语言中，都可以重载运算符，让它们在用户定义类型上具有新的含义。The use of generic procedures introduced in this chapter is both powerful and dangerous—it is not for the faint of heart. Allowing the programmer to dynamically change the meanings of the primitive operators of the language can result in unmanageable code. But if we are careful to extend operators to only new types of arguments, without changing their behavior on the original types, we can get powerful extensions without breaking any old software. Most programming languages do not allow the freedom to modify the existing behavior of primitive operators, for good reason. However, many of the ideas here are portable and can be safely used. For example, in many languages, as diverse as C++ and Haskell, one can overload operators to have new meanings on user-defined types.

算术扩展相当温和，但我们必须意识到可能出现的问题，以及可能引发的微妙错误：整数加法满足结合律，但浮点数加法不满足；数的乘法满足交换律，但矩阵乘法不满足。如果把加法扩展为字符串拼接，这个扩展也不满足交换律。好的一面是，将算术扩展到包含字面数值和纯数值量的符号表达式，是很直接的。继续扩展到函数、向量、矩阵和张量，虽不困难，却需要大量工作。不过，我们最终会在扩展的顺序上遇到真正的问题——符号向量并不等于坐标为符号的向量！符号函数的类型问题也可能让我们陷入复杂的局面。Extensions of arithmetic are pretty tame, but we must be aware of the problems that can come up, and the subtle bugs that can be evoked: addition of integers is associative, but addition of floating-point numbers is not associative; multiplication of numbers is commutative, but multiplication of matrices is not. And if we extend addition to be concatenation of strings, that extension is not commutative. On the good side, it is straightforward to extend arithmetic to symbolic expressions containing literal numbers as well as purely numerical quantities. It is not difficult, but lots of work, to continue to expand to functions, vectors, matrices, and tensors. However, we eventually run into real problems with the ordering of extensions—symbolic vectors are not the same as vectors with symbolic coordinates! We also can get into complications with the typing of symbolic functions.

通过扩展每个基本算术过程，使其能够处理微分对象，几乎不费吹灰之力就能实现前向模式自动微分，这是可扩展泛型威力的一个优美例子。不过，要让它对返回函数值的高阶函数也能正确工作，却很困难。（当然，大多数编写需要自动微分的应用程序的程序员，无须担心这种复杂情况。）One beautiful example of the power of extensible generics is the almost trivial implementation of forward-mode automatic differentiation by extending each primitive arithmetic procedure to handle differential objects. However, making this work correctly with higher-order functions that return functions as values was difficult. (Of course, most programmers writing applications that need automatic differentiation do not need to worry about this complication.)

在我们的系统中，“类型”由一个对该类型元素返回真的谓词表示。为了提高效率，我们引入了谓词注册和标记系统，让我们可以添加类型之间关系的声明。例如，可以让素数集成为整数集的子集，这样，满足用户定义的 prime? 谓词的数，就自动满足 integer? 谓词。In our system the “type” is represented by a predicate that is true of elements of that type. In order to make this efficient we introduced a predicate registration and tagging system that allowed us to add declarations of relationships among the types. For example, we could have prime numbers be a subset of the integers, so numbers that satisfy the user-defined prime? predicate automatically satisfy the integer? predicate.

一旦有了用户定义的类型，并声明了它们之间的子集关系，我们就进入了一个充满新可能性的领域。我们用一个简单却可优雅扩展的冒险游戏展示了这一点。由于泛型过程根据所有参数的类型进行分派，冒险游戏中实体行为的描述就简单得多，也模块化得多；如果先根据第一个参数分派，得到一个根据第二个参数分派的过程，再依次类推，情况就远不如现在。因此，在典型的单分派面向对象系统中，为这些行为建模会更加复杂。Once we have user-defined types with declared subset relationships, we enter a new realm of possibilities. We demonstrated this with a simple but elegantly extensible adventure game. Because our generic procedures dispatch on the types of all of their arguments, the descriptions of the behaviors of the entities in our adventure game are much simpler and more modular than they would be if we dispatched on the first argument to produce a procedure that dispatched on the second argument, and so on. So modeling these behaviors in a typical single-dispatch objectoriented system would be more complicated.

我们使用带标记的数据来高效实现可扩展的泛型过程。数据所带的标记提供了所需信息，用来决定应该使用哪些过程来实现指定的操作。但一旦能够给数据加上标记，标记还可以有其他用途。例如，可以给数据标注其来源、推导方式，或所依据的假设。这类审计轨迹可能有助于访问控制、追踪敏感数据的使用，或调试复杂系统 [128]。因此，除了用标记来确定泛型过程的处理过程以外，能够给任意数据项附加任意标记，本身也蕴含着力量。We used tagged data to efficiently implement extensible generic procedures. The data was tagged with the information required to decide which procedures to use to implement the indicated operations. But once we have the ability to tag data, there are other uses tags can be put to. For example, we may tag data with its provenance, or how it was derived, or the assumptions it was based on. Such audit trails may be useful for access control, for tracing the use of sensitive data, or for debugging complex systems [128]. So there is power in the ability to attach arbitrary tags to any data item, in addition to the use of tags to determine the handlers for generic procedures.

 

1 ODE 是“常微分方程”（ordinary differential equation）的缩写，指只有一个自变量的微分方程。1 ODE means “ordinary differential equation,” meaning a differential equation with a single independent variable.
2 由于预期会改变 MIT/GNU Scheme 系统中许多运算符的含义，我们专门制作了一组运算符，为以后可能需要的基本过程命名。我们给这些副本的名字加了 n: 前缀。在 MIT/GNU Scheme 中，原始基本过程始终以原名存在于 system-global-environment 中，因此我们本来也可以选择从那里获取它们。2 Because we anticipated varying the meanings of many operators in the MIT/GNU Scheme system, we made a special set of operators that name primitive procedures we might need later. We named the copies with the prefix n:. In MIT/GNU Scheme the original primitive procedures are always available, with their original names, in the system-global-environment, so we could have chosen to get them from there.

4 模式匹配4 

Pattern Matching

模式匹配是一种技术，可支持创建领域专用语言以及其他应当具有添加式特性的系统。Pattern matching is a technology that supports the creation of domain-specific languages and other systems that should have an additive character.

模式匹配是相等性测试的推广。在相等性测试中，我们比较两个对象，以确定它们是否具有相同的结构和内容。在模式匹配中，我们推广相等性测试，允许结构和内容的某些部分保持未指定状态。模式精确指定数据的某些部分，但又带有一些“空洞”（模式变量），用来匹配数据中未指定的部分。我们可以对模式变量能够匹配什么施加约束，也可以要求同一个模式变量的多次出现必须匹配同样的东西。Pattern matching is a generalization of equality testing. In equality testing we compare two objects to determine that they have the same structure and contents. In pattern matching, we generalize equality testing to allow some parts of the structure and contents to be unspecified. A pattern specifies certain parts of the data exactly, but it has “holes” (pattern variables) that match the unspecified parts of the data. We may impose constraints on what a pattern variable can match, and we may require that multiple instances of the same pattern variable match the same thing.

模式可以匹配较大数据对象的一部分；匹配所处的上下文并未指定。能够处理部分信息，意味着只有模式中已指定的部分才构成对所匹配数据的假设；对于未指定的部分，则几乎没有或完全没有假设。A pattern can be matched to a part of a larger datum; the context of the match is unspecified. The ability to work with partial information means that only the specified parts of the pattern are assumptions about the data matched; there are few or no assumptions about the unspecified parts.

模式匹配的这一性质，使我们能够构建非常灵活的基于规则的系统。在基于规则的系统中，可以通过添加新规则来添加新功能，不过，如何定义规则以及规则之间如何相互作用，也会带来一些困难。例如，如果有不止一条规则适用，结果就可能取决于应用规则的顺序。我们已经在棋类游戏规则解释器中遇到过规则相互作用的问题。（见第63页的评析。）This property of pattern matching enables the construction of very flexible rule-based systems. In a rule-based system one can add new rules to add new capabilities, though there are difficulties associated with how rules are defined and how they interact with one another. For example, if more than one rule is applicable, the results may depend on the ordering of application. We already encountered problems with the interaction of rules, in the boardgame rule interpreter. (See the critique on page 63.)

除了用模式来匹配满足部分规约的数据之外，模式本身也可以表示部分已知的信息。合并这些模式（合一），可以产生比各个模式单独提供的信息更为具体的信息。Besides the use of patterns to match data that meets a partial specification, patterns can themselves represent partially known information. Merging such patterns (unification) can generate more specific information than the individual patterns contribute.

模式匹配的另一种用途，是作为泛型过程的推广。泛型过程使我们能够通过调节程序中自由变量的含义，做出令人惊叹的事情。可以把使用泛型过程（例如绑定到+的那个过程）的程序，看作是在发布一项任务，征求能够对所提供的实参完成“相加”工作的处理过程。如果提供的实参满足附加处理过程时所给出的谓词，那么附加到泛型过程上的这一处理过程就是适用的。不过，这种发布待办任务的语言相当有限——我们拥有的只是一个符号，在这里就是+。如果改用模式来发布待办任务，再用其他模式来发布可能完成这些任务的过程，就会得到一种丰富得多的语言：模式导向调用。Another use of pattern matching is as a generalization of generic procedures. Generic procedures allow us to do miraculous things by modulating the meanings of the free variables in a program. We may think of the program that employs a generic procedure, such as that bound to +, as advertising for a handler that can do the job of “+ing” the arguments supplied. A handler attached to a generic procedure is applicable if the arguments supplied satisfy the predicates provided when it was attached. But the language for advertising jobs that need to be done is rather limited—all we have is a single symbol, in this case +. If we instead use patterns to advertise jobs to be done and other patterns to advertise procedures that might do those jobs, we have a much richer language: pattern-directed invocation.

4.1 模式4.1 Patterns

代数的基本定律可以表述为模式之间的等价关系：The elementary laws of algebra can be expressed as equivalence of patterns:

这就是乘法对加法的分配律。它表明，我们可以用一侧替换另一侧，而不改变表达式的值。定律的每一侧都是一个模式，其中包含模式变量a、b和c，以及模式常量×和+。这条定律说，如果找到一个代数表达式，它是某个东西与一个和式的乘积，就可以把它替换为两个乘积的和，反之亦然。This is the distributive law of multiplication over addition. It says that we can replace one side with the other without changing the value of the expression. Each side of the law is a pattern, with pattern variables a, b, and c, and pattern constants × and +. What the law says is that if we find an algebraic expression that is the product of something and a sum of terms, we can replace it with a sum of two products, and vice versa.

让我们看看如何基于模式匹配来组织程序。这里的一个关键思想，是把模式编译成构成匹配器各个部件的组合子。在Let's see how to organize programs based on pattern matching. A key idea here will be compilation of patterns into combinators that are the pieces of a matcher. In 第4.2节section 4.2中，我们将用一个初等代数的项重写系统来演示这一点。 we will demonstrate this in a term-rewriting system for elementary algebra.

一种模式语言A Language of Patterns

首要任务是设计我们的模式语言。我们先从简单的东西入手，用Lisp（Scheme）列表来构造模式。与上面的数学例子不同，我们不会保留诸如乘号和+这样的符号，因此必须区分模式变量与模式常量。模式变量可以用以问号符号?开头的列表表示。这是一种传统选择。因此，假设我们操作的是Lisp前缀数学表达式，那么组成分配律的模式，在这种语言中可以表示如下：The first job is to make up our language of patterns. We will start with something simple. We will make our patterns out of Lisp (Scheme) lists. Unlike the mathematical example above, we will not have reserved symbols, such as and +, so we will have to distinguish pattern variables from pattern constants. A pattern variable can be represented by a list beginning with the query symbol, ?. This is a traditional choice. So in this language the patterns that make up the distributive law may be represented as follows, assuming that we are manipulating Lisp prefix mathematical expressions:

(* (? a) (+ (? b) (? c)))

(+ (* (? a) (? b)) (* (? a) (? c)))

你可能会抱怨，我们本可以使用?a这样的特殊符号，而不是冗长的(? a)。这样做当然可以，但这种选择会让扩展稍微困难一些，例如，当我们想要一个只能匹配数的变量时。当然，如果确实有帮助，之后也可以添加语法，不过请记住Alan Perlis的箴言：“语法糖会导致分号癌。”采用这种简单的列表表示，只需把描述限制的谓词添加到列表表示中，就能把模式变量(? a)限制为只能匹配数：(? a ,number?)。You might complain that we could have used distinguished symbols, such as ?a instead of the long-winded (? a). That would be fine, but that choice would make it a bit harder to extend, say if we want a variable that is restricted to match only numbers. Of course, we can add syntax later if it is helpful, but remember Alan Perlis's maxim: “Syntactic sugar causes cancer of the semicolon.” With our simple list representation we are able to restrict the pattern variable (? a) to match only numbers by adding the predicate describing the restriction to its list representation: (? a ,number?).

对匹配器设计的一项约束是，上面的第二个模式应当能够匹配One constraint on our design of the matcher is that the second pattern above should match

(+ (* (cos x) (exp y)) (* (cos x) (sin z)))

其中，a=(cos x)、b=(exp y)、c=(sin z)。where a=(cos x), b=(exp y), and c=(sin z).

但它不应当匹配But it should not match

(+ (* (cos x) (exp y)) (* (cos (+ x y)) (sin z)))

因为无法为(? a)作出一致的赋值，除非以某种方式使得x=(+ x y)。1我们将在because there is no consistent assignment possible for (? a), unless, somehow, x=(+ x y).1 We will learn about that sort of situation when we study unification matching in 第4.4节section 4.4研究合一匹配时了解这类情形；在这里，我们认定不可能匹配。; here we will decide that there is no match possible.

对匹配器的另一项约束，是必须能够匹配列表中数目未知的连续元素，这将对其结构产生重要影响。例如，假设我们想制定一条规则，把正弦平方与余弦平方的和替换为1，即使它们在和式中并不相邻：Another constraint on the matcher, which will have an important influence on its structure, is the need to match an unknown number of consecutive elements in a list. For example, suppose we want to make a rule to replace a sum of squares of a sine and a cosine with 1, even if they are not consecutive in the sum:

(+ ... (expt (sin theta) 2) ... (expt (cos theta) 2) ...)

(+ 1 ... ... ...)

这里的..可以代表许多项。我们将使用以前缀??书写的片段变量来匹配多个项。因此，要写出的模式是：The ... here may stand for many terms. We will use a segment variable, written with the prefix ??, to match many terms. So the pattern we will write is:

(+ (?? t1)

   (expt (sin (? x)) 2)

   (?? t2)

   (expt (cos (? x)) 2)

   (?? t3))

这里需要三个片段变量。片段变量(?? t1)匹配正弦项之前的各项，(?? t2)匹配正弦项与余弦项之间的各项，而(?? t3)匹配余弦项之后的各项。We needed three segment variables here. The segment variable (?? t1) will match the terms before the sine term, (?? t2) will match the terms between the sine term and the cosine term, and (?? t3) will match the terms after the cosine term.

片段变量有着深远的影响，因为在找到下一个能够匹配的部分之前，我们并不知道片段有多长，而且同一个数据对象可能有多种匹配方式。例如，同一个和式中，可能同时含有两个不同角度的正弦平方和余弦平方。更简单地说，模式Segment variables have a profound effect, because we don't know how long a segment is until we find the next part that matches, and we may be able to match the same data item many ways. For example, there may be squares of both sines and cosines of two different angles in the same sum. Even simpler, the pattern

(a (?? x) (?? y) (?? x) c)

可以匹配数据can match the datum

(a b b b b b b c)

且有四种不同方式。（注意，片段变量x在模式中出现的两个位置，必须吞掉相同数目的b。）因此，匹配器必须在片段变量的可能赋值空间中进行搜索。in four different ways. (Notice that the segment variable x must eat up the same number of bs in the two places it appears in the pattern.) So the matcher must do a search over the space of possible assignments to the segment variables.

4.2 项重写4.2 Term rewriting

项重写系统是创建领域专用语言的强大工具，这类语言用于操作类似表达式的信息。如果我们有一个表达式语法系统，需要把某些子表达式替换为“等价”的子表达式，那么通常可以用基于规则的项重写系统来描述这些变换。例如，许多编译器优化都可以表述为：在较大的上下文中，对程序片段进行局部重写。项重写系统的基本特征，是使用模式匹配器识别待变换的信息，再用模板系统实例化替换内容。关于如何从等式理论（“等价”表达式组成的系统）构造收敛的项重写系统，已有大量研究[72]，但这里不作探讨。另外，用于匹配的模式与用于实例化的模板在表面上有些相似，这可能令人想到构建双向规则的可能性；我们也不会研究这一点。首先，我们开发一个简单的单向系统，用模式识别输入，用模板生成输出。Term-rewriting systems are powerful tools for creating domain-specific languages for manipulating expression-like information. If we have a syntactic system of expressions, where we may need to replace some subexpressions with “equivalent” subexpressions, we can often use a rule-based term-rewriting system to describe those transformations. For example, many compiler optimizations can be expressed as local rewrites of program fragments in a larger context. The essential features of a term-rewriting system are the use of a pattern matcher to identify the information to be transformed, and a template system for instantiating the replacement. There has been extensive research [72] into the problem of constructing convergent term-rewriting systems from equational theories (systems of “equivalent” expressions), but we won't get into that here. Also, there is a superficial similarity between the patterns matched against and the templates for instantiation, which may suggest the possibility of making bidirectional rules; we won't look at that either. First we develop a simple unidirectional system, in which patterns are used to recognize inputs and templates are used to make outputs.

下面是若干代数化简规则的近似表述：Here is an approximation to some algebraic simplification rules:

(define algebra-1

  (rule-simplifier

    (list

    ;; Associative law of addition

    (rule ’(+ (? a) (+ (? b) (? c)))

          ‘(+ (+ ,a ,b) ,c))

    ;; Commutative law of multiplication

    (rule ’(* (? b) (? a))

          (and (expr<? a b)

               ‘(* ,a ,b)))

    ;; Distributive law of multiplication over addition

    (rule ’(* (? a) (+ (? b) (? c)))

          ‘(+ (* ,a ,b) (* ,a ,c))))))

algebra-1中有三条规则。第一条实现加法结合律，第二条实现乘法交换律，第三条实现乘法对加法的分配律。There are three rules in algebra-1. The first rule implements the associative law of addition, the second implements the commutative law of multiplication, and the third implements the distributive law of multiplication over addition.

每条规则由两部分组成：用于匹配子表达式的模式，以及后件表达式。如果模式匹配成功，就对后件求值。如果后件的值为#f，则该规则不适用。否则，用求值结果替换匹配到的子表达式。注意，我们使用第391页介绍的反引号机制，简化后件表达式的书写。Each rule is composed of two parts: a pattern to match a subexpression, and a consequent expression. If the pattern matches, the consequent is evaluated. If the value of the consequent is #f the rule is not applicable. Otherwise the result of the evaluation replaces the matched subexpression. Notice that we use the backquote mechanism described on page 391 to simplify writing the consequent expression.

这些规则被汇集到一个列表中，交给rule-simplifier过程。得到的结果是一个化简器过程，可以将它应用于代数表达式。The rules are gathered in a list for the rule-simplifier procedure. The result is a simplifier procedure that can be applied to an algebraic expression.

(algebra-1 ’(* (+ y (+ z w)) x))

(+ (+ (* x y) (* x z)) (* w x))

注意交换律规则的后件中的限制谓词expr<?：Notice the restriction predicate, expr<?, in the consequent of the rule for the commutative law:

(rule ’(* (? b) (? a))

      (and (expr<? a b)

           ‘(* ,a ,b)))

如果后件表达式返回#f，就认为这次匹配失败。系统回溯到匹配器中，寻找另一种匹配；如果找不到，该规则就不适用。在交换律中，限制谓词expr<?为代数表达式规定了一种次序。设置这一限制的原因留作练习4.1。If the consequent expression returns #f, that match is considered to have failed. The system backtracks into the matcher to look for an alternative match; if none are forthcoming, the rule is not applicable. In the commutative law the restriction predicate expr<? imposes an ordering on algebraic expressions. The reason for this restriction is left as exercise 4.1.

练习4.1：守卫表达式Exercise 4.1: Guard expressions

为什么交换律中必须有(expr<? a b)这一限制？如果没有这一限制，会出什么问题？Why is the (expr<? a b) restriction necessary in the commutative law? What would go wrong if there were no restriction?

4.2.1 代数中的片段变量4.2.1 Segment variables in algebra

algebra-2规则系统有趣得多。构建它时，假设加法与乘法都是n元运算。要做到这一点，需要片段变量。我们还在变量限制中使用number?谓词，以支持数值化简规则。The algebra-2 rule system is far more interesting. It is built with the assumption that addition and multiplication are n-ary operations. We need segment variables to make this work. We also use the number? predicate in variable restrictions to support rules for numerical simplification.

(define algebra-2

  (rule-simplifier

   (list

    ;; Sums

    (rule ‘(+ (? a))

          a)                    ; unary + is identity

    (rule ‘(+ (?? a) (+ (?? b)) (?? c))

          ‘(+ ,@a ,@b ,@c))     ; associative: use n-ary + 

    (rule ‘(+ (?? a) (? y) (? x) (?? b))

          (and (expr<? x y)     ; commutative

               ‘(+ ,@a ,x ,y ,@b)))



    ;; Products

    (rule ‘(* (? a))

          a)                    ; unary * is identity

    (rule ‘(* (?? a) (* (?? b)) (?? c))

          ‘(* ,@a ,@b ,@c))     ; associative: use n-ary *

    (rule ‘(* (?? a) (? y) (? x) (?? b))

          (and (expr<? x y)     ; commutative

               ‘(* ,@a ,x ,y ,@b)))



    ;; Distributive law

    (rule ‘(* (?? a) (+ (?? b)) (?? c))

          ‘(+ ,@(map (lambda (x) ‘(* ,@a ,x ,@c)) b)))



    ;; Numerical simplifications

   (rule  ‘(+ 0 (?? x))

          ‘(+ ,@x))

    (rule ‘(+ (? x ,number?) (? y ,number?) (?? z))

          ‘(+ ,(+ x y) ,@z))

    (rule ‘(* 0 (?? x))

          0)

    (rule ‘(* 1 (?? x))

          ‘(* ,@x))

    (rule ‘(* (? x ,number?) (? y ,number?) (?? z))

          ‘(* ,(* x y) ,@z))

    )))

借助algebra-2，除了处理和与积的多个实参，我们还实现了一些数值化简。注意，除了用反引号机制构造后件表达式外，我们还用它来构造模式，使模式包含作为变量限制的谓词number?。要进一步理解化简器，参见练习4.2。With algebra-2 we implement some numerical simplifications, in addition to dealing with multiple arguments to sums and products. Notice that we used the backquote mechanism to build patterns that include the predicate number? as restrictions on the variables, in addition to its use for constructing the consequent expressions. For further understanding of the simplifier, see exercise 4.2.

现在，我们可以得到以下结果：Now we can get these results:

(algebra-2 ’(* (+ y (+ z w)) x))

(+ (* w x) (* x y) (* x z))



(algebra-2 ’(+ (* 3 (+ x 1)) -3))

(* 3 x)

至此，我们可以看出，如何有可能扩展这样的系统，使它能够化简范围广泛的代数表达式。At this point we can see how it may be possible to extend such a system to simplify large classes of algebraic expressions.

练习4.2：项的排序Exercise 4.2: Term ordering

按照谓词expr<?，一个明确为数的表达式，小于任何不是明确为数的表达式。According to the predicate expr<?, an expression that is explicitly a number is less than any expression that is not explicitly a number.

  1. a. 在algebra-2中，交换律对表达式施加的次序，如何使数值化简规则得以发挥作用？a. In algebra-2 how does the ordering on expressions imposed by the commutative laws make the numerical simplification rules effective?
  2. b. 假设交换律没有强制规定次序。我们将不得不如何表述数值化简规则？解释为什么数值化简会变得代价高昂。b. Suppose that the commutative laws did not force an ordering. How would we have to express the numerical simplification rules? Explain why numerical simplification would become very expensive.

练习4.3：排序效率Exercise 4.3: Sorting efficiency

交换律中的排序，会演化出一个对和式中的项及乘积中的因子进行的n2阶冒泡排序。如果项很多，如在一个真正的代数问题中，这种情况会变得相当糟糕。在这个系统中，有没有办法实现更高效的排序？如果没有，为什么？如果有，你会如何安排？The ordering in the commutative laws evolves an order n2 bubble sort on the terms of a sum and the factors of a product. This can get pretty bad if there are many terms, as in a serious algebra problem. Is there some way in this system to make a more efficient sort? If not, why not? If so, how would you arrange it?

我们所描述的系统不会合并同类项。例如：The system we have described does not collect like terms. For example:

(+ (* 3 x) (* 4 x))

构造一个新系统algebra-3，其中包含能够合并同类项的规则，使结果保持为各项之和。演示你的解决方案。你的方案必须能够处理如下问题：Make a new system algebra-3 that includes rules that cause the collection of like terms, leaving the result as a sum of terms. Demonstrate your solution. Your solution must be able to handle problems like

(algebra-3

  ’(+ y (* x -2 w) (* x 4 y) (* w x) z (* 5 z) (* x w) (* x y 3)))

4.2.2 规则系统的实现4.2.2 Implementation of rule systems

既然我们对使用基于模式的规则系统已经有了一些经验，现在就深入看看它如何工作。Now that we have some experience with the use of a pattern-based rule system, let's dive in to see how it works.

我们把规则实现为一个过程，用规则的模式匹配给定表达式。如果匹配成功，规则就在一个将模式变量绑定到所匹配数据的环境中，对其后件求值。规则过程接受成功续延和失败续延，可用它们回溯到规则的后件部分或模式匹配部分。2We implement a rule as a procedure that matches the rule's pattern against a given expression. If the match succeeds, the rule evaluates its consequent in an environment in which the pattern variables are bound to their matched data. Rule procedures take success and failure continuations that can be used to backtrack into the consequent or pattern-match part of a rule.2

上面使用的rule-simplifier过程，是一个简单递归化简器的构造器。它生成过程simplify-expression，该过程接受一个表达式，并用这些规则化简表达式。它先递归地化简表达式的所有子表达式，再应用规则化简所得表达式。它反复执行这一过程，直到过程收敛。因此，返回的表达式是化简过程的一个不动点。The rule-simplifier procedure used above is a constructor for a simple recursive simplifier. It produces simplify-expression, a procedure that takes an expression and uses the rules to simplify the expression. It recursively simplifies all the subexpressions of an expression and then applies the rules to simplify the resulting expression. It does this repeatedly until the process converges. Thus the expression returned is a fixed point of the simplification process.

(define (rule-simplifier the-rules)

  (define (simplify-expression expression)

    (let ((subexpressions-simplified

           (if (list? expression)

               (map simplify-expression expression)

               expression)))

      (try-rules subexpressions-simplified the-rules

        (lambda (result fail)   ; A: success continuation

          (simplify-expression result))

        (lambda ()              ; B: failure continuation

          subexpressions-simplified))))

  simplify-expression)

过程try-rules只是扫描规则列表，通过succeed和fail续延安排扫描的执行顺序。The procedure try-rules just scans the list of rules, sequencing the scan by means of the succeed and fail continuations.

(define (try-rules data rules succeed fail)

  (let per-rule ((rules rules))

    (if (null? rules)

        (fail)               ; out of rules: go to B above

        (try-rule data

                  (car rules)

                  succeed    ; if rule succeeds go to A above

                  (lambda () ; if rule fails try other rules

                    (per-rule (cdr rules)))))))



(define (try-rule data rule succeed fail)

  (rule data succeed fail))

规则的构造由过程make-rule实现，它接受一个规则模式，以及一个实现后件表达式的处理过程。例如，第161页上的交换律规则，可以直接用make-rule构造：Rule construction is implemented by the procedure make-rule, which takes a rule pattern and a handler that implements the consequent expression. For example, the commutative law rule on page 161 can be made directly with make-rule:

(make-rule ’(* (? b) (? a))

  (lambda (b a)

    (and (expr<? a b)

         ‘(* ,a ,b))))

处理过程(lambda (b a) ...)需要从匹配器过程生成的字典中，取得名为a和b的模式变量的值，作为实参。规则按照这些值对应的变量在模式中出现的顺序，把这些值组成列表，再将处理过程应用于该列表。因此，编写处理过程时，形参必须按照这一顺序排列。The handler (lambda (b a) ...) needs to get arguments that are the values of the pattern variables named a and b from the dictionary produced by the matcher procedure. The rule applies the handler to a list of these values in the order in which they appear in the pattern. Thus the handler must be written with its parameters in that order.

规则构造器make-rule把模式编译成匹配过程。它返回的规则是一个过程，使用这一匹配过程来匹配数据。如果匹配成功，规则就把处理过程应用于匹配所得的模式变量值。The rule constructor make-rule compiles the pattern into a match procedure. The rule it returns is a procedure that uses that match procedure to match the data. If the match succeeds, the rule applies the handler to values of the pattern variables resulting from the match.

我们将在We will learn how a pattern is compiled into a match procedure in 第4.3节section 4.3学习如何把模式编译成匹配过程；在这里，只需知道，可以用run-matcher运行匹配过程，而且如果匹配成功，就会以一个字典为实参，调用传给run-matcher的第三个实参。字典dict把模式变量映射到它们所匹配的子表达式。如果匹配失败，run-matcher就返回#f，规则也随之失败。; all we need to know here is that the match procedure can be run using run-matcher and that if the match succeeds, the third argument to run-matcher is called with a dictionary. The dictionary dict is a mapping of pattern variables to the subexpressions that they were matched against. If the match fails, run-matcher returns #f, and the rule fails.

(define (make-rule pattern handler)

  (let ((match-procedure (match:compile-pattern pattern)))

    (define (the-rule data succeed fail)

      (or (run-matcher match-procedure data

            (lambda (dict)

              (let ((result

                     (apply handler

                            (match:all-values dict))))

                (and result

                     (succeed result

                              (lambda () #f))))))

          (fail)))

    the-rule))

过程match:all-values按照模式变量在模式中出现的顺序，返回它们的值。The procedure match:all-values returns the values of the pattern variables in the order in which they appear in the pattern.

4.2.3 旁话：神奇的宏技术4.2.3 Aside: Magic macrology

比较第161页给出的规则定义：Compare the rule definition given on page 161:

(rule ’(* (? b) (? a))

      (and (expr<? a b)

           ‘(* ,a ,b)))

与make-rule所需的实参：with what make-rule needs for its arguments:

(make-rule ’(* (? b) (? a))

  (lambda (b a)

    (and (expr<? a b)

         ‘(* ,a ,b))))

名称a和b被重复书写：它们既出现在模式中，也以相同的顺序出现在处理过程的形参列表中。这写起来既令人厌烦，又容易出错，因为必须记得重复这些名称，而重复错误或顺序错误都会造成失误。The names a and b are repeated: they occur both in the pattern and in the parameter list of the handler, in the same order. This is both obnoxious to write and error-prone, because we must remember to repeat the names, and we can make a mistake if we repeat them incorrectly or in the wrong order.

这种情况适合使用语法抽象，也就是宏。下面这段相当神奇的代码，把规则定义转换成所需的make-rule调用：This is a case for syntactic abstraction, otherwise known as a macro. The following rather magical code fragment transforms the rule definition into the desired call to make-rule:

(define-syntax rule

  (er-macro-transformer

   (lambda (form rename compare)

     (let ((pattern (cadr form))

          (handler-body (caddr form))

          (r-make-rule (rename 'make-rule))

          (r-lambda (rename ’lambda)))

      ‘(,r-make-rule ,pattern

                     (,r-lambda

                      ,(match:pattern-names pattern)

                      ,handler-body))))))

我们至少可以用下面这道神奇的咒语，来部分检查这个宏；它会展开表达式中出现的宏：We can at least partially check this macro with the following magic incantation that expands the macros that appear in an expression:

(pp (syntax ’(rule ’(* (? b) (? a))

                   (and (expr<? a b)

                        ‘(* ,a ,b)))

            (the-environment)))

(make-rule ’(* (? b) (? a))

           (lambda (b a)

             (and (expr<? a b)

                  (list ’* a b))))

可以看到，规则被展开为一个以模式及其处理过程为实参的make-rule调用。正是对这个表达式求值，才构造出规则。在较为传统的语言中，像rule这样的宏会直接展开成代码，用以替换宏调用。然而，这个过程并不具有引用透明性，因为宏展开可能使用与用户所用符号冲突的符号。在Scheme中，我们设法避免这一问题，允许用户编写不会引起冲突的卫生宏。但这比简单地用一个表达式替换另一个表达式复杂得多。这里不打算解释这些问题或解决方案，只使用MIT/GNU Scheme参考手册[51]中介绍的解决方案。We see that the rule expands into a call to make-rule with the pattern and its handler procedure. This is the expression that is evaluated to make the rule. In more conventional languages, a macro, such as rule, expands directly into code that is substituted for the macro call. However, this process is not referentially transparent, because the macro expansion may use symbols that conflict with the user's symbols. In Scheme we try to avoid this problem, allowing a user to write hygienic macros that cannot cause conflicts. But this is more complicated than just substituting one expression for another. We will not try to explain the problems or the solutions here, but we will just use the solutions described in the MIT/GNU Scheme reference manual [51].

4.2.4 模式导向调用4.2.4 Pattern-directed invocation

规则执行器try-rules，也可以用于实现根据输入属性、使用模式进行分派的过程。模式运算符的实参与该模式运算符的规则模式进行匹配。匹配规则的后件计算应返回的值。The rule executive, try-rules, can also be used to implement procedures that use patterns for dispatching on input properties. The arguments to a pattern operator are matched against the pattern operator's rule pattern. The consequent of the matching rule computes the value to be returned.

例如，我们可以编写传统的阶乘过程，将条件判断分散如下：For example, we could write the traditional factorial procedure, distributing the conditional as follows:

(define factorial

  (make-pattern-operator

   (rule ’(0) 1)

   (rule ‘((? n ,positive?))

         (* n (factorial (- n 1))))))



(factorial 10)

3628800

我们还可以用这一机制构造行为取决于所提供实参数目的过程。例如，Lisp的-运算符应用于一个实参时表示取负，应用于多个实参时表示减法：We could also use this mechanism to build procedures whose behavior depends on the number of arguments supplied. For example, the Lisp - operator is negation when applied to one argument and subtraction when applied to multiple arguments:

(define -

  (make-pattern-operator

   (rule ’((? x)) (n:- 0 x))

   (rule ’((? x) (?? y)) (n:- x (apply n:+ y)))))

我们可以允许通过动态添加规则来扩展模式运算符。这些模式运算符类似于泛型过程，允许程序员把规则定义分散到不同位置。例如，在窥孔优化器中，我们可能希望把各种优化分别与编译器代码生成器的不同部分组织在一起。We can allow a pattern operator to be extended with additional rules dynamically. Such pattern operators are analogous to generic procedures, allowing the programmer to distribute the rule definitions nonlocally. For example, in a peephole optimizer we may want to group various optimizations with different parts of the code generator of a compiler.

(define peephole (make-pattern-operator))



(attach-rule! peephole

  (rule ’((push (? reg1))

          (pop (? reg2)))

        (if (eqv? reg1 reg2)

            ’()

            ‘((move ,reg1 ,reg2)))))



(attach-rule! peephole

  (rule ‘((or (? reg) (? const1 ,unsigned-integer?))

          (or (? reg) (? const2 ,unsigned-integer?)))

        ‘((or ,reg

              ,(bitwise-or const1 const2)))))

第一条规则可以放在优化器的控制结构部分，第二条规则则可以与优化器的逻辑运算部分放在一起。The first rule could be in the control-structure part of the optimizer, and the second rule could be located with the logical arithmetic part of the optimizer.

下面是实现模式运算符的一种方法。传给make-pattern-operator的最后一条规则是默认规则。无论之后再添加什么其他规则，它总是最后才被尝试。Here is one way to implement pattern operators. The last rule passed to make-pattern-operator is the default rule. It is always tried last, no matter what other rules may be added later.

(define (make-pattern-operator . rules)

  (let ((rules

         (cons ’rules

               (if (pair? rules)

                   (except-last-pair rules)

                   ’())))

        (default-rule

         (and (pair? rules)

              (last rules))))

    (define (the-operator . data)

      (define (succeed value fail) value)

      (define (fail)

        (error "No applicable operations:" data))

      (try-rules data

                 (cdr rules)

                 succeed

                 (if default-rule

                     (lambda ()

                       (try-rule data

                                 default-rule

                                 succeed

                                 fail))

                     fail)))

    (set-pattern-metadata! the-operator rules)

    the-operator))

我们用set-pattern-metadata!把规则列表作为一张“便笺”附加到运算符上，并在下面的代码中用pattern-metadata取回它。我们提供了把规则添加到运算符规则列表前端（override-rule!）或末尾（attach-rule!）的过程：We use set-pattern-metadata! to attach the rule list as a “sticky note” to an operator, and we use pattern-metadata to retrieve it in the code below. We have procedures to add a rule to the front (override-rule!) or to the end (attach-rule!) of an operator's rule list:

(define (attach-rule! operator rule)

  (let ((metadata (pattern-metadata operator)))

    (set-cdr! metadata

              (append (cdr metadata)

                      (list rule)))))



(define (override-rule! operator rule)

  (let ((metadata (pattern-metadata operator)))

    (set-cdr! metadata

              (cons rule (cdr metadata)))))

4.3 匹配器的设计4.3 Design of the matcher

既然已经见识了模式匹配的部分威力，接下来就探索它如何工作。我们的匹配器由一组匹配过程（或称匹配器），以及将它们组合成复合匹配器的若干组合子构建而成。3模式的每个基本元素由一个基本匹配器表示，而唯一的组合方式——列表——则由一个组合子表示，它把各列表元素的匹配器组合为一个复合匹配器。所有匹配过程都接受三个实参：包含待匹配数据的列表、模式变量绑定的字典，以及匹配成功时应调用的续延过程（succeed）。传给succeed的实参，必须是匹配产生的新字典，以及从输入列表中消耗的项目数。这个数用于在片段匹配返回后，确定从哪里继续。若匹配不成功，匹配过程就返回#f。Now that we have seen some of the power of pattern matching, we will explore how it works. Our matcher is constructed from a family of match procedures (or matchers), and some combinators that combine them to produce compound matchers.3 Each primitive element of the pattern is represented by a primitive matcher, and the only combination, list, is represented by a combinator that combines matchers for the list elements to make a compound one. All match procedures take three arguments: a list containing data to be matched, a dictionary of bindings of pattern variables, and a continuation procedure (succeed) to be called if the match is successful. The arguments to succeed must be the new dictionary resulting from the match and the number of items that were consumed from the input list. This number will be used for determining where to proceed after a segment match returns. A match procedure returns #f if the match is unsuccessful.

共有三个基本匹配过程和一个组合子。我们逐一来看。还需要一个小过程，可以把它作为succeed实参传给匹配过程，用来报告结果：There are three primitive match procedures and one combinator. Let's go through them. We will also need a small procedure that we can pass to a match procedure as its succeed argument to report the result:

(define (result-receiver dict n-eaten)

  ‘(success ,(match:bindings dict) ,n-eaten))

模式常量Pattern constants

过程match:eqv接受一个模式常量，例如x，并生成匹配过程eqv-match；当且仅当第一个数据项与模式常量相等（使用eqv?判断）时，该过程成功。它不会向字典中添加内容。传给succeed的第二个实参是匹配的项目数，对于这个匹配过程，该数为1。The procedure match:eqv takes a pattern constant, such as x, and produces a match procedure, eqv-match, that succeeds if and only if the first data item is equal (using eqv?) to the pattern constant. It does not add to the dictionary. The second argument to succeed is the number of items matched, which is 1 for this match procedure.

(define (match:eqv pattern-constant)

  (define (eqv-match data dictionary succeed)

    (and (pair? data)

         (eqv? (car data) pattern-constant)

         (succeed dictionary 1)))

  eqv-match)

例如：For example:

(define x-matcher (match:eqv ’x))



(x-matcher ’(x) (match:new-dict) result-receiver)

(success () 1)



(x-matcher ’(y) (match:new-dict) result-receiver)

#f

元素变量Element variables

过程match:element用于为(? x)这样的模式变量构造匹配过程element-match，该变量旨在匹配单个项目。The procedure match:element is used to make a match procedure, element-match, for a pattern variable, such as (? x), that is intended to match a single item.

匹配元素变量时有两种可能：元素变量已经有值，或尚未有值。如果变量有值，它就在字典中有绑定。这种情况下，当且仅当绑定的值与第一个数据项相等（使用equal?判断）时，匹配成功。如果变量没有值，它就尚未绑定。这种情况下，匹配成功，并通过添加从该变量到第一个数据项的绑定来扩展字典。无论是哪一种成功情况，我们都指明消耗的项目数为1。When matching an element variable there are two possibilities: either the element variable already has a value or it does not yet have a value. If the variable has a value, it is bound in the dictionary. In that case the match succeeds if and only if the binding's value is equal (using equal?) to the first data item. If the variable does not have a value, it is not bound. In that case the match succeeds, extending the dictionary by adding a binding of the variable to the first data item. In either case of success, we indicate that the number of items consumed is 1.

(define (match:element variable)

  (define (element-match data dictionary succeed)

    (and (pair? data)

         (let ((binding (match:lookup variable dictionary)))

           (if binding

               (and (equal? (match:binding-value binding)

                            (car data))

                    (succeed dictionary 1))

               (succeed (match:extend-dict variable

                                           (car data)

                                           dictionary)

                        1)))))

  element-match)

下面是一些例子。匹配绑定是一个列表：第一个元素是变量名，第二个元素是值，第三个元素是变量类型（这里全都是?元素变量）。Here are some examples. A match binding is a list: the first element is the variable name; the second element is the value; and the third element is the variable's type (here all are ? element variables).

((match:element ’(? x))

’(a) (match:new-dict) result-receiver)

(success ((x a ?)) 1)



((match:element ’(? x))

’(a b) (match:new-dict) result-receiver)

(success ((x a ?)) 1)



((match:element ’(? x))

’((a b) c) (match:new-dict) result-receiver)

(success ((x (a b) ?)) 1)

片段变量Segment variables

过程match:segment用于为(?? x)这样的模式变量构造匹配过程segment-match，该变量旨在匹配一系列项目。片段变量匹配器比元素变量匹配器复杂，因为它能够消耗数目未知的数据项。因此，片段匹配器不仅必须把新字典告知调用者，还必须告知从数据中吞掉了多少个项目。The procedure match:segment is used to make a match procedure, segment-match, for a pattern variable, such as (?? x), that is intended to match a sequence of items. A segment-variable matcher is more complicated than an element-variable matcher because it can consume an unknown number of data items. Thus a segment matcher must inform its caller not only of the new dictionary, but also of how many items from the data were eaten.

匹配片段变量时有两种可能：片段变量已经有值，或尚未有值。如果片段变量有值，该值必须与数据匹配；这一点由第174页的match:segment-equal?检查。如果片段变量尚未有值，就必须给它一个值。When matching a segment variable there are two possibilities: either the segment variable already has a value or it does not yet have a value. If the segment variable has a value, the value must match the data; this is checked by match:segment-equal? on page 174. If the segment variable does not yet have a value, it must be given one.

由match:segment返回的匹配器segment-match，以数据的某个起始子列表(list-head data i)作为片段变量的一种可能赋值而成功。（它从i=0开始，假设该片段不吞掉任何数据项。）然而，如果这次成功导致后续匹配失败，片段匹配器就尝试比之前多吞掉一个元素（通过执行(lp (+ i 1))）。如果片段匹配器用尽了数据项，就匹配失败。这是存在片段变量时所需的回溯搜索的关键。The matcher, segment-match, returned by match:segment, succeeds with some initial sublist of the data, (list-head data i), as a possible assignment to the segment variable. (It starts with i=0, assuming that the segment will eat no items from the data.) However, if that success leads to a later failure in the match, the segment matcher tries to eat one more element than it had already tried (by executing (lp (+ i 1))). If the segment matcher runs out of data items, it fails to match. This is the key to the backtracking search that is needed when there are segment variables.

(define (match:segment variable)

  (define (segment-match data dictionary succeed)

    (and (list? data)

         (let ((binding (match:lookup variable dictionary)))

           (if binding

               (match:segment-equal?

                data

                (match:binding-value binding)

                (lambda (n) (succeed dictionary n)))

               (let ((n (length data)))

                 (let lp ((i 0))

                   (and (<= i n)

                        (or (succeed (match:extend-dict

                                     variable

                                     (list-head data i)

                                     dictionary)

                                    i)

                           (lp (+ i 1))))))))))

  segment-match)

例如：For example:

((match:segment ’(?? a))

 ’(z z z) (match:new-dict) result-receiver)

(success ((a () ??)) 0)

当然，长度为零的片段也是允许的。Of course, a zero-length segment is okay.

如果想看到所有可能的匹配，我们可以修改结果接收过程，使其在打印成功结果后返回#f。这样就会促使匹配器过程在可能的情况下，找出另一个值。If we want to see all of the possible matches, we change the result receiver to return #f after printing the successful result. This causes the matcher procedure to come up with an alternative value, if possible.

(define (print-all-results dict n-eaten)

  (pp ‘(success ,(match:bindings dict) ,n-eaten))

  ;; by returning #f we force backtracking.

  #f)



((match:segment ’(?? a))

 ’(z z z) (match:new-dict) print-all-results)

(success ((a () ??)) 0)

(success ((a (z) ??)) 1)

(success ((a (z z) ??)) 2)

(success ((a (z z z) ??)) 3)

#f

现在回到片段变量已经有值的情形，我们需要确保这个值能够匹配数据的一个起始片段。这由match:segment-equal?处理。它逐一比较该值的元素与数据中的元素。如果比较成功，就以从数据中消耗的元素数（必定等于该值的长度）为实参，调用ok（作为第三个实参传给它的过程）并返回；否则返回#f。Now, returning to the case of a segment variable that already has a value, we need to make sure that the value matches an initial segment of the data. This is handled by match:segment-equal?. It compares the elements of the value against the data. If that works, it returns by calling ok (the procedure passed as its third argument) with the number of elements consumed from the data (which must be the length of the value); otherwise it returns #f.

(define (match:segment-equal? data value ok)

  (let lp ((data data) (value value) (n 0))

    (cond ((pair? value)

           (if (and (pair? data)

                    (equal? (car data) (car value)))

               (lp (cdr data) (cdr value) (+ n 1))

               #f))

           ((null? value) (ok n))

           (else #f))))

匹配列表Matching lists

最后是match:list组合子，它接受一个匹配过程列表，构造出一个匹配过程；当且仅当所给匹配器吞掉数据列表中的全部元素时，该过程才匹配这个数据列表。它依次应用各个匹配器。每个匹配器会告诉列表组合子，在把剩余数据传给下一个匹配器之前，应跳过多少个项目。Finally, there is the match:list combinator, which takes a list of match procedures and makes a match procedure that matches a data list if and only if the given matchers eat up all of the elements in the data list. It applies the matchers in succession. Each matcher tells the list combinator how many items to jump over before passing the remaining data to the next matcher.

(define (match:list matchers)

  (define (list-match data dictionary succeed)

    (and (pair? data)

         (let lp ((data-list (car data))

                  (matchers matchers)

                 (dictionary dictionary))

           (cond ((pair? matchers)

                  ((car matchers)

                   data-list

                   dictionary

                   (lambda (new-dictionary n)

                     ;; The essence of list matching:

                     (lp (list-tail data-list n)

                         (cdr matchers)

                         new-dictionary))))

                 ((pair? data-list) #f)  ;unmatched data

                 ((null? data-list) (succeed dictionary 1))

                 (else #f)))))

  list-match)

注意，match:list组合子返回的匹配器list-match，与其他匹配器具有完全相同的接口，因此可以被纳入组合之中。所有基本匹配过程都具有完全相同的接口，正是这一点使它成为一个组合子系统。Notice that the matcher, list-match, returned by the match:list combinator has exactly the same interface as the other matchers, allowing it to be incorporated into a combination. The fact that all of the basic match procedures have exactly the same interface makes this a system of combinators.

现在，通过以下组合，我们可以构造一个匹配器，匹配包含任意多个元素的列表，其中以符号a开头，以符号b结尾，而两者之间由片段变量(?? x)匹配：Now we can make a matcher that matches a list of any number of elements, starting with the symbol a, ending with the symbol b, and with a segment variable (?? x) between them, by the combination:

((match:list (list (match:eqv ’a)

                   (match:segment ’(?? x))

                   (match:eqv ’b)))

 ’((a 1 2 b))

 (match:new-dict)

 result-receiver)

(success ((x (1 2) ??)) 1)

这是一次成功的匹配。返回的字典恰好有一个条目：x=(1 2)，而匹配恰好从所提供的列表中吞掉了一个元素（列表(a 1 2 b)）。This was a successful match. The dictionary returned has exactly one entry: x=(1 2), and the match ate precisely one element (the list (a 1 2 b)) from the list supplied.

((match:list (list (match:eqv ’a)

                   (match:segment ’(?? x))

                   (match:eqv ’b)))

 ’((a 1 2 b 3))

 (match:new-dict)

 result-receiver)

#f

这是一次失败，因为没有东西可以匹配输入数据中b后面的3。This was a failure, because there was nothing to match the 3 after the b in the input data.

字典The dictionary

我们将使用的字典，只是一个带表头的绑定列表。每个绑定都是一个列表，包含变量名、变量值和变量类型。The dictionary we will use is just a headed list of bindings. Each binding is a list of the variable's name, its value, and its type.

(define (match:new-dict)

  (list 'dict))



(define (match:bindings dict)

  (cdr dict))



(define (match:new-bindings dict bindings)

  (cons 'dict bindings))



(define (match:extend-dict var value dict)

  (match:new-bindings dict

                      (cons (match:make-binding var value)

                            (match:bindings dict))))



(define (match:lookup var dict)

  (let ((name

         (if (symbol? var)

             var

             (match:var-name var))))

    (find (lambda (binding)

            (eq? name (match:binding-name binding)))

          (match:bindings dict))))



(define (match:make-binding var value)

  (list (match:var-name var)

        value

        (match:var-type var)))



(define match:binding-name car)

(define match:binding-type caddr)



(define match:binding-value

  (simple-generic-procedure 'match:binding-value 1 cadr))

访问过程match:binding-value本来只是cadr，不过，为了便于将来扩展，将它做成了泛型过程。支持下述章节的代码将需要这一点：The accessor match:binding-value is just cadr, but is made generic to allow future extensions. This will be needed in the code supporting 第4.5节section 4.5.

4.3.1 编译模式4.3.1 Compiling patterns

我们可以用一个简单的编译器，自动从模式构造模式匹配器。编译器产生的值，是一个适合所给模式的匹配过程，其接口与上面给出的基本匹配器完全相同。We can automate the construction of pattern matchers from patterns with an elementary compiler. The compiler produces as its value a match procedure appropriate for the pattern it is given, which has exactly the same interface as the elementary matchers given above.

匹配过程的接口便于组合匹配器，但对人并不十分友好。要试用匹配器，使用下面的接口更加方便：The match-procedure interface is convenient for composing matchers, but not very friendly to humans. For playing with the matcher it is more convenient to use:

(define (run-matcher match-procedure datum succeed)

  (match-procedure (list datum)

                   (match:new-dict)

                   (lambda (dict n)

                     (and (= n 1)

                          (succeed dict)))))

通过这个接口，我们隐藏了匹配过程的几个细节：把传入的数据对象包在一个列表中；检查该列表中恰好有一个元素（即该数据对象）被匹配；并提供初始字典。With this interface we are hiding several details about match procedures: we wrap the incoming datum in a list; we check that exactly one element of that list (the datum) has been matched; and we provide the initial dictionary.

以下是一些简单的例子：Some simple examples are:

(run-matcher

 (match:compile-pattern ’(a ((? b) 2 3) (? b) c))

 ’(a (1 2 3) 2 c)

 match:bindings)

#f



(run-matcher

 (match:compile-pattern ’(a ((? b) 2 3) (? b) c))

 ’(a (1 2 3) 1 c)

 match:bindings)

((b 1 ?))

如前所见，某些含有片段变量的模式可能有多种匹配方式；我们可以通过失败回到匹配器中，选择下一个匹配，如此直到穷尽所有匹配，从而得到全部匹配：As we saw before, some patterns involving segment variables may match in many ways, and we can elicit all of the matches by failing back into the matcher to select the next one, until they are all exhausted:

(run-matcher

 (match:compile-pattern ’(a (?? x) (?? y) (?? x) c))

 ’(a b b b b b b c)

 print-all-matches)

((y (b b b b b b) ??) (x () ??))

((y (b b b b) ??) (x (b) ??))

((y (b b) ??) (x (b b) ??))

((y () ??) (x (b b b) ??))

#f

所有可能的匹配都要求(?? x)的两次出现匹配同样的数据。The possible matches require both instances of (?? x) to match the same data.

过程print-all-matches打印各个绑定，并强制触发失败。The procedure print-all-matches prints the bindings and forces a failure.

(define (print-all-matches dict)

  (pp (match:bindings dict))

  #f)

要构造这个编译器，需要定义模式变量的语法。目前使用的语法非常简单：模式变量是一个包含类型（?或??）和名称的列表。To make this compiler we need to define the syntax of pattern variables. For now we have a very simple syntax: a pattern variable is a list of the type (? or ??) and the name.

(define (match:var-type var)

  (car var))



(define (match:var-type? object)

  (memq object match:var-types))



(define match:var-types ’(? ??))



(define (match:named-var? object)

  (and (pair? object)

       (match:var-type? (car object))

       (n:>= (length object) 2)

       (symbol? (cadr object))))



(define (match:element-var? object)

  (and (match:var? object)

       (eq? ’? (match:var-type object))))



(define (match:segment-var? object)

  (and (match:var? object)

       (eq? ’?? (match:var-type object))))

这段代码比预想的复杂，因为我们将在This code is more complex than one might expect, because we will extend the variable syntax in 第4.5节section 4.5以及某些练习中扩展变量语法。 and some of the exercises.

(define match:var-name

  (simple-generic-procedure 'match:var-name 1

    (constant-generic-procedure-handler #f)))



(define-generic-procedure-handler match:var-name

  (match-args match:named-var?)

  cadr)

默认处理过程总是返回假值。目前只有一个执行实质性工作的处理过程，它取出具名变量的名称。The default handler is a procedure that always returns false, and at this time there is only one substantive handler, which retrieves the name of a named variable.

我们还把判断实参是否为匹配变量的谓词做成泛型过程，尽管目前满足match:var?的对象只有具名变量。We also make the predicate that determines if its argument is a match variable generic, although at this time the only objects that satisfy match:var? are named variables.

(define match:var?

  (simple-generic-procedure 'match:var? 1

    (constant-generic-procedure-handler #f)))



(define-generic-procedure-handler match:var?

  (match-args match:named-var?)

  (constant-generic-procedure-handler #t))

编译器把模式映射为相应的匹配器：The compiler maps a pattern to the corresponding matcher:

(define (match:compile-pattern pattern)

  (cond ((match:var? pattern)

         (case (match:var-type pattern)

           ((?) (match:element pattern))

           ((??) (match:segment pattern))

           (else (error "Unknown var type:" pattern))))

        ((list? pattern)

         (match:list (map match:compile-pattern pattern)))

        (else  ; constant

         (match:eqv pattern))))

通过修改这个编译器，我们可以随心所欲地改变模式的语法。By varying this compiler, we can change the syntax of patterns any way we like.

(run-matcher

 (match:compile-pattern ’(a ((? b) 2 3) (? b) c))

 ’(a (1 2 3) 1 c)

 match:bindings)

((b 1 ?))

练习4.5：回溯Exercise 4.5: Backtracking

在第177页的例子中，通过让成功过程print-all-matches返回#f，我们得到了多个匹配。这大概相当神秘。它是如何工作的？请用简短而清楚的一段话，解释匹配序列是如何生成的。In the example on page 177 we got multiple matches, by returning #f from the success procedure print-all-matches. This is probably pretty mysterious. How does it work? Explain, in a short but clear paragraph, how the sequence of matches is generated.

4.3.2 匹配变量的限制4.3.2 Match-variable restrictions

我们常常希望限制模式变量能够匹配的对象种类。例如，可能希望构造一个模式，其中某个变量只能匹配正整数。一种做法，是我们在Often we want to restrict the kind of object that can be matched by a pattern variable. For example, we may want to make a pattern in which a variable can match only a positive integer. One way to do this, which we used in our term-rewriting system in 第4.2.1节section 4.2.1的项重写系统中使用过的：允许变量携带一个谓词，测试数据对象是否可接受。例如，我们可能想寻找正弦函数的正整数次幂。所需模式可以写成如下形式：, is to allow a variable to carry a predicate for testing the datum for acceptability. For example, we may be interested in finding positive integer powers of sine functions. We could write the pattern we want as follows:

‘(expt (sin (? x)) (? n ,exact-positive-integer?))

不能对这样的模式使用简单引用，因为谓词表达式（这里是exact-positive-integer?）必须先求值，才能放入模式。与项重写中一样（We cannot use simple quotation for such a pattern, because the predicate expression (here exact-positive-integer?) must be evaluated before being included in the pattern. As in term rewriting (第4.2节section 4.2），我们使用反引号机制来实现这一点。), we use the backquote mechanism to do this.

要构造一个能检查数据是否满足这种谓词的匹配器，只需在match:element中添加一行：To make a matcher that can check that data satisfies such a predicate, we add a single line to match:element:
