(define (match:element variable)

  (define (element-match data dictionary succeed)

    (and (pair? data)

         (match:satisfies-restriction? variable (car data))

         (let ((binding (match:lookup variable dictionary)))

           (if binding

               (and (equal? (match:binding-value binding)

                            (car data))

                    (succeed dictionary 1))

               (succeed (match:extend-dict variable

                                           (car data)

                                           dictionary)

                        1)))))

  element-match)



(define (match:satisfies-restriction? var value)

  (or (not (match:var-has-restriction? var))

      ((match:var-restriction var) value)))

练习4.6：备选模式——有选择是好事Exercise 4.6: Pattern alternatives: choice is good

扩展模式语言的一种有趣方法，是引入选择运算符：An interesting way to extend our pattern language is to introduce a choice operator:

(?:choice pattern ...)

这应当编译成一个匹配器，按从左到右的顺序逐一尝试匹配给定模式，返回第一个成功的匹配；如果没有任何模式匹配，则返回#f。（这应该会让你想到正则表达式中的“择一”，见第40页，不过在模式匹配中，“选择”这个名称更为传统。）This should compile into a matcher that tries to match each of the given patterns in order from left to right, returning the first successful match, or #f if none match. (This should remind you of regular expression “alternation” (see page 40), but the name “choice” is more traditional in pattern matching.)

例如：For example:

(run-matcher

 (match:compile-pattern ’(?:choice a b (? x) c))

 ’z

 match:bindings)

((x z ?))



(run-matcher

 (match:compile-pattern

 ‘((? y) (?:choice a b (? x ,string?) (? y ,symbol?) c)))

 ’(z z)

 match:bindings)

((y z ?))



(run-matcher

 (match:compile-pattern ‘(?:choice b (? x ,symbol?)))

  ’b

  print-all-matches)

()

((x b ?))

#f

动手：为这一新的模式形式实现新的匹配器过程match:choice。相应地扩充模式编译器。To do: Implement a new matcher procedure, match:choice, for this new pattern schema. Augment the pattern compiler appropriately.

练习4.7：模式中的命名Exercise 4.7: Naming in patterns

另一项扩展是提供具名模式，类似于Scheme的letrec。Another extension is to provide named patterns, analogous to Scheme's letrec.

命名能使模式更简短、更模块化，同时还能支持递归子模式，包括相互递归的子模式。Naming allows shorter, more modular patterns while also supporting recursive subpatterns, including mutually recursive subpatterns.

例如，模式：For instance, the pattern:

(?:pletrec ((odd-even-etc (?:choice () (1 (?:ref even-odd-etc))))

            (even-odd-etc (?:choice () (2 (?:ref odd-even-etc)))))

    (?:ref odd-even-etc))

应当匹配具有以下形式的所有列表（包括空列表）：should match all lists of the following form (including the empty list):

(1 (2 (1 (2 (1 ...)))))

这里，?:pletrec引入一组相互递归的模式定义，而?:ref在原处替入一个已定义的模式（以便将这种引用与a这样的字面符号，以及(? x)这样的模式变量区分开）。Here, ?:pletrec introduces a block of mutually recursive pattern definitions while ?:ref substitutes a defined pattern in place (in order to distinguish such references from literal symbols like a and from pattern variables like (? x)).

动手：实现这两种新的模式形式?:pletrec和?:ref。一种做法是实现新的匹配器过程match:pletrec和match:ref，再相应地扩充模式编译器。其他方法也可能可行。如果你的做法比较微妙或不直观，请简要解释。To do: Implement these new ?:pletrec and ?:ref pattern schemas. One approach is to implement new matcher procedures, match:pletrec and match:ref, then augment the pattern compiler appropriately. Other approaches may also work. Explain your approach briefly if it is subtle or non-obvious.

思考（动手之前！）：在一个妥善的、基于环境的类letrec实现中，嵌套的?:pletrec实例会引入不同的作用域轮廓线。然而，模式匹配器的控制结构使这一点并不容易做到。To think (before you do!): In a proper environment-based letrec-like implementation, nested ?:pletrec instances would introduce distinct contour lines for scoping. But the control structure of our pattern matcher does not make this easy.

匹配器过程按照从左到右、深度优先的顺序遍历模式和数据，将每个不同模式变量（例如(? x)）在文本中的首次出现绑定到相应的数据对象，随后把该变量在模式文本中的每次出现都视为一个约束实例。这是通过让字典沿深度优先的控制路径传递来实现的。请特别注意match:list过程体中new-dictionary的出现。这一控制结构实质上规定：每个不同模式变量最左、最深的那次出现，是一个隐式、扁平的全局命名空间中的定义实例，而之后在下游的所有出现都是约束实例。The matcher procedures traverse the pattern and data in left-to-right depth-first order, binding the first textual appearance of each distinct pattern variable (like (? x)) to its corresponding datum and then treating each subsequent textual appearance in the pattern as a constraining instance. This is achieved by threading the dictionary through the depth-first control path. Pay particular attention to the appearance of new-dictionary in the body of match:list. This control structure, in essence, decrees that the leftmost, deepest instance of each unique pattern variable is a defining instance in an implicit flat global namespace, with all subsequent downstream appearances being constraining instances.

因此，在这个练习中，先不考虑作用域的这种复杂性。具体而言，正如所有模式变量共用一个全局命名空间，你的模式定义也可以如此。So let's not worry about that scoping complexity in this exercise. Specifically, just as pattern variables all share a common global namespace, so too can your pattern definitions.

当然，如果你确实雄心勃勃，也可以重写所有现有匹配器接口，使它们接受额外的pattern-environment形参，从而实现词法作用域。不过，那是留待另一个时间和场合的工作（在练习4.9中）。Of course, if you are really ambitious, you can implement lexical scoping by rewriting all the existing matcher interfaces to accept an extra pattern-environment parameter. But that is a job for another time and place (in exercise 4.9).

练习4.8：搬起石头砸自己的脚Exercise 4.8: Hoist by our own petard

表面上看，要扩展这个匹配器系统，使它支持向量模式和向量数据，似乎很容易。然而，我们在设计这个匹配器时作出了一个很强的假设：它是一个用列表模式匹配列表数据的匹配器。On the surface it may appear that it would be easy to extend this matcher system to allow vector patterns and vector data. But we made a strong assumption in the design of this matcher—that it is a matcher of list patterns on list data.

  1. a. 要让这段代码摆脱这一假设，从而构造出涵盖这两种复合数据的匹配器，需要做些什么？如果要支持任意序列呢？需要哪些类型的改动？是否需要改变匹配过程的接口？a. What would it take to liberate this code from that assumption so that you could make a matcher that encompassed both kinds of compound data? Or arbitrary sequences? What sorts of changes are required? Do you need to change the interface to a match procedure?
  2. b. 把它实现出来！（这是一大堆工作。）b. Make it so! (This is lots of work.)

练习4.9：通用模式语言Exercise 4.9: General pattern language

即使加入练习4.7中的?:pletrec和?:ref，我们现有的模式匹配器仍然不是一种完整的语言，因为它不支持命名空间的作用域和参数化模式。例如，我们无法写出下面这个模式，它旨在仅匹配构成回文的符号列表。Even with the addition of ?:pletrec and ?:ref in exercise 4.7, the pattern matcher we have is not a complete language, in that it does not support namespace scoping and parametric patterns. For example, we cannot write the following pattern, which is intended to match only lists of symbols that are palindromes.

(?:pletrec ((palindrome

            (?:pnew (x)

              (?:choice ()

                        ((? x ,symbol?)

                         (?:ref palindrome)

                         (? x))))))

   (?:ref palindrome))

要让这一模式以合理的方式工作，?:pnew就要创建新的、具有词法作用域的模式变量，它们只能在?:pnew的体内引用。For this to work in any reasonable way, ?:pnew creates fresh lexically scoped pattern variables that can be referred to only in the body of the ?:pnew.

拥有一个充分完善的模式语言子系统非常美妙，但构建它并不容易。A fully worked-out pattern language is a wonderful subsystem to have, but it is not easy to build.

动手：充实这一构想，做出一种完整的模式语言。胆小者勿试！To do: Flesh out this idea to produce a full pattern language. Not for the faint of heart!

4.4 合一匹配4.4 Unification match

如前所述，模式匹配是结构化数据对象之间的一种相等性测试。它是相等性测试的推广，因为我们允许数据的某些部分保持未指定状态，具体做法是允许模式变量匹配数据中未指定的部分。但我们要求，同一个模式变量的每次出现都必须匹配等价的数据。Pattern matching is, as we have said, a kind of equality testing between structured data items. It is a generalization of equality testing because we allow some parts of the data to be unspecified, by allowing pattern variables that match the unspecified parts of the data. But we require that every occurrence of the same pattern variable must match equivalent data.

到目前为止，匹配器都是单边的：我们用含有变量的模式，匹配不含变量的数据，得到一个字典，将模式中的每个变量映射到数据中与之匹配的一部分。如果把每个变量的匹配值代入原始模式，就会得到该模式的一个代换实例。所得实例总是与原始数据等价。So far our matchers have been one-sided: we match a pattern with variables against data that contains no variables, producing a dictionary—a map from each variable in the pattern to a matching piece of the data. If we substitute the matching value for each variable into the original pattern we make a substitution instance of the pattern. The resulting instance is always equivalent to the original data.

接下来，我们要取消数据中不能有变量这一限制：允许匹配的两边都有变量。这种强大的匹配称为合一。成功合一的结果仍然是一个字典，但变量的值可能包含变量，而且字典未必为模式中的每个变量都给出值。如果用字典中与变量关联的值，替换两个给定模式中出现的变量，就能得到这两个初始模式共同的一个代换实例。这个可能包含变量的代换实例，称为这些模式的合一结果。合一结果是两个模式最一般的共同代换实例：两个模式的其他任何共同代换实例，都是该合一结果的代换实例。不计变量重命名的差别，合一结果是唯一的，因此合一是良定义的。4We are about to remove the limitation that the data has no variables: we will allow variables on both sides of the match. This powerful kind of match is called unification. The result of a successful unification is also a dictionary, but the values for variables may contain variables, and the dictionary may not give values for every variable in the patterns. If we substitute the values associated with variables in the dictionary for variables that appear in either of the two given patterns, we obtain a substitution instance of both initial patterns. This substitution instance, which may contain variables, is called the unifier of the patterns. The unifier is the most general common substitution instance of the two patterns: any other common substitution instance of the two patterns is a substitution instance of the unifier. The unifier is unique, up to renaming of the variables, so unification is well defined.4

J. A. Robinson在其著名的、用于定理证明的归结过程发明中，首次描述了合一[104]。5Unification was first described by J. A. Robinson in his famous invention of the resolution procedure for theorem proving [104].5

举一个简单的例子，假设我们有几个信息来源，分别提供了Ben Franklin生卒日期的部分信息：For a simple example, suppose we have several sources of partial information about Ben Franklin's dates of birth and death:

(define a

  ’(((? gn) franklin) (? bdate) ((? dmo) (? dday) 1790)))



(define b

  ’((ben franklin) ((? bmo) 6 1705) (apr 17 (? dyear))))



(define c

  ’((ben (? fn)) (jan (? bday) 1705) (apr 17 (? dyear))))

对两个表达式进行合一，会得到一个字典，其中包含由匹配推导出的变量值。我们可以用这个字典构造两个模式的合一结果：The unification of two expressions will give us a dictionary of the values of the variables that are derived from the match. We can use that dictionary to construct the unifier of the two patterns:

(unifier a b)

((ben franklin) ((? bmo) 6 1705) (apr 17 1790))



(unifier a c)

((ben franklin) (jan (? bday) 1705) (apr 17 1790))



(unifier b c)

((ben franklin) (jan 6 1705) (apr 17 (? dyear)))

这些结果中的每一个，都比任何单一来源提供的部分信息更完整。我们还可以进一步结合这三个来源，得到完整的图景：Each of these results is more fully specified than the partial information provided by any source. We can further combine all three sources to get a full picture:

(unifier a (unifier b c))

((ben franklin) (jan 6 1705) (apr 17 1790))



(unifier b (unifier a c))

((ben franklin) (jan 6 1705) (apr 17 1790))



(unifier c (unifier a b))

((ben franklin) (jan 6 1705) (apr 17 1790))

表达式中的变量之间常常存在约束。例如，同一个变量可能多次出现，而这些出现必须保持一致，如下面的推导所示：Often there are constraints among the variables in an expression. For example, there may be multiple instances of the same variable, which must remain consistent, as in the following derivation:

(define addition-commutativity

  ’(= (+ (? u) (? v)) (+ (? v) (? u))))



(unifier ’(= (+ (cos (? a)) (exp (? b))) (? c))

         addition-commutativity)

(= (+ (cos (? a)) (exp (? b))) (+ (exp (? b)) (cos (? a))))

4.4.1 合一如何工作4.4.1 How unification works

我们可以把合一看作一种方程求解。如果把模式视为结构化的部分信息，那么合一就是在检验这样一个命题：两个模式是否是关于同一个事物的部分信息。要使模式能够合一，相应的各个部分必须能够合一。因此，合一就是在相应部分之间建立方程，并求解未知量（即每个模式中未指定的信息部分）。We can think of unification as a kind of equation solving. If we think of the patterns as structured partial information, unifying them is testing the proposition that the two patterns are partial information about the same thing. For the patterns to unify, the corresponding parts must unify. So unification is setting up equations among the corresponding parts and solving for the unknowns (the pieces of information left unspecified in each pattern).

这一过程类似于求解数值方程的方法。目标是尽可能多地消去方程中的变量。结果是一个代换列表，列出用哪些表达式替换被消去的变量。任何代换表达式都不能引用已消去的变量。我们扫描这些方程，找到一个可以解出其中某个变量的方程。解出变量，就是将它单独置于一侧，找到一个不含该变量的等价表达式。随后，用新发现的值（即等价表达式）替换该变量的所有出现，从而消去该变量：既要替换剩余方程中的出现，也要替换代换列表中先前已消去变量所关联的值中的出现。然后把新的代换加入代换列表。重复这一过程，直到没有更多待解方程，或遇到矛盾。结果要么是一个成功的代换列表，要么是一份矛盾报告。The process is analogous to the way we solve numerical equations. The goal is to eliminate as many variables in the equations as we can. The result is a list of substitutions of expressions for the eliminated variables. No substitution expression may refer to any eliminated variable. We scan the equations for one that can be solved for one of the variables in it. Solving for a variable isolates it, finding an equivalent expression that does not contain the variable. We eliminate the variable by replacing all occurrences of it with its the newly discovered value (the equivalent expression), both in the remaining equations and in the values associated with previously eliminated variables in the substitution list. We then add the new substitution to the substitution list. We repeat until there are no more equations to be solved or we encounter a contradiction. The result is either a successful substitution list or a report of the contradiction.

在合一中，“方程”就是两个输入模式相应部分之间的匹配，而“代换列表”就是字典。实现合一的一种方式，是遍历输入模式共有的结构。与单边匹配一样，模式由列表结构表示。如果在匹配的任一边遇到变量，就在字典中将它绑定到另一边的数据。In unification the “equations” are the matches of the corresponding parts of the two input patterns, and the “substitution list” is the dictionary. One way to implement unification is to walk the common structure of the input patterns. As in one-sided matching, the patterns are represented by list structure. If a variable is encountered on either side of the match, it is bound, in the dictionary, to the data on the other side.

如果一个变量在原始模式中出现多次，那么每次后续出现都必须匹配首次出现所绑定的值。这一点通过以下方式保证：每次遇到变量，都在字典中查找它；如果已有该变量的绑定，就用它的值替代该变量。此外，每当建立一个新绑定并将它加入字典时，都会用这一新绑定替换字典中其他变量值内所有新消去变量的出现。If there are multiple occurrences of a variable in the original patterns, each subsequent occurrence must match the value bound by the first occurrence. This is ensured by the fact that every time a variable is encountered, it is looked up in the dictionary, and if there is a binding for the variable, its value is used instead of the variable. Also, every time a new binding is made and entered into the dictionary, the new binding is used to replace all instances of the newly eliminated variable in the values for other variables in the dictionary.

要得到两个模式的unifier，就对它们进行unify，以取得代换字典，前提是它们能够合一。如果不能，unify就返回#f，表示失败。然后用字典实例化其中一个模式；选择哪一个并不重要。过程match:dict-substitution会把模式表达式pattern1中、在字典dict里有绑定的变量的每次出现，都替换成它在字典中的值。To obtain the unifier of two patterns we unify them to get the dictionary of substitutions, if they can be unified. If not, unify returns #f, indicating a failure. The dictionary is then used to instantiate one of the patterns; it doesn't matter which is chosen. The procedure match:dict-substitution replaces every instance of a variable in the pattern expression pattern1 that has a binding in the dictionary dict with its value in the dictionary.

(define (unifier pattern1 pattern2)

  (let ((dict (unify pattern1 pattern2)))

    (and dict

         ((match:dict-substitution dict) pattern1))))

合一器的主要接口是unify，它返回成功匹配所得的字典；如果匹配不成功，则返回#f。The main interface to the unifier is unify, which returns the dictionary result of a successful match, or #f if the match was unsuccessful.

(define (unify pattern1 pattern2)

  (unify:internal pattern1 pattern2

                  (match:new-dict)

                  (lambda (dict) dict)))

入口unify:internal可对匹配过程提供更多控制。它接受两个待合一的模式、一个可能已经指定了一些绑定的字典，以及一个在匹配成功时调用的成功续延（succeed）。上面的unify提供的成功续延只是返回字典。在The unify:internal entry point gives more control of the matching process. It takes the two patterns to be unified, a dictionary that may have some bindings specified, and a success continuation (succeed) that will be called if the match succeeds. The success continuation provided by unify, above, just returns the dictionary. In 第4.4.4节section 4.4.4中，我们将添加代码，尝试在模式中使用片段变量；届时，可以让succeed返回#f，表明当前结果不是所要的结果，从而取得多个匹配。能够回溯到匹配器中，也简化了其他一些有趣的语义扩展，例如把代数表达式和方程求解纳入匹配过程。6, when we add code to experiment with segment variables in the patterns, we will be able to extract multiple matches by returning #f from succeed, indicating that the result was not the one wanted. The ability to backtrack into the matcher also simplifies other interesting semantic extensions, such as incorporating algebraic expressions and equation solving into the match process.6

在unify:internal中，待合一的模式pattern1和pattern2被包在列表中。合一器程序会逐项比较这两个列表，构造一个使相应项相等的字典。如果两个项列表同时耗尽，匹配就成功。在顶层的unify:internal中，项列表只包含两个给定模式；而核心合一过程unify:dispatch会递归深入模式，把模式的子模式作为项列表来比较。7In unify:internal the patterns to be unified, pattern1 and pattern2 are wrapped in lists. The unifier program will compare these lists term by term, building a dictionary that makes corresponding terms equal. The match succeeds if both lists of terms are simultaneously exhausted. At the top level, in unify:internal, the term lists just contain the two given patterns, but the central unification procedure, unify:dispatch, will recursively descend into the pattern, comparing subpatterns of the patterns as lists of terms.7

(define (unify:internal pattern1 pattern2 dict succeed)

  ((unify:dispatch (list pattern1) (list pattern2))

  dict

  (lambda (dict fail rest1 rest2)

    (or (and (null? rest1) (null? rest2)

             (succeed dict))

        (fail)))

  (lambda () #f)))

过程unify:dispatch接受两个输入项列表，是递归下降匹配器的核心。匹配过程取决于项列表的内容。例如，如果两个项列表都以常量开头，如(ben franklin)和(ben (? fn))，就必须比较这两个常量；只有常量相等，匹配才能继续。如果一个项列表以变量开头，另一个可以以任意项开头，而该变量必须绑定到它所匹配的项。（如果两者都是变量，就会消去其中一个，以另一个代替。）因此，如果一个项列表是((? bmo) 6 1705)，另一个是(jan (? bday) 1705)，就必须把变量(? bmo)绑定到值jan，匹配才能继续。如果两个项列表都以一个不是变量的列表开头，匹配过程就必须先递归地匹配相应子列表，再继续匹配给定项列表的其余部分。例如，在Ben Franklin的例子中合一b和c时，匹配首项后，字典中包含从fn到franklin的绑定，剩下的项列表是(((? bmo) 6 1705) (apr 17 (? dyear)))和((jan (? bday) 1705) (apr 17 (? dyear)))。这两个项列表都以列表开头，因此匹配过程必须递归比较子列表((? bmo) 6 1705)和(jan (? bday) 1705)。The procedure unify:dispatch, which takes two input lists of terms, is the core of the recursive descent matcher. The match process depends on the contents of the term lists. For example, if both term lists begin with a constant, as in (ben franklin) and (ben (? fn)), the constants must be compared, and the match can proceed only if the constants are equal. If one term list begins with a variable, the other can begin with any term, and the variable must be bound to the term it matches. (If both are variables, one of the variables will be eliminated in favor of the other.) So, if one term list is ((? bmo) 6 1705) and the other is (jan (? bday) 1705), then the variable (? bmo) must be bound to the value jan for the match to proceed. If both term lists start with a list that is not a variable, the match must recursively match the corresponding sublists before proceeding to match the rest of the given term lists. For example, in unifying b and c in the Ben Franklin example, after the first terms are matched the dictionary contains a binding of fn to franklin and the remaining termlists are (((? bmo) 6 1705) (apr 17 (? dyear))) and ((jan (? bday) 1705) (apr 17 (? dyear))). Both of these term lists begin with a list, so the matching must recurse to compare the sublists ((? bmo) 6 1705) and (jan (? bday) 1705).

unify:dispatch返回的过程unify-dispatcher接受三个实参：字典、成功续延和失败续延。如果两个项列表都已耗尽，匹配就成功。如果还有更多项需要匹配，泛型过程unify:gdispatch就根据两个项列表的内容，调用合适的匹配过程。如果匹配成功，就意味着相对于给定字典，这两个项列表的起始项能够合一。因此，会以新字典dict*、新的失败续延fail*，以及输入列表尚未匹配的尾部rest1和rest2为实参，调用成功续延。随后，通过递归调用unify:dispatch匹配这些尾部。The procedure unify-dispatcher returned by unify:dispatch takes three arguments: a dictionary, a success continuation, and a failure continuation. If both term lists are exhausted, the match succeeds. If there are more terms to be matched, the generic procedure unify:gdispatch calls an appropriate match procedure that depends on the contents of the two term lists. If the match succeeds, it means that the initial terms of the two term lists could be unified relative to the given dictionary. So the success continuation is called with the new dictionary dict*, a new failure continuation fail*, and the unmatched tails, rest1 and rest2, of the input lists. These tails are then matched by a recursive call to unify:dispatch.

(define (unify:dispatch terms1 terms2)

  (define (unify-dispatcher dict succeed fail)

    (if (and (null? terms1) (null? terms2))

        (succeed dict fail terms1 terms2)

        ((unify:gdispatch terms1 terms2)

         dict

         (lambda (dict* fail* rest1 rest2)

           ((unify:dispatch rest1 rest2) dict* succeed fail*))

         fail)))

  unify-dispatcher)

泛型过程unify:gdispatch具有处理上述各种情况的处理过程：匹配两个常量、匹配两个项列表，以及把变量与某个东西匹配。（由于它是泛型过程，可以扩展以支持新的匹配种类。）对于将常量与项列表匹配之类的情况，默认处理过程是unify:fail：The generic procedure unify:gdispatch has handlers for the cases described above: matching two constants, matching two term lists, and matching a variable to something. (Because it is generic, it can be extended for new kinds of matching.) The default handler, for cases such as matching a constant to a term list, is unify:fail:

(define (unify:fail terms1 terms2)

  (define (unify-fail dict succeed fail)

    (fail))

  unify-fail)



(define unify:gdispatch

  (simple-generic-procedure ’unify 2 unify:fail))

在这个合一器中，项列表是逐项匹配的，因此处理过程的任务，是匹配两个项列表的首项。于是，处理过程是否适用，只取决于每个项列表的首项。为了简化适用性规约，我们引入car-satisfies，它接受一个谓词，并生成一个新谓词，以确保列表中存在首项，且该项满足作为实参传入的谓词。In this unifier the term lists are matched term by term, so the job of a handler is to match the first terms of the two term lists. Thus the applicability of a handler depends only on the first term of each term list. To simplify the applicability specification we introduce car-satisfies, which takes a predicate and produces a new predicate ensuring that there is a first term in the list and that term satisfies the argument predicate.

(define (car-satisfies pred)

  (lambda (terms)

    (and (pair? terms)

         (pred (car terms)))))

任何既不是匹配变量、也不是列表的项，都是常量。常量只有在相等时才匹配：Any term that is not a match variable or a list is a constant. Constants match only when they are equal:

(define (unify:constant-terms terms1 terms2)

  (let ((first1 (car terms1)) (rest1 (cdr terms1))

        (first2 (car terms2)) (rest2 (cdr terms2)))

    (define (unify-constants dict succeed fail)

      (if (eqv? first1 first2)

          (succeed dict fail rest1 rest2)

          (fail)))

    unify-constants))



(define (constant-term? term)

  (and (not (match:var? term))

       (not (list? term))))



(define-generic-procedure-handler unify:gdispatch

  (match-args (car-satisfies constant-term?)

              (car-satisfies constant-term?))

  unify:constant-terms)

处理过程unify:list-terms是真正发生递归下降的地方。由于每个项列表的首项本身就是列表，匹配器必须递归匹配这些子列表。如果子列表匹配成功，就必须继续匹配输入项列表的剩余部分。（注意，只有两个子列表的全部项都匹配，递归匹配才会成功；因此，传给成功续延的、尚未匹配的子列表尾部将是空的，可以忽略。）The handler unify:list-terms is where the recursive descent actually happens. Because the first term of each term list is itself a list, the matcher must recurse to match those sublists. If the match of the sublists succeeds, the match must continue with the rest of the input termlists. (Note that the recursive match will succeed only if all of the terms of the two sublists match; so the unmatched sublist tails passed to the success continuation will be empty and are ignored.)

(define (unify:list-terms terms1 terms2)

  (let ((first1 (car terms1)) (rest1 (cdr terms1))

        (first2 (car terms2)) (rest2 (cdr terms2)))

    (define (unify-lists dict succeed fail)

      ((unify:dispatch first1 first2)

       dict

       (lambda (dict* fail* null1 null2)

         (succeed dict* fail* rest1 rest2))

       fail))

    unify-lists))



(define (list-term? term)

  (and (not (match:var? term))

       (list? term)))



(define-generic-procedure-handler unify:gdispatch

  (match-args (car-satisfies list-term?)

              (car-satisfies list-term?))

  unify:list-terms)

到目前为止，我们的代码实现了递归下降和常量匹配。两个不同符号之间的匹配，或符号与列表之间的匹配，这些明显的矛盾都会导致失败。要解有意思的方程，必须能够匹配含变量的项。发现变量时，可能会向字典中添加新绑定。方程求解器中负责处理变量的部分，是过程maybe-substitute。So far our code implements recursive descent and the matching of constants. Obvious contradictions like matching two different symbols or a symbol to a list produce a failure. In order to solve interesting equations we must be able to match terms with variables. When we find variables, we may add new bindings to the dictionary. The part of the equation solver that deals with variables is the procedure maybe-substitute.

过程maybe-substitute取得一个以变量开头的项列表var-first。它把该变量与第二个项列表terms的首项进行匹配。The procedure maybe-substitute gets one term list var-first that starts with a variable. It matches that variable with the first term of the second term list, terms.

如果变量与自身匹配，就得到一个恒真式，匹配成功，而字典保持不变。如果变量已有值，就用它的值替换变量，再把所得列表与项列表terms匹配。最后，如果变量没有值，就可以用do-substitute消去它；该过程负责在可能的情况下，添加从var到term的绑定。If a variable is matched against itself we have a tautology, and the match succeeds with an unchanged dictionary. If the variable already has a value, we replace the variable with its value and match the resulting list against the term list terms. Finally, if the variable does not have a value, we can eliminate it using do-substitute, which is responsible for adding a binding from var to term when possible.

(define (maybe-substitute var-first terms)

  (define (unify-substitute dict succeed fail)

    (let ((var (car var-first)) (rest1 (cdr var-first))

          (term (car terms)) (rest2 (cdr terms)))

      (cond ((and (match:element-var? term)

                  (match:vars-equal? var term))

             (succeed dict fail rest1 rest2))

            ((match:has-binding? var dict)

             ((unify:dispatch

                 (cons (match:get-value var dict) rest1)

                 terms)

              dict succeed fail))

            (else

             (let ((dict* (do-substitute var term dict)))

               (if dict*

                   (succeed dict* fail rest1 rest2)

                   (fail)))))))

  unify-substitute)

在do-substitute中，首先使用旧字典清理传入的term，把之前已消去的变量替换为它们的值。然后检查var能够匹配的对象是否受到限制。最后，检查清理后的项（term*）中是否出现var。如果清理后的项含有对var的引用，就不能继续匹配。8如果匹配通过了所有这些测试，就构造一个新字典，其中包含从var到清理后项的新绑定。新字典中的绑定值，也必须清除对var的引用。In do-substitute we first use the old dictionary to clean the incoming term by replacing any previously eliminated variables with their values. Then we check if there are any restrictions on what objects var may match. Finally we check for any occurrences of var in the cleaned term (term*). If the cleaned term contains a reference to var, the match cannot proceed.8 If our match passes all these tests, we make a new dictionary that includes the new binding of var to the cleaned term. The binding values in the new dictionary must also be cleaned of references to var.

(define (do-substitute var term dict)

  (let ((term* ((match:dict-substitution dict) term)))

    (and (match:satisfies-restriction? var term*)

         (or (and (match:var? term*)

                  (match:vars-equal? var term*))

         (not (match:occurs-in? var term*)))

     (match:extend-dict var term*

       (match:map-dict-values

        (match:single-substitution var term*)

        dict)))))

既然已经知道如何处理变量，剩下的只是将这个处理过程安装到泛型分派器过程中。这里唯一微妙之处是，待消去的变量可能出现在任一项列表中。必须保证，包含该变量的项列表作为第一个实参传给maybe-substitute。Now that we know how to handle variables we just have to install this handler in our generic dispatcher procedure. The only subtlety here is that the variable to be eliminated may appear in either term list. We must guarantee that the term list containing the variable is the first argument to maybe-substitute.

(define (element? term)

  (any-object? term))



(define-generic-procedure-handler unify:gdispatch

  (match-args (car-satisfies match:element-var?)

              (car-satisfies element?))

  (lambda (var-first terms)

    (maybe-substitute var-first terms)))



(define-generic-procedure-handler unify:gdispatch

  (match-args (car-satisfies element?)

              (car-satisfies match:element-var?))

  (lambda (terms var-first)

    (maybe-substitute var-first terms)))

至此，我们已经拥有一个完整、正确且胜任其职的传统合一器。9它使用泛型过程编写，因此很容易扩展到其他种类的数据。只需少量工作，就能添加语义附件，例如赋予以符号+和*开头的列表以交换性。如后面将看到的，我们还可以添加对新种类语法变量的支持，例如片段变量。不过，在此之前，先看一个实际应用：类型推断。At this point we have a complete, correct, and competent traditional unifier.9 It is written with generic procedures, so it can easily be extended to work with other kinds of data. And with only a small amount of work we can add semantic attachments, such as the commutativity of lists beginning with the symbols + and *. As we shall see, we can also add support for new kinds of syntactic variables, such as segment variables. But before we do that we will look at a real application: type inference.

练习4.10：合一向量Exercise 4.10: Unifying vectors

可以扩展这个合一器，使它处理由其他数据类型（例如向量）构成的数据和模式。请为向量构造处理过程，不要把向量转换成列表（那是图省事的办法！）。This unifier can be extended to handle data and patterns that are made of other data types, such as vectors. Make handlers for vectors without transforming the vectors to lists (the easy way out!).

练习4.11：合一字符串Exercise 4.11: Unifying strings

扩展合一器，使它允许字符串合一。这可能很有趣，但需要发明一种语法机制，用于在字符串内部表示字符串变量。这相当微妙，因为你可能必须用字符串表达式来表示字符串变量。这会涉及引用问题——请尽量不要发明繁复怪异的机制。此外，确保不要作出妨碍日后引入字符串片段变量的假设。（见第209页的练习4.21。）Extend the unifier to allow unification of strings. This could be fun, but you need to invent a syntactic mechanism for representing string variables inside a string. This is pretty delicate, because you may have to represent a string variable with a string expression. This gets into quotation problems—please try not to invent a baroque mechanism. Also, make sure that you don't make assumptions that will prevent you from introducing string segment variables later. (See exercise 4.21 on page 209.)

练习4.12：变量限制Exercise 4.12: Variable restrictions

我们像在单边匹配器中一样，添加了对变量限制的支持：只需在过程do-substitute的主条件式中放入一个分支。不过，这存在一些微妙的问题。We added support for restrictions on variables as we did in the one-sided matcher: we just put a clause for that into the main conditional in the procedure do-substitute. But there are subtle problems.

  • 如果一个受限制的变量与另一个受限制的变量匹配，应当发生什么？What should happen if a restricted variable is matched against another restricted variable?
  • 变量通过限制检查、首次绑定到目标后，就会被统一消去。然而，这样就丢失了限制，使它无法否决后续匹配中不合适的部分。When the variable is first bound to its target, after passing the restriction, it is uniformly eliminated. But the restriction is then lost, preventing it from killing an unsuitable later part of the match.

你的任务是理解这些问题，并确定如何缓解它们。对于你可能考虑的应用，这件事有多重要？有没有一种解决方案，能够很好地融入我们的实现策略？Your task is to understand these problems and determine how to ameliorate them. How important could this be for any applications you might consider? Is there a solution that fits nicely into our implementation strategy?

练习4.13：用模式组合子进行合一？Exercise 4.13: Unifying with pattern combinators?

与前面的单边模式匹配器不同，我们的合一匹配器不会把模式编译成匹配过程，再由这些过程组合成整个模式的匹配过程。不过，匹配过程系统有可能更高效，因为它避免了在匹配时对模式进行语法分析。能否以类似方式拆分合一匹配器？如果不能，为什么？这样做是个好主意吗？如果不是，为什么？如果是，就动手做吧！（这很难！）Unlike our earlier one-sided pattern matcher, our unification matcher does not compile the patterns into match procedures that combine to build a match procedure for the pattern. But a system of match procedures is potentially more efficient, because it avoids the syntactic analysis of the patterns while matching. Can the unification matcher be broken up in a similar way? If not, why not? Is it a good idea to do so? If not, why not? If so, do it! (This is hard!)

4.4.2 应用：类型推断4.4.2 Application: Type inference

合一匹配的一项经典应用是类型推断：给定一个程序以及程序某些部分的类型信息，推导程序其他部分的类型信息。例如，如果知道<是一个接受两个数值实参、生成一个布尔值的过程，那么分析表达式(g (< x (f y)))时，就可以推导出：f和g都是一元过程；g接受布尔实参；f返回数值；而x具有数值。如果利用这些信息，去推导包含该表达式的程序的性质，就能了解有关程序的大量信息。以下是对该表达式的分析：One classic application of unification matching is type inference: given a program and some type information about parts of the program, deduce type information about other parts of the program. For example, if we know that < is a procedure that takes two numerical arguments and produces a boolean value, then if we analyze the expression (g (< x (f y))), we can deduce that f and g are unary procedures; g accepts a boolean argument; f returns a numerical value; and x has a numerical value. If this information is used to deduce properties of the program that the expression is embedded in, we can learn a great deal about the program. Here is an analysis of the expression:

(pp (infer-program-types ’(g (< x (f y)))))

(t (? type:17)

   ((t (type:procedure ((boolean-type)) (? type:17)) g)

    (t (boolean-type)

       ((t (type:procedure ((numeric-type) (numeric-type))

                           (boolean-type))

           <)

        (t (numeric-type) x)

        (t (numeric-type)

           ((t (type:procedure ((? y:12)) (numeric-type)) f)

            (t (? y:12) y)))))))

这是给定表达式的抽象树，带有类型标注。每个子表达式x都已扩展为形式为(t type x)的带类型表达式。例如，对g的引用具有以下类型：This is the abstract tree of the given expression, annotated with types. Each subexpression x has been expanded into a typed expression of the form (t type x). For example, the reference to g has the type:

(type:procedure ((boolean-type)) (? type:17))

正如预期，g是一个接受布尔实参的过程，但我们没有关于其返回值的信息。未知的值类型由模式变量(? type:17)表示。As expected, g is a procedure that accepts a boolean argument, but we have no information about its value. The unknown value type is represented by the pattern variable (? type:17).

让我们考虑一个更为充实的例子：Let's consider a more substantial example:

(define foo

  (infer-program-types

   ’(define fact

      (lambda (n)

        (begin

          (define iter

            (lambda (product counter)

              (if (> counter n)

                  product

                  (iter (* product counter)

                        (+ counter 1)))))

          (iter 1 1))))))

foo中的结果相当冗长。因此，我们用一个化简器查看它，将它转成“人类可读”的形式。The result in foo is rather verbose. So we look at it with a simplifier that puts it into “human readable” form.

(pp (simplify-annotated-program foo))

(begin

  (define fact

    (lambda (n)

      (declare-type n (numeric-type))

      (define iter

        (lambda (product counter)

          (declare-type product (numeric-type))

          (declare-type counter (numeric-type))

          (if (> counter n)

              product

              (iter (* product counter)

                    (+ counter 1)))))

      (declare-type iter

        (type:procedure ((numeric-type) (numeric-type))

                        (numeric-type)))

      (iter 1 1)))

  (declare-type fact

    (type:procedure ((numeric-type)) (numeric-type))))

这里可以看到，类型推断程序能够确定阶乘程序的完整类型：它是一个接受一个数值输入、生成一个数值输出的过程。这一信息由一条声明报告：Here we see that the type inference program was able to determine the complete type of the factorial program—that it is a procedure that takes one numerical input and produces a numerical output. This is reported in a declaration:

(declare-type fact

  (type:procedure ((numeric-type)) (numeric-type)))

内部定义iter的类型也已确定：它接受两个数值实参，并生成数值结果。The type of the internal definition iter has also been determined: it takes two numerical arguments and produces a numerical result.

(declare-type iter

  (type:procedure ((numeric-type) (numeric-type))

                  (numeric-type)))

此外，每个内部变量的类型都已确定，并已给出相应的声明：Also, the type of each internal variable has been determined, and an appropriate declaration has been posted:

(declare-type n (numeric-type))

(declare-type product (numeric-type))

(declare-type counter (numeric-type))

4.4.3 类型推断如何工作4.4.3 How type inference works

类型推断过程有四个阶段。The process of type inference has four phases.

  1. 1. 用类型变量对给定程序的所有子表达式进行标注。1. The given program is annotated with type variables for all subexpressions of the program.
  2. 2. 根据程序的语义结构，建立类型变量之间的约束。2. Constraints on the type variables are formulated based on the semantic structure of the program.
  3. 3. 对约束进行合一，尽可能多地消去变量。3. The constraints are unified to eliminate as many of the variables as possible.
  4. 4. 使用约束合一所产生的字典，对已标注程序进行特化，得到一个新的已标注程序，其类型标注体现了这些约束。4. The annotated program is specialized using the dictionary produced by unification of the constraints to make a new annotated program whose type annotations incorporate the constraints.

这一方案由以下过程实现：The plan is implemented in this procedure:

(define (infer-program-types expr)

  (let ((texpr (annotate-program expr)))

    (let ((constraints (program-constraints texpr)))

      (let ((dict (unify-constraints constraints)))

        (if dict

            ((match:dict-substitution dict) texpr)

            ’***type-error***)))))

如果无法为程序表达式赋予一致的类型，这个过程就会报错。不过，它不会解释失败原因；可以通过在失败续延中回传信息来做到这一点。This procedure complains if the program expression cannot be consistently typed. However, it gives no explanation about why it failed; this could be accomplished by passing information back in the failure continuations.

标注Annotation

annotate-program过程通过泛型过程annotate-expr实现，以便轻松扩展到新的语言特性。The annotate-program procedure is implemented in terms of a generic procedure, annotate-expr, to allow easy extension for new language features.

(define (annotate-program expr)

  (annotate-expr expr (top-level-env)))



(define annotate-expr

  (simple-generic-procedure ’annotate-expr 2 #f))

annotate-expr过程接受一个用于类型变量绑定的环境。其初始环境是下面创建的顶层环境。The annotate-expr procedure takes an environment for bindings of the type variables. It is initialized with the top-level environment created below.

对于简单种类的表达式，有一些简单的处理过程来进行标注。如果一个显式的数作为子表达式出现，就为它赋予一个由(numeric-type)构造的常量类型：There are simple handlers for annotating simple kinds of expressions. If an explicit number appears as a subexpression it is given a constant type, constructed by (numeric-type):

(define-generic-procedure-handler annotate-expr

  (match-args number? any-object?)

  (lambda (expr env)

    (make-texpr (numeric-type) expr)))

过程make-texpr根据类型和表达式构造一个带类型表达式。可以用texpr-type和texpr-expr选取它的各个部分。The procedure make-texpr constructs a typed expression from a type and an expression. Its parts can be selected with texpr-type and texpr-expr.

不过，对于用符号表示的标识符，我们未必预先知道它的类型。过程get-var-type尝试在环境中查找标识符的类型；如果找不到，就创建一个唯一的类型变量，用于该词法上下文中该标识符所有出现位置的类型标注：However, we may not a priori know a type for an identifier, which is represented by a symbol. The procedure get-var-type tries to find the identifier's type in the environment, and failing that, creates a unique type variable for the type annotation of all occurrences of the identifier in that lexical context:

(define-generic-procedure-handler annotate-expr

  (match-args symbol? any-object?)

  (lambda (expr env)

    (make-texpr (get-var-type expr env) expr)))

我们可能知道某些标识符的类型，例如语言的基本过程。顶层环境提供了这些类型。这里展示的基本过程具有过程类型，其实参和返回值的类型由类型常量（例如(numeric-type)）表示：We may know types for some identifiers, such as primitive procedures of the language. These are provided in the top-level environment. The primitive procedures shown here have procedure types with type constants (e.g., (numeric-type)) for their arguments and values:

(define (top-level-env)

  (list (make-top-level-env-frame)))



(define (make-top-level-env-frame)

  (let ((binary-numerical

         (let ((v (numeric-type)))

           (procedure-type (list v v) v)))

        (binary-comparator

         (let ((v (numeric-type)))

           (procedure-type (list v v) (boolean-type)))))

    (list (cons ’+ binary-numerical)

          ...

          (cons ’= binary-comparator)

          (cons ’< binary-comparator)

          ...)))

对于条件表达式，要为条件表达式的值创建一个类型变量，并递归标注每个子表达式：For a conditional expression, a type variable is created for the value of the conditional expression, and each subexpression is recursively annotated:

(define-generic-procedure-handler annotate-expr

  (match-args if-expr? any-object?)

  (lambda (expr env)

    (make-texpr (type-variable)

        (make-if-expr

         (annotate-expr (if-predicate expr) env)

         (annotate-expr (if-consequent expr) env)

         (annotate-expr (if-alternative expr) env)))))

每一种表达式都有相应的标注处理过程。我们不会全部展示，不过lambda表达式的标注很有意思：There are annotation handlers for every kind of expression. We will not show all of them, but the annotation of a lambda expression is interesting:

(define-generic-procedure-handler annotate-expr

  (match-args lambda-expr? any-object?)

  (lambda (expr env)

    (let ((env* (new-frame (lambda-bvl expr) env)))

      (make-texpr

       (procedure-type (map (lambda (name)

                              (get-var-type name env*))

                            (lambda-bvl expr))

                       (type-variable))

       (make-lambda-expr (lambda-bvl expr)

                         (annotate-expr) (lambda-body expr)

                                         env*))))))

与解释器或编译器一样，对lambda表达式进行标注时，会创建一个新的环境框架，用于保存有关约束变量的信息；在这里，为每个约束变量创建一个类型变量。我们用刚为约束变量创建的类型变量，再加上一个表示返回值类型的类型变量，为lambda表达式的值创建一个过程类型，并递归标注过程体。Just as in an interpreter or compiler, the annotation of a lambda expression makes a new environment frame to hold information about the bound variables; in this case we create one type variable for each bound variable. We create a procedure type for the value of the lambda expression, with the type variables we just created for the bound variables and a type variable for the value, and we recursively annotate the body.

约束Constraints

program-constraints过程根据程序的语义结构，建立类型变量上的约束。它同样使用泛型过程实现，为每种表达式类型设置处理过程。The program-constraints procedure formulates constraints on the type variables based on the semantic structure of the program. It is also implemented using a generic procedure with handlers for each expression type.

(define (program-constraints texpr)

  (program-constraints-1 (texpr-type texpr)

                         (texpr-expr texpr)))



(define program-constraints-1

  (simple-generic-procedure ’program-constraints-1 2 #f))

这个泛型过程接受两个实参：表达式的类型，以及表达式本身。它返回一个类型约束列表，其中的约束是研究表达式时发现的。它遍历表达式树，在能够发现类型约束的地方，发现并建立这些约束。This generic procedure takes two arguments: the type of an expression and the expression itself. It returns a list of constraints on the types that it discovers in its study of the expression. It walks the expression tree, discovering and formulating type constraints where they may be found.

下面是条件式的处理过程：Here is the handler for conditionals:

(define-generic-procedure-handler program-constraints-1

  (match-args type-expression? if-expr?)

  (lambda (type expr)

    (append

      (list (constrain (boolean-type)

                       (texpr-type (if-predicate expr)))

            (constrain type

                       (texpr-type (if-consequent expr)))

            (constrain type

                       (texpr-type (if-alternative expr))))

      (program-constraints (if-predicate expr))

      (program-constraints (if-consequent expr))

      (program-constraints (if-alternative expr)))))

这个处理过程建立三个类型约束，并将它们添加到递归处理条件式的三个子表达式时建立的约束中。第一个约束是，谓词表达式的值为布尔值。第二和第三个约束是，条件式的值的类型，与后件表达式及备选表达式的值的类型相同。This handler formulates three type constraints that it adds to the constraints it recursively formulates in the three subexpressions of the conditional. The first constraint is that the value of the predicate expression is a boolean. The second and third constraints are that the type of the value of the conditional is the same as the types of the value of the consequent expression and the value of the alternative expression.

约束用等式表示：The constraints are represented as equations:

(define (constrain lhs rhs)

  ‘(= ,lhs ,rhs))

（标识符lhs和rhs分别是“等式左侧”和“等式右侧”的助记名称。）(The identifiers lhs and rhs are mnemonic for “left-hand side” and “right-hand side” respectively.)

lambda表达式的类型约束是：lambda表达式所产生过程的返回值类型，与其过程体的值的类型相同。这一约束将与为过程体建立的约束合并。The type constraint for a lambda expression is that the type of the value returned by the lambda expression's procedure is the same as the type of the value of its body. This is combined with the constraints formulated for the body.

(define-generic-procedure-handler program-constraints-1

  (match-args type-expression? lambda-expr?)

  (lambda (type expr)

    (cons (constrain (procedure-type-codomain type)

                     (texpr-type (lambda-body expr)))

          (program-constraints (lambda-body expr)))))

过程调用的约束是：运算符的类型是过程类型；各操作数表达式的类型与该过程的实参类型匹配；该过程返回值的类型就是该调用的类型。The constraints for a procedure call are that the operator's type is a procedure type, the types of the operand expressions match the argument types of the procedure, and the type of the value returned by the procedure is the type of the call.

(define-generic-procedure-handler program-constraints-1

  (match-args type-expression? combination-expr?)

  (lambda (type expr)

    (cons (constrain (texpr-type (combination-operator expr))

                     (procedure-type

                      (map texpr-type

                           (combination-operands expr))

                      type))

          (append

            (program-constraints (combination-operator expr))

            (append-map program-constraints

                        (combination-operands expr))))))

合一Unification

发现的每个约束，都是两个类型表达式之间的等式。因此，现在有了一组需要求解的方程。这通过对每个等式的左侧（lhs）和右侧（rhs）进行合一来完成。所有这些合一必须在同一个变量绑定上下文中完成，才能同时求解这些方程。由于两个列表的合一会合一列表中相应的元素，因此只需把所有约束合并成一次巨大的合一：Each constraint discovered is an equation of two type expressions. So we now have a set of equations to solve. This is accomplished by unifying the left-hand side (lhs) and right-hand side (rhs) of each equation. All these unifications must be done in the same variable-binding context so as to solve them simultaneously. Since unification of two lists unifies corresponding elements of the lists, we can just combine the constraints into one giant unification:

(define (unify-constraints constraints)

  (unify (map constraint-lhs constraints)

         (map constraint-rhs constraints)))

随后，infer-program-types（第196页）使用unify-constraints返回的字典，实例化带类型的程序。The dictionary returned by unify-constraints is then used by infer-program-types (on page 196) to instantiate the typed program.

评析Critique

虽然这个小型类型推断系统很好地演示了合一，但它并不十分擅长类型推断：它对过程的处理确实不太好。例如，考虑这个简单情形：Although this small type-inference system is a nice demonstration of unification, it is not very good at type inference: it doesn't really handle procedures very well. For example, consider the simple case:

(pp (infer-program-types

     ’(begin (define id (lambda (x) x))

             (id 2))))

它看起来能够正确工作，返回This apparently works correctly, returning

(t (numeric-type)

   (begin

     (t (type:procedure ((numeric-type)) (numeric-type))

        (define id

          (t (type:procedure ((numeric-type)) (numeric-type))

             (lambda (x) (t (numeric-type) x)))))

     (t (numeric-type)

        ((t (type:procedure ((numeric-type)) (numeric-type))

            id)

         (t (numeric-type) 2)))))

但请注意，恒等过程被赋予了接受数值实参、返回数值的类型，原因是该过程被用于一个数值实参。然而，恒等过程的正确类型不应要求某种特定类型的实参。更一般地说，过程的类型不应取决于它在某个例子中的用法。这种混淆导致系统无法为一段完全合理的代码赋予类型：But notice that the identity procedure has been typed as having a numeric argument and a numeric value, because the procedure was used with a numeric argument. However, the correct type for the identity procedure should not require any specific kind of argument. More generally, the type of a procedure should not depend on its use in an example. This confusion causes a failure to type a perfectly reasonable piece of code:

(infer-program-types

  ’(begin (define id (lambda (x) x))

          (id 2)

          (id #t)))

***type-error***

练习4.14：过程Exercise 4.14: Procedures

上面评析中展示的具体问题并不难修复，但一般情形很复杂。如何处理作为实参传递、以及作为值返回的过程？请记住，过程中可能有自由变量，它们在过程定义处受到词法绑定。The specific problem shown in the critique above is not very hard to fix, but the general case is complicated. How can we handle procedures passed as arguments and returned as values? Remember that there may be free variables in a procedure that are lexically bound where the procedure was defined.

设计一个修复这一问题的方案，并尽可能使其通用。Work out a fix for this problem, and make it as general as you can.

练习4.15：参数化类型Exercise 4.15: Parametric types

本练习考察，要扩展这个类型推断系统，使它支持参数化类型，需要做些什么。例如，Scheme的map过程可以操作由任意类型对象组成的列表。This exercise examines what it takes to extend this type-inference system to work with parametric types. For example, the Scheme map procedure operates on lists of objects of any type.

  1. a. 要扩展系统以支持参数化类型，必须做些什么？这一扩展是否要求修改合一器？如果是，解释为什么有此必要；如果不是，解释为什么不必要。a. What must be done to extend the system to support parametric types? Does this extension require us to modify the unifier? If so, explain why it is necessary. If not, explain why it is not necessary.
  2. b. 实现允许使用参数化类型所需的改动。b. Implement the changes required to allow parametric types to be used.

练习4.16：联合类型Exercise 4.16: Union types

这里概述的类型推断系统完全不支持联合类型。例如，加法运算符+被定义为用于数值算术。但如果希望+既表示数的相加，又表示字符串的连接，该怎么办？The type-inference system we have outlined here does not have any support for union types. For example, the addition operator + is defined for numeric arithmetic. But what if we want + to be both addition of numbers and concatenation of strings?

  1. a. 要扩展系统以支持联合类型，必须做些什么？这一扩展是否要求修改合一器？如果是，解释为什么有此必要；如果不是，解释为什么不必要。a. What must be done to extend the system to support union types? Does this extension require us to modify the unifier? If so, explain why it is necessary. If not, explain why it is not necessary.
  2. b. 实现允许使用联合类型所需的改动。注意：这并不容易。b. Implement the changes required to allow union types to be used. Note: This is not easy.

练习4.17：副作用Exercise 4.17: Side effects

这里概述的类型推断系统足以应对纯函数式程序。能否优雅地扩展它，使其适用于包含赋值的程序？如果你认为可以，请解释并演示你的设计；如果认为不可以，请说明理由。The type-inference system we have outlined here is adequate for pure functional programs. Can it be elegantly extended to work for programs with assignment? If you think so, explain and demonstrate your design. If you think not, explain your reasons.

这并不容易。理解这个问题并使其可行，可能是一个不错的学期项目。This is not easy. It may be a nice term project to understand this and make it work.

练习4.18：这实用吗？Exercise 4.18: Is this practical?

我们的类型推断实现实用吗？Is our implementation of type inference practical?

  1. a. 估计标注阶段和约束阶段所需的时间与空间，随被分析程序规模增长的阶。a. Estimate the orders of growth of time and space of the annotation and constraints phases with the size of the program being analyzed.
  2. b. 使用所展示的算法，估计巨大合一阶段所需时间与空间的增长阶。如果使用目前已知的最佳合一算法呢？（这需要查阅一些文献。）b. Estimate the order of growth of time and space of the giant unification phase, using the algorithm shown. What about the best known algorithms for unification? (This will take some library research.)
  3. c. 能否将巨大合一阶段拆分成若干部分，使整体具有更好的渐近行为？c. Is there a way to break up the giant unification phase into parts so that the whole has better asymptotic behavior?

4.4.4 添加片段变量——一项实验！4.4.4 Adding segment variables—an experiment!

为合一器添加片段变量令人兴奋：我们并不确切知道会得到什么。10但由于我们谨慎地使用了泛型过程，任何依赖于未添加片段变量时合一器行为的程序（例如类型推断的例子），都不会因为这项实验而给出错误答案。事实上，以泛型过程来组织合一器，使这类实验相对不容易出问题。11Adding segment variables to the unifier is exciting: we are not sure exactly what we will get.10 But our careful use of generic procedures will ensure that no program that depends on the behavior of the unifier without the addition of segment variables (such as the type inference example) will produce wrong answers as a consequence of this experiment. Indeed, the organization of the unifier in terms of generic procedures makes such experiments relatively unproblematic.11

使用谓词来分派，控制着元素变量与片段变量之间的相互作用。例如，片段变量可以把元素变量包含在它所积累的片段中，但元素变量的值不能是片段变量。因此，必须修改谓词element?（第192页）的定义，以排除片段变量：The use of predicates for the dispatch controls the interaction between element variables and segment variables. For example, a segment variable may incorporate an element variable into a segment it accumulates, but an element variable may not have a segment variable as its value. Thus, we must change our definition of the predicate element? (on page 192) to exclude segment variables:

(define (element? term)

  (not (match:segment-var? term)))

我们需要针对片段变量各种情形的泛型处理过程。对于以片段变量开头的项列表，unify:gdispatch的处理过程是maybe-grab-segment，它按如下方式安装。已知包含片段变量的列表，总是作为第一个实参传给maybe-grab-segment（就像对maybe-substitute所做的那样）。12We need generic handlers for the segment variable cases. The unify:gdispatch handler for term lists that start with a segment variable is maybe-grab-segment, which is installed as follows. The list known to contain the segment variable is always passed as the first argument to maybe-grab-segment (as we did with maybe-substitute).12

(define-generic-procedure-handler unify:gdispatch

  (match-args (car-satisfies match:segment-var?)

              (complement (car-satisfies match:segment-var?)))

  (lambda (var-first terms)

    (maybe-grab-segment var-first terms)))



(define-generic-procedure-handler unify:gdispatch

  (match-args (complement (car-satisfies match:segment-var?))

              (car-satisfies match:segment-var?))

  (lambda (terms var-first)

    (maybe-grab-segment var-first terms)))

匹配两个都以片段变量开头的项列表时，有一个特殊情况需要处理：如果两个列表以同一个片段变量开头，就可以直接略过这个恒真式，无须进一步处理。否则，从任一变量出发都有可能得到匹配。然而，有些情况下，从一个变量出发可以得到合适的匹配，从另一个出发却不行，这取决于变量在模式中的后续出现。为了确保不漏掉从某个变量出发的匹配，我们让匹配具有对称性：如果第一个顺序失败，就尝试另一个顺序。In matching two termlists that each start with a segment variable, there is a special case to be handled: if both lists start with the same segment variable, we can dismiss the tautology without further work. Otherwise it is possible that we will get a match starting with either variable. But there are cases where a good match is obtained with one variable but not the other, depending on the further occurrences of the variables in the patterns. To make sure we don't miss a match starting with one of the variables, we make the match symmetrical by trying the other order if the first one fails.

(define (unify:segment-var-var var-first1 var-first2)

  (define (unify-seg-var-var dict succeed fail)

    (if (match:vars-equal? (car var-first1) (car var-first2))

        (succeed dict fail (cdr var-first1) (cdr var-first2))

        ((maybe-grab-segment var-first1 var-first2)

         dict

         succeed

         (lambda ()

           ((maybe-grab-segment var-first2 var-first1)

            dict

            succeed

            fail)))))

  unify-seg-var-var)



(define-generic-procedure-handler unify:gdispatch

  (match-args (car-satisfies match:segment-var?)

              (car-satisfies match:segment-var?))

  unify:segment-var-var)

过程maybe-grab-segment类似于处理元素变量的过程maybe-substitute（第191页）。片段变量与自身匹配的情况，已由unify:segment-var-var处理；因此，maybe-grab-segment首先检查var-first开头的片段变量是否有值。如果有，就用该值替换变量，再把所得列表与项列表terms匹配。由于片段变量的绑定值是它吞掉的元素组成的列表，所以使用append将片段变量替换为它的值。匹配未绑定片段变量这一更复杂的任务，则交给grab-segment。The procedure maybe-grab-segment is analogous to the procedure maybe-substitute (on page 191) used for element variables. The case of matching a segment variable against itself was handled by unify:segment-var-var; so maybe-grab-segment starts by checking if the segment variable at the start of var-first has a value. If so, we replace the variable with its value and match the resulting list against the term list terms. Because the binding of a segment variable is the list of elements that it gobbles, we use append to replace the segment variable with its value. The more complex job of matching an unbound segment variable is passed on to grab-segment.

(define (maybe-grab-segment var-first terms)

  (define (maybe-grab dict succeed fail)

    (let ((var (car var-first)))

      (if (match:has-binding? var dict)

          ((unify:dispatch

            (append (match:get-value var dict)

                    (cdr var-first))

            terms)

           dict succeed fail)

          ((grab-segment var-first terms)

           dict succeed fail))))

  maybe-grab)

过程grab-segment是真正进行片段匹配和回溯的地方。项列表分为两部分：起始片段和剩余各项（terms*）。起始片段（initial）最初为空，而terms*是整个项列表。匹配过程尝试在片段变量绑定到initial的情况下继续。如果失败，失败续延就把一个元素从terms*移到initial，然后尝试匹配。重复这一过程，直到匹配成功，或对整个项列表的匹配也失败：The procedure grab-segment is where the segment matching and backtracking actually happen. The term list is broken into two parts: an initial segment and the rest of the terms (terms*). The initial segment (initial) starts out empty and terms* is the whole term list. The match tries to proceed with the segment variable bound to initial. If that fails, the failure continuation tries to match with an element moved from terms* to initial. This is repeated until either a match succeeds or the match of the entire term list fails:

(define (grab-segment var-first terms)

  (define (grab dict succeed fail)

    (let ((var (car var-first)))

      (let slp ((initial ’()) (terms* terms))

        (define (continue)

          (if (null? terms*)

              (fail)

              (slp (append initial (list (car terms*)))

                   (cdr terms*))))

        (let ((dict* (do-substitute var initial dict)))

            (if dict*

                (succeed dict* continue (cdr var-first) terms*)

                (continue))))))

  grab)

这似乎就是构造一个带有实验性片段变量扩展的合一器所需的全部工作。有了片段变量，就必须预期会得到多个匹配。我们可以拒绝一个匹配，强迫程序回溯，以获得另一个匹配。注意，字典的每个条目都是一个列表，包含变量名、值以及变量类型。This appears to be all that is required to make a unifier with an experimental extension for segment variables. With segment variables we must expect to get multiple matches. We can reject a match, forcing the program to backtrack, to get an alternative. Note that each dictionary entry is a list containing the name of the variable, the value, and the type of the variable.

可以将合一器用作单边匹配器。例如，将分配律模式与给定代数表达式匹配，恰好有两种方式，如下所示：13We can use the unifier as a one-sided matcher. For example, there are exactly two ways to match the distributive law pattern to the given algebraic expression, as we see:13

(let ((pattern ’(* (?? a) (+ (?? b)) (?? c)))

      (expression ’(* x y (+ z w) m (+ n o) p)))

  (unify:internal pattern expression (match:new-dict)

    (lambda (dict)

      (pp (match:bindings dict)) 

      #f)))

((c (m (+ n o) p) ??) (b (z w) ??) (a (x y) ??))

((c (p) ??) (b (n o) ??) (a (x y (+ z w) m) ??))

#f

这两个字典产生相同的代换实例：Both of these dictionaries produce the same substitution instance:

(* x y (+ z w) m (+ n o) p)

但在代数操作程序中，我们实际上需要两个字典，因为它们分别表示分配律的一种不同应用。But in an algebraic manipulator we really want both dictionaries, because each of them represents a different application of the distributive law.

当片段变量与包含片段变量的列表匹配时，事情就变得更复杂，也更不清楚了：Things get more complicated and much less clear when segment variables match against lists containing segment variables:

(let ((p1 ’(a (?? x) (?? y) (?? x) c))

      (p2 ’(a b b b (?? w) b b b c)))

  (unify:internal p1 p2 (match:new-dict)

    (lambda (dict)

      (pp (match:bindings dict))

      #f)))



((y (b b b (?? w) b b b) ??) (x () ??))

((y (b b (?? w) b b) ??) (x (b) ??))

((y (b (?? w) b) ??) (x (b b) ??))

((w () ??) (y () ??) (x (b b b) ??))

((w () ??) (y () ??) (x (b b b) ??))

((y ((?? w)) ??) (x (b b b) ??))

((y () ??) (w () ??) (x (b b b) ??))

((w ((?? y)) ??) (x (b b b) ??))

((w () ??) (y () ??) (x (b b b) ??))

#f

显然，有很多方法可以完成这一匹配。但其中许多字典，实际上只是构造同一个代换实例的不同方式。为了看清这一点，我们为每种情况构造代换实例：Apparently, there are many ways to make this match. But many of the dictionaries are really different ways of constructing the same substitution instance. To see this clearly, we construct the substitution instance in each case:

(let ((p1 ’(a (?? x) (?? y) (?? x) c))

      (p2 ’(a b b b (?? w) b b b c)))

  (unify:internal p1 p2 (match:new-dict)

    (lambda (dict)

      (and dict

           (let ((subst (match:dict-substitution dict)))

             (let ((p1* (subst p1)) (p2* (subst p2)))

               (if (not (equal? p1* p2*))

                   (error "Bad dictionary"))

               (pp p1*))))

      #f)))



(a b b b (?? w) b b b c)

(a b b b (?? w) b b b c)

(a b b b (?? w) b b b c) (a b b b b b b c)

(a b b b b b b c)

(a b b b (?? w) b b b c) (a b b b b b b c)

(a b b b (?? y) b b b c) (a b b b b b b c)

#f

因此可以看到，每个“解”都是这个问题的有效解：为变量找到一些值，将这些值代回给定模式后，能使模式相同。在这个例子中，有五个解是等价的。这五个是最一般的合一结果，不计变量重命名的差别，它们是唯一的。其他四个则没有达到最大的一般性。然而，合一本应产生两个输入模式唯一的、最一般的共同代换实例，不计变量重命名的差别。因此，加入片段之后，这个非常有用的模式匹配器实际上就不是合一器了。So we see that each “solution” is a valid solution to the problem of finding values for the variables that when substituted back into the given patterns make the patterns the same. In this case five of the solutions are equivalent. These five are the most general unifiers, and they are unique up to renaming of the variables. The other four are not as general as possible. But unification is supposed to produce the unique most general common substitution instance of the two input patterns, up to renaming of variables. So with segments, this very useful pattern matcher is not really a unifier.

实际上，问题还要更严重一些。有些完全有效的匹配，这个程序却找不到。下面是一个例子：Actually, the problem is a bit worse. There are perfectly good matches that are not found by this program. Here is an example:

;;; A missing match!

(unify:internal ’(((?? x) 3) ((?? x)))

                ’((4 (?? y)) (4 5))

                (match:new-dict)

                (lambda (dict)

                  (pp (match:bindings dict))

                  #f))

#f

但这些表达式确实能够匹配，绑定如下：But these expressions do match, with the following bindings:

((x (4 5) ??) (y (5 3) ??))

真令人遗憾！不过，这个故事有一条启示。使用泛型过程，我们可以对正确的算法作出可能有问题的扩展，而不破坏它在使用未扩展算法时的正确性。即使这些扩展不满足未扩展算法的正确性要求，也可能对某些用途有用。How sad! But there is a moral to this story. Using generic procedures, we can make possibly problematic extensions to a correct algorithm without undermining its correctness for uses of the unextended algorithm. The extensions may be useful for some purposes, even without satisfying the correctness requirements of the unextended algorithm.

练习4.19：能修复这些问题吗？Exercise 4.19: Can we fix these problems?

对包含片段变量的模式进行合一时，我们遇到了问题。我们可能漏掉某些匹配，可能生成同一个解的多个副本；而有些解虽然确实能使输入模式相等，却并不是最一般的。让我们考虑如何修复这些问题。We have a problem with unifying patterns containing segment variables. We may miss some matches; we may generate multiple copies of the same solution; and some of the solutions, although valid solutions of the problem to make the input patterns equal, are not maximally general. Let's think about fixing this.

  1. a. 为unify:internal编写一个包装过程，收集所有的解。如果使用赋值，这并不困难；不过，寻找一种函数式解决方案可能更有趣——但不必为此费太大劲！a. Write a wrapper for unify:internal that collects all of the solutions. This is not hard if you use assignments, but it might be more fun to look for a functional solution—but don't try too hard!
  2. b. 既然已经有了所有的解，去掉重复解就很容易了。用每个解中的代换对输入进行替换，生成结果。可以检查对两个输入进行代换的结果是否相等——这是对求解算法正确性的检查。然后，为每个不同的结果，保存由一个代换和一个结果组成的对。要小心：变量名并不重要，因此，如果将一个所得字典中的变量统一重命名后能够得到另一个字典，那么这两个字典就表示同一个解。b. Now that you have all of the solutions, it is easy to eliminate duplicates. Create the result of substituting from each solution into the inputs. You can check that the results of the two substitutions are equal—this is a check that the algorithm for solving is correct. Now save the pair of one substitution and one result for each distinct result. Be careful: The name of a variable doesn't matter, so two resulting dictionaries represent the same solution if you can get one by uniformly renaming variables in the other.
  3. c. 如果集合中的某个结果是另一个结果的代换实例，那么它就不是两个输入的一个最一般的共同特化。c. If any result in the collection is a substitution instance of another result, it is not a most general common specialization of the two inputs.

编写谓词substitution-instance?，将这些结果过滤掉。现在，剩下的集合就是该算法能够生成的最一般的共同特化。返回它们。Write the predicate substitution-instance? to filter those out. You are now left with the collection of the most general common specializations that this algorithm will generate. Return these.

  1. d. 想出一种办法，避免漏掉上面“A missing match!”所展示的那类匹配。能否对所展示的代码作一个简单扩展，就处理这种匹配？注意：这是一个极其困难的问题。d. Figure out a way to avoid missing matches like the “A missing match!” shown above. Is there a simple extension of the code shown that can handle this kind of match? Note: This is an extremely difficult problem.

练习4.20：更一般的匹配Exercise 4.20: More general matches

除了上面展示的棘手问题之外，还有一个合一器没有处理的有趣微妙之处。考虑以下问题：Beyond the nasty problems shown above, there is an interesting subtlety that is not addressed by the unifier. Consider the following problem:

(unifier ’((?? x) 3) ’(4 (?? y)))

(4 3)

这里可以看到一个完全有效的匹配，但它不是可能得到的最一般的匹配。问题在于，4与3之间可以有任意多个东西。更好的答案应该是：Here we see a perfectly good match, but it is not the most general one possible. The problem is that there can be any number of things between the 4 and the 3. A better answer would be:

(4 (?? z) 3)

想出如何得到这个答案。这需要对合一器作出相当大的扩展。Figure out how to get this answer. This requires a significant extension to the unifier.

练习4.21：带片段的字符串Exercise 4.21: Strings with segments

如果你还没做练习 4.11（第 193 页），现在就做。不过，这里我们希望你加入字符串片段变量。这在匹配 DNA 片段时可能很有用！If you did not do exercise 4.11 (page 193), do it now. But here we want you to add string segment variables. This can be useful in matching segments of DNA!

4.5 图上的模式匹配4.5 Pattern matching on graphs

到目前为止，我们开发的模式匹配都是用来匹配列表结构的。这类结构非常适合表示表达式，例如代数表达式或计算机语言表达式的抽象语法树。不过，模式匹配也可以用来构建处理范围广泛得多的数据的系统。如果所关心的结构可以用一种可达关系来刻画，那么将它描述为一个图可能很合适：节点代表“位置”，边代表描述这些位置如何相互连接的“路径元素”。电路就是这类结构的一个例子，其中电路元件和电路节点都是位置，而可达关系就是对互连方式的描述。国际象棋或西洋跳棋之类的棋盘游戏也是一个例子，其中棋盘格可以用图中的节点表示，而格子之间的相邻关系可以用图中的边表示。The pattern matching we have developed so far is for matching list structures. Such structures are excellent for representing expressions, such as algebraic expressions or the abstract syntax trees of computer-language expressions. However, pattern matching can be used to make systems that operate on a much wider range of data. If the structure of interest can be characterized by an accessibility relation, it may be appropriate to describe the structure as a graph of nodes representing “places” and edges representing “path elements” describing how the places are interconnected. An electrical circuit is an example of such a structure, where the circuit parts and circuit nodes are places and the accessibility relation is just the description of the interconnect. A board game like chess or checkers is another, where the board squares may be represented by nodes in a graph and the adjacency of squares may be represented by edges in the graph.

我们将把图实现为节点和边的集合。我们的图是不可变的，其含义是：节点或边一旦加入，就不能再修改；改变图的唯一办法是添加更多节点和边。这会带来一些后果，我们将在以下部分看到：We will implement a graph as a collection of nodes and edges. Our graphs are immutable in the sense that once a node or an edge is added, it cannot be modified; the graph can be changed only by adding more nodes and edges. This will have consequences that we will see in 第 4.5.4 节section 4.5.4.

一个节点包含一组边，而一条边是标签与值的组合。边的标签是在 eqv? 判定下唯一的对象，通常是符号或数。边的值是一个 Scheme 对象，往往是另一个节点。A node contains a collection of edges, and an edge is a combination of a label and a value. The label of an edge is an object that is unique under eqv?, usually a symbol or a number. The value of an edge is a Scheme object, often another node.

这个实现既适用于具体图（构建图时，所有节点和边都已可用），也适用于惰性图（访问时按需扩展图）。在线性序列这个较简单的世界中，列表是具体图，而流则是引用时才生成的惰性图。This implementation will work with concrete graphs (where all of the nodes and edges are available at the time we build the graph) and lazy graphs (where the graph is extended, as necessary, at the time of access). In the simpler world of linear sequences, a list is a concrete graph and a stream is a lazy graph that is generated when referenced.

我们先看一个简单的例子，了解图是如何工作的。然后，我们将用国际象棋裁判这个贯穿性的例子，探索图以及图上模式匹配的更复杂的用途。We will first look at a simple example to see how graphs work. We will then use an extended example, a chess referee, to explore more complex uses of graphs and pattern matching on graphs.

4.5.1 把列表看作图4.5.1 Lists as graphs

我们从简单而熟悉的列表世界开始。cons 单元就是节点，用 g:cons 创建；它们的 car 和 cdr 将实现为标签分别为 car 和 cdr 的边，并通过 g:car 和 g:cdr 访问：We start with the simple but familiar world of lists. The cons cells are the nodes, which will be made with g:cons and whose car and cdr will be implemented as edges labeled with car and cdr and accessed by g:car and g:cdr:

(define (g:cons car cdr)

  (let ((pair (make-graph-node ’pair)))

    (pair ’connect! ’car car)

    (pair ’connect! ’cdr cdr)

    pair))



(define (g:car pair) (pair ’edge-value ’car))

(define (g:cdr pair) (pair ’edge-value ’cdr))

要把列表表示为图，我们需要一个专门的列表结束标记：To represent lists as graphs we need a special end marker for lists:

(define nil (make-graph-node ’nil))



(define (g:null) nil)



(define (g:null? object) (eqv? object nil))

将列表转换为列表图的过程如下：The conversion of a list to a list graph is:

(define (list->graph list)

  (if (pair? list)

      (g:cons (car list) (list->graph (cdr list)))

      (g:null)))

一个简单的例子按预期工作：and a simple example works as expected:

(define g (list->graph ’(a b c)))



(and (eqv? ’a (g:car g))

     (eqv? ’b (g:car (g:cdr g)))

     (eqv? ’c (g:car (g:cdr (g:cdr g))))

     (g:null? (g:cdr (g:cdr (g:cdr g)))))

#t

我们可以修改列表图构造过程，使其支持惰性图，在遍历边时才创建节点：We can modify the list-graph constructor to allow lazy graphs, with nodes that are created as edges are traversed:

(define (list->lazy-graph list)

  (if (pair? list)

      (g:cons (delay (car list))

              (delay (list->lazy-graph (cdr list))))

      (g:null)))

这里我们使用 Scheme [109] 的 delay 构造一个允诺；对允诺执行 force 时，它就会对被延迟（推迟）的表达式求值。流 [13]（惰性列表）通常用 delay 和 force 来构造。Here we used the Scheme [109] delay to construct a promise that will evaluate the delayed (postponed) expression when the promise is forced. Streams [13] (lazy lists) are usually constructed using delay and force.

4.5.2 实现图4.5.2 Implementing graphs

我们必须能够创建图节点，并通过边把它们连接到其他节点。我们将把图节点表示为一个捆绑过程：一组可以按名称调用的委托过程。14We have to be able to make graph nodes and connect them to other nodes by edges. We will represent a graph node as a bundle procedure: a collection of delegate procedures that can be called by name.14

(define (make-graph-node name)

  (let ((edges ’()))

    (define (get-name) name)

    (define (all-edges) (list-copy edges))

    (define (%find-edge label)

      (find (lambda (edge)

              (eqv? label (edge ’get-label)))

            edges))

    (define (has-edge? label)

      (and (%find-edge label) #t)) ; boolean value

    (define (get-edge label)

      (let ((edge (%find-edge label)))

        (if (not edge)

            (error "No edge with this label:" label))

        edge))

    (define (edge-value label)

      ((get-edge label) ’get-value))

    (define (connect! label value)

      (if (has-edge? label)

          (error "Two edges with same label:" label))

      (set! edges

            (cons (make-graph-edge label value) edges)))

    (define (maybe-connect! label value)

      (if (not (default-object? value))

          (connect! label value)))

    (bundle graph-node? get-name all-edges has-edge?

            get-edge edge-value connect! maybe-connect!)))

make-graph-node 的参数是新节点的名称；打印节点对象时会显示这个名称。bundle 宏的第一个参数是一个谓词，生成的捆绑对象将满足这个谓词。在这里，它定义为The argument to make-graph-node is the name of the new node; this is shown when printing a node object. The first argument to the bundle macro is a predicate that the generated bundle will satisfy. In this case, it is defined as

(define graph-node? (make-bundle-predicate ’graph-node))

其他捆绑对象谓词的定义都很相似，因此不再列出。We will not show the definitions of other bundle predicates since they are similar.

边也表示为捆绑过程。一条边可以有一个具体的值，也可以以一个允诺为值（由 delay 构造），在需要时才产生这个值。后者使惰性图结构成为可能。Edges are also represented as bundle procedures. An edge may have a concrete value or the value may be a promise (constructed by delay) to produce the value when asked. The latter provides for lazy graph structures.

(define (make-graph-edge label value)

  (define (get-label) label)

  (define (get-value)

    (if (promise? value)

        (force value)

        value))

  (bundle graph-edge? get-label get-value))

练习 4.22：更多惰性图Exercise 4.22: More lazy graphs

我们已经展示了如何创建具体列表和惰性列表。那么，一些更有趣的结构呢？We have shown how to make concrete lists and lazy lists. How about some more interesting structures?

有一棵可以动态扩展的树，或许会很不错。例如，用这种方式构建博弈树可能很有用：随着资源变得可用，我们可能希望同时从广度和深度两个方面细化这棵树。构造一个这样的树的例子，使它既可以随着每一层考虑更多合理的走法而扩展，也可以随着增加更多需要考虑的层而扩展。Perhaps it would be nice to have a dynamically extensible tree. For example, a game tree could be usefully built this way: we may want to elaborate the tree both in breadth and depth as resources become available. Make an example of such a tree that can be extended as more plausible moves are considered at each level, and as more levels are added for consideration.

4.5.3 图上的匹配4.5.3 Matching on graphs

我们可能希望在图中寻找有趣的特征。一种办法是尝试让模式与图匹配。图的模式可以指定一个由节点和边交替组成的序列，即一条路径。要匹配这样的模式，可以从一个节点出发，尝试沿着模式指定的路径行进。We might want to search a graph for interesting features. One way to do this is to try to match patterns to the graph. A pattern for a graph could specify an alternating sequence of nodes and edges: a path. Such a pattern can be matched by starting at a node and trying to follow the path specified by the pattern.

例如，设想我们有一个国际象棋棋盘和一些棋子。棋盘格是图的节点。表示相邻格子的节点通过边与给定节点相连。我们可以从执白棋的棋手的视角，用罗盘方位给边加上标签：north, south, east, west, northeast, southeast, northwest, southwest。沿 north 走就是朝棋盘黑方的一侧走，沿 south 走则是朝棋盘白方的一侧走。Imagine, for example, that we have a chessboard and chess pieces. The board squares are nodes of a graph. The nodes representing adjacent squares are connected to a given node by edges. We can label the edges, as seen by the player playing White, by compass directions: north, south, east, west, northeast, southeast, northwest, southwest. Going north is toward the Black side of the board, and going south is toward the White side of the board.

有了这样的安排，我们就可以把马沿北、北、东的方向走的一步表示为：Given such an arrangement, we can specify a move where a knight may move north-north-east as:

(define basic-knight-move

  ‘((? source-node ,(occupied-by ’knight))

    north (?)

    north (?)

    east (? target-node ,maybe-opponent)))

这个模式与我们在前几节中见过的模式有几个共同特征：元素变量以 ? 字符引入；它们可以有名称（例如 source-node），也可以有限制条件（例如 (occupied-by ’knight)）。我们引入语法 (?) 来表示匿名元素变量。This pattern shares several characteristics with those we've looked at in previous sections: element variables are introduced by the ? character; they can have names (e.g., source-node); and they can have restrictions (e.g., (occupied-by ’knight)). We introduce the syntax (?) to indicate an anonymous element variable.

模式匹配从 source-node 开始，经过两条标签为 north 的边——途经的节点我们并不关心——最后沿 east 方向到达 target-node。我们把这种模式称为路径模式，或在国际象棋的语境中称为走法模式。The pattern match starts with source-node, traverses two edges labeled north—with nodes that we don't care about—and finally travels east to reach target-node. We call this kind of pattern a path pattern, or in the context of chess, a move pattern.

当然，这只是马的一种可能走法。不过，我们可以利用对称性生成马的所有可能走法：可以将这一走法作东西镜像反射，可以将它顺时针旋转 90 度，还可以将它旋转 180 度：Of course, this is only one possible knight move. But we can generate all possible knight moves by symmetries: we can reflect the knight move east-west, we can rotate it clockwise by 90 degrees, and we can rotate it by 180 degrees:

(define all-knight-moves

  (symmetrize-move basic-knight-move

                   reflect-ew rotate-90 rotate-180))

symmetrize-move 过程应用这三种对称变换的所有可能组合，产生八种走法。对于我们使用的这些变换，应用对称变换的先后顺序无关紧要。The symmetrize-move procedure applies all possible combinations of these three symmetries to produce eight moves. The order in which the symmetry transformations are applied doesn't matter for the transformations we use.

(define (symmetrize-move move . transformations)

  (let loop ((xforms transformations) (moves (list move)))

    (if (null? xforms)

        moves

        (loop (cdr xforms)

              (append moves

                      (map (rewrite-path-edges (car xforms))

                           moves))))))

其中，rewrite-path-edges 将其参数应用于一个走法中的每个边标签，产生一个替换了边标签的新走法。where rewrite-path-edges applies its argument to each edge label in a move, producing a new move with substituted edge labels.

这样一种对称变换的例子是One example of such a symmetry transformation is

(define (reflect-ew label)

  (case label

    ((east) ’west)

    ((northeast) ’northwest)

    ((northwest) ’northeast)

    ((southeast) 'southwest)

    ((southwest) 'southeast)

    ((west) ’east)

    (else label)))

其他变换也是类似的罗盘方位重映射。and the others are similar remappings of the compass directions.

得到的马的全部走法列表为The resulting list of all knight moves is

((source north (?) north (?) east target ) (source north (?) north (?) west target)

 (source east (?) east (?) south target)

 (source east (?) east (?) north target)

 (source south (?) south (?) west target)

 (source south (?) south (?) east target)

 (source west (?) west (?) north target)

 (source west (?) west (?) south target))

这里我们简化了打印结果，把带有限制条件的起点和终点节点变量分别替换为 source 和 target。where we have simplified the printing by replacing the restricted source and target node variables with source and target.

马的走法在国际象棋中很特殊：马可以越过被己方或对方棋子占据的格子，到达目标格。车、象和后不能穿过被占据的格子，但在到达目标格的途中，可以经过许多空格。我们需要一种办法来指定这种重复遍历。我们用 (* ...) 来指定重复遍历：Knight moves are special in chess, in that a knight can move over squares occupied by either a friend or an opponent to get to the target square. Rooks, bishops, and queens may not pass through an occupied square, but they may pass through many unoccupied squares on their way to a target square. We need a way to specify such a repeated traversal. We use (* ...) to specify a repeated traversal:

(define basic-queen-move

  ‘((? source-node ,(occupied-by ’queen))

    (* north (?* ,unoccupied))

    north (? target-node ,maybe-opponent)))

后可以沿北向穿过任意多个空格，到达目标格。记法 (?* ...) 是一种新的模式变量，只能在 (* ...) 模式内部使用。它与简单模式变量一样匹配一个元素，但保存的并非单个匹配值，而是把重复过程中匹配到的所有元素收集成一个列表。于是，后的全部可能走法为：The queen may move north through any number of unoccupied squares to the target square. The notation (?* ...) is a new kind of pattern variable that can be used only inside a (* ...) pattern. Like a simple pattern variable, it matches one element, but instead of saving just a single matched value, it collects a list of all elements matched in the repeat. All of the queen's possible moves are then:

(define all-queen-moves

  (symmetrize-move basic-queen-move

                   rotate-45 rotate-90 rotate-180))

兵的规则更复杂。兵几乎是唯一一种其可能走法取决于自身位置或邻近敌方棋子位置的棋子。15 兵在初始位置可以向北走一步或两步，但不在初始位置时只能向北走一步。当且仅当这一步能吃掉对方棋子时，兵才可以向东北或西北走一步。最后，位于倒数第二行的兵可以走到最后一行，并升变为任意一种棋子，通常是后。16Pawns have more complicated rules. A pawn is (almost) the only piece whose possible moves depend on its position or the position of a neighboring opponent.15 A pawn may go north one or two steps from its initial position, but it may go only one step north if not in its initial position. A pawn may take one step northeast or northwest if and only if that move takes an opponent piece. Finally, a pawn in the penultimate row may move into the last row and be promoted into any piece, usually a queen.16

练习 4.23：补全国际象棋走法Exercise 4.23: Filling out chess moves

我们已经展示了如何为马和后的走法构造模式，但还没有为所有棋子的走法构造模式。We have shown how to make patterns for knight moves and queen moves, but we have not made patterns for moves for all chess pieces.

  1. a. 车和象的走法与后的走法相似，但限制更多：车不能斜走，而象只能斜走。为象的全部走法以及车的全部简单走法构造模式。a. Rook moves and bishop moves are similar to queen moves, but more restricted: a rook cannot move diagonally, and a bishop can move only diagonally. Make patterns for all bishop moves and all simple rook moves.
  2. b. 兵的走法复杂得多。为兵的所有可能走法构造一组模式（吃过路兵除外）。b. Pawn moves are much more complicated. Make a set of patterns for all possible pawn moves (except en passant captures).
  3. c. 为王非常有限的走法构造一组模式。暂时不用考虑王车易位，也不用考虑王不能走到受将军位置这一规则。c. Make a set of patterns for the king's very limited ways to move. Don't worry about castling or the rule that a king cannot be moved into check.
  4. d. 王车易位是最后一种特殊情况。它同时涉及王和一只车。构造一组王车易位模式。（见脚注 15。）d. Castling is the final special case. It involves both the king and a rook. Make a set of castling patterns. (See footnote 15.)

4.5.4 棋盘与图的不同视图4.5.4 Chessboards and alternate graph views

将棋盘看作图，蕴含着一个令人振奋的想法。我们希望相同的模式能适用于双方棋手。但是，描述方向的边并不相同：白方的 north 是黑方的 south，白方的 east 是黑方的 west！对于走法模式对称的主要棋子（车、马、象、王、后），这没有太大影响；但白兵只能向 north 走，黑兵只能向 south 走。无论如何，让双方使用相同的走法描述会是件很好的事。The chessboard, as a graph, incorporates an exciting idea. We want the same patterns to work for both players. But the edges describing directions are different: north for White is south for Black and east for White is west for Black! This makes little difference for the major pieces (the rooks, knights, bishops, kings, queens) with symmetrical move patterns, but White pawns can move only north and Black pawns can move only south. In any case, it would be pleasant to make the move descriptions the same for both players.
